raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

With `--monokernel`, every pure decode step of 1 to 128 requests of `amd/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Quark-MXFP4` at TP2 on MI355X runs on persistent FlyDSL kernels, one launch per GDN decoder layer and three around the QSA attention, as RFC #60904 proposes. Prefill and mixed steps run vLLM's forward. This now also covers the 1 to 16 requests of #63032 and is faster there in the same harness (below), so one kernel family serves the whole range. Proof of concept.

## Claims

- Median ITL against #63032 at 1–16 concurrent (same engine base, same GPUs, same harness): **−11 to −24% at 1K inputs**, −10 to −22% at 32K; at 128K, parity at 1 concurrent and −8% at 4.
- Against stock vLLM with TP2-tuned AITER (same flags, `--max-model-len 262144`, 1K inputs): −32 to −42% at 1–16 concurrent (an earlier run on the same engine base), **−18 to −30% at 24–128** (#63032's stock fallback).
- Accuracy at parity: GSM8K stock 0.958 / 0.959, `--monokernel` 0.964 / 0.964 at 128 concurrent and 0.961 / 0.962 at 4 (strict / flexible, stderr 0.005). Long-context retrieval through the decode-time QSA select: every needle recalled at 8K–32K in both arms (single code and all eight codes, 4 and 32 concurrent).
- Stock path: the AMD QSA indexer scoring kernel scores only each row's visible columns. On main its grid grows with `--max-model-len`: at 128 decode rows and 262144 it takes ~375 µs a QSA layer whatever the context, against 28 / 39 / 155 µs at 128 / 8K / 64K context here.
- No new environment variables, and no host syncs in the specialized decode steps (`VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=error`, 1 to 128 concurrent).

## Validation

MI355X, TP2, AITER main with TP2-tuned GEMM/MoE configs, FlyDSL 0.4.1 (the stage tests also pass on 0.4.0). The serving numbers are on this PR's engine base with the kernels of each PR exported onto it, so only the specialized-decode code differs between the arms. This PR's serving numbers are at its head `b974d398ce`; GSM8K, the retrieval check and the host-sync check ran at `c2550fce02`, before the last five commits, which move work between CTAs and issue weight loads earlier without changing the arithmetic.

```bash
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS=1 AITER_USE_FLYDSL_MOE_SORTING=1 \
VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION=INT4 \
vllm serve amd/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Quark-MXFP4 -tp 2 --trust-remote-code --max-model-len 262144 \
  --max-num-seqs 160 --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_capture_sizes": [1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 24, 32, 64, 128]}' \
  --no-enable-prefix-caching --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 --limit-mm-per-prompt '{"image": 0, "video": 0}' \
  --gdn-prefill-backend aiter_flydsl \
  --quantization-config.targets '{"*linear_attn.in_proj_qkv": "mxfp4", "*linear_attn.in_proj_z": "mxfp4", "*linear_attn.out_proj": "mxfp4"}' \
  --monokernel
```

**Serving, 1K inputs** (`vllm bench serve`, random dataset, `--ignore-eos`, output 128, `max(8, 4 × concurrency)` prompts, `max(4, concurrency)` warmups; median of two runs, the second in reverse order; repeat range ≤ 0.4% for this PR, ≤ 0.5% for #63032). Median ITL in ms; #63032 runs stock above 16 rows. The #63032 column is from the previous day's session on the same GPUs; at 1–8 concurrent, whose code the last five commits do not change, this PR's head reproduces that session's numbers for this PR within 0.3%.

| conc. | #63032 | this PR | Δ | TPOT #63032 | TPOT this PR |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 4.082 | 3.638 | −10.9% | 4.095 | 3.654 |
| 2 | 4.484 | 3.857 | −14.0% | 4.847 | 4.225 |
| 3 | 5.016 | 4.177 | −16.7% | 5.023 | 4.185 |
| 4 | 4.995 | 4.201 | −15.9% | 5.000 | 4.202 |
| 5 | 5.900 | 4.843 | −17.9% | 5.884 | 4.816 |
| 8 | 5.909 | 4.961 | −16.0% | 5.902 | 4.941 |
| 12 | 7.857 | 5.945 | −24.3% | 7.839 | 5.914 |
| 16 | 7.829 | 6.072 | −22.4% | 7.774 | 6.041 |
| 24 | 10.408 (stock) | 7.316 | −29.7% | 11.392 | 8.326 |
| 32 | 11.083 (stock) | 7.915 | −28.6% | 13.165 | 10.047 |
| 64 | 13.663 (stock) | 10.444 | −23.6% | 18.534 | 15.561 |
| 128 | 18.877 (stock) | 15.443 | −18.2% | 31.195 | 27.830 |

3, 5 and 12 concurrent run the captured widths 4, 8 and 16 in both arms. Stock at 1 / 2 / 4 / 8 / 16 concurrent on the same engine base (an earlier run, same flags and client): 6.291 / 6.554 / 7.116 / 7.671 / 8.947 ms.

**Serving, long inputs** (as above with `max(4, 2 × concurrency)` prompts and 2 warmups). Median ITL in ms.

| input | conc. | #63032 | this PR | Δ |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 32K | 1 | 4.291 | 3.870 | −9.8% |
| 32K | 4 | 5.254 | 4.433 | −15.6% |
| 32K | 16 | 8.202 | 6.364 | −22.4% |
| 32K | 32 | 12.091 (stock) | 8.290 | −31.4% |
| 128K | 1 | 4.426 | 4.415 | −0.2% |
| 128K | 4 | 5.487 | 5.032 | −8.3% |

At 128K and 16 concurrent the median step carries a prefill chunk in both arms (~0.4 s), so it is not a decode measurement. ITL is the decode-step latency; TPOT also carries the prefill of later requests mixed into decode steps, which run stock in both arms.

**GSM8K** (lm_eval 0.4.13 `local-chat-completions`, `--apply_chat_template --fewshot_as_multiturn`, 5-shot, `chat_template_kwargs={"enable_thinking": false}`, `max_gen_toks` 1024, 1319 questions, `--max-model-len 8448`, default capture sizes up to 128): `--monokernel` 0.964 / 0.964 at 128 concurrent and 0.961 / 0.962 at 4 concurrent (strict / flexible); stock 0.958 / 0.959. 47123 of 49152 engine steps ran on the kernels.

**Long-context retrieval** (8 key-value needles at random depths in 8K, 16K and 32K-token haystacks, 40 prompts a length, greedy, thinking off; same prompts in both arms). Contexts past the indexer's 2048-token budget score and select 512 compressed blocks at every decode step, so the answers depend on the decode-time select. Asked for one code (24 tokens) or all eight in a given order (~80 decode tokens, 1956 of the first 2048 engine steps on the kernels):

| task | conc. | 8K | 16K | 32K |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| one code, stock / `--monokernel` | 4 | 40/40 / 40/40 | 40/40 / 40/40 | 40/40 / 40/40 |
| one code, stock / `--monokernel` | 32 | 40/40 / 40/40 | 40/40 / 40/40 | 40/40 / 40/40 |
| all eight codes, stock / `--monokernel` | 4 | 320/320 / 320/320 | 320/320 / 320/320 | 320/320 / 320/320 |
| all eight codes, stock / `--monokernel` | 32 | 320/320 / 320/320 | 320/320 / 320/320 | 320/320 / 320/320 |

The greedy all-codes replies are identical in 197 of 240 prompts; the others list the same codes in a different order.

**Host syncs**: none under `VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=error` at `c2550fce02` (dummy weights, `--max-cudagraph-capture-size 128`, 1 / 4 / 16 / 32 / 128 concurrent, 736 requests of 512 output tokens, 18379 of the first 18432 engine steps on the kernels). The run uses `--gdn-prefill-backend triton`, because AITER's FlyDSL GDN prefill metadata (the ROCm default) syncs the host on its own, as #63032 notes.

**Tests**: `tests/models/qwen4_exp/amd_specialized_decode/test_stages.py` (198 tests; the codec selection included) checks every stage at 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8, 12, 16, 32 and 128 rows against float references with the stock rounding points: the batch-tiled GEMM on bf16 and both MXFP4 layouts (summed, folded, resident), the gated residual (stats, mix, exchange push, combine; bf16 and INT4 lines), a two-rank exchange with partial lines, the gated delta net (projection + conv with null slots, recurrence, gated norm, out_proj through the exchange; the one-phase resident form), the MoE (routing as sets, weights, outputs of the agreeing rows; random, hot and skewed routing; the small-batch path at 1–12 rows with shared and padding rows), the QSA projections, the fused prepare against `ops.qsa_prepare`, the indexer scores and the in-kernel select against vLLM's top-k (as sets), and the sparse attention (strided paged pools, contexts from none to past the budget, padded rows, a hole in a block list, dense and spread merges).

```bash
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 pytest tests/models/qwen4_exp/amd_specialized_decode/test_stages.py tests/models/qwen4_exp/test_qsa_amd.py
```

225 tests, ~6.5 min on one MI355X. A new Buildkite step (`:amd: (MI355) Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Specialized Decode`) runs the stage tests; `test_qsa_amd.py` runs in the existing `:amd: (MI300) Qwen4 Exp` step.

## Details

Each launch runs one decoder layer as a sequence of bulk-synchronous phases over the whole batch, inside vLLM's step: vLLM schedules, samples and owns the weights and caches, which the kernels read and update in place.

| layer | launches | phases |
|---|---|---|
| GDN ×36 | `gdn` | attn HC mix, GDN in_proj (MXFP4) + in_proj_ba + conv update, gated delta rule + gated RMSNorm, out_proj (MXFP4) + TP exchange + HC combine, MLP HC mix, router, routing + MXFP4 activation quant, experts, MoE combine + TP exchange + HC combine |
| QSA ×12 | `qsa_front`, `qsa_score`, `qsa_attn`, `qsa_back` | attn HC mix → x, qkv_proj + index_qk_proj; the fused prepare (queries, gate, K/V and indexer cache writes), indexer scores and the top-k select; sparse attention; gated o_proj + TP exchange + HC combine, then the MLP half |

- 256 CTAs × 256 threads co-resident; bulk-synchronous phases; a striped grid barrier (64 counters, wave-0 ballot poll).
- Batch-tiled MFMA GEMMs (`v_mfma_f32_16x16x32_bf16`): bf16 weights or MXFP4 weights decoded in registers from either AITER layout (Triton row-major, ASM shuffled), split-K partials summed in order by a later phase or folded by the last arriving unit.
- Up to 16 rows, a GEMM unit stages its whole K slice once, the next phase's first weights are issued between a grid barrier's arrival and its wait, and a mix, and the GDN projection through the attention combine, each run as one phase whose CTAs hand data over as tagged (value, tag) pairs instead of grid barriers.
- Expert-major fused W4A4 MoE on AITER's `AITER_MXFP4_MXFP4` weights in place (gate-up, SiLU, MXFP4 requant with AITER's scale rule, down), the fused shared expert as expert 512. The schedule adapts to the step's expert distribution: one expert's units run on one XCD (one L2), and a last round at most half full runs as intermediate halves. Up to 12 rows a small-batch path spreads each expert over the grid instead: whole router logits per CTA, gate/up pieces of 32 intermediate rows, and 160 CTAs owning the down projection's output rows and pushing the exchange lines.
- Gated delta rule: one CTA per (row, key head) (one value head a unit up to 16 rows), the next head's state loads in flight, a halving 16-row reduction, non-temporal state traffic.
- QSA (`wide/indexer.py`, `wide/select.py`, `wide/attention.py`), on vLLM's paged caches in place. The scores load the row's page table into LDS and run four 16-column tiles a wave a round on the matrix unit; a radix select (three levels of an LDS histogram) picks the decode top-k's set in the same launch, and a row whose visible blocks fit the budget takes all of them unscored. The attention expands its share of the selected blocks into an LDS table of cache byte offsets, stages 16 tokens a wave (`S^T = K Q^T`, wave-private online softmax, `O^T += V^T P^T`), and merges the waves through LDS and the splits in the row's last CTA (spread over the splits at small widths). FP8 or Octave K/V, FP8 indexer keys and MTP top-k reuse keep vLLM's QSA.
- TP exchange: one-shot lines (8 tokens × 64 columns, the last line of a column group partial when the rows are not a multiple of 8) pushed to every rank's uncached mailbox, one flag per line at a fixed offset; readers sum the ranks' copies in rank order and apply the HC combine. With `VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION=INT4` the lines carry QuickReduce's INT4 codec (16-column groups, bf16 group scales; 320 B lines), otherwise exact bf16. Each partial is quantized once (one-shot); on dumped real decode partials that is 22.0 dB SQNR against 18.7 dB for QuickReduce's two-shot, which quantizes twice.

60 layer launches a step plus two QSA kernels on each QSA layer. Four layer builds a capture size in 1–128 compile at startup, one after another (36 for the capture sizes above, ~2 min with an empty FlyDSL cache; 76 for the default list up to 128, ~5.5 min); the QSA kernels compile on first use during graph capture. For profiling, `runtime.layers.TRACE = True` (set in the worker, e.g. from a `--worker-extension-cls` module) builds every launch with per-phase clock stamps.

**Stock QSA scoring.** `_qsa_mqa_paged_kernel` launched one program per 32 columns of the page table's capacity for every query row, so its cost followed `--max-model-len`, not the context, in decode steps and prefill chunks alike. It now launches a fixed grid of at most 4096 programs (CUDA graph safe), and each row's programs stride over its visible column tiles only. Visible scores are bitwise identical; the columns past them, which the decode top-k never reads, are left unwritten, as on the NVIDIA kernel. `test_qsa_mqa_paged_scores_visible_columns` covers it.

**Scope and limitations**

- Follows RFC #60904: `--monokernel`, default-deny refusals (config, model, caches; every reason listed; the TP ranks agree), one `plan()` per step, MRV2 only, model-owned code under `vllm/models/qwen4_exp/amd/specialized_decode/`. Bounded in-kernel waits (grid barriers, exchange flags and tagged hand-offs) with health words; the TP ranks raise together (`FailStop`) rather than hang.
- Speculative decoding is refused, as in #63032. FP8 or Octave K/V, FP8 indexer keys and MTP top-k reuse keep vLLM's QSA inside the specialized step.
- The select runs one CTA per row: at 128K context and one row it is no faster than vLLM's decode top-k, hence the parity with #63032 there.
- vLLM's embedding, PLE, LM head, logits all-gather and sampling stay stock.
- Size: ~9.1K lines of Python, all under the model's `specialized_decode/` except the QSA scoring kernel, the `--monokernel` docstring and the Buildkite step. The kernels are specific to this model, hardware and TP degree; the stage tests pin their numerics.
- Overlap with #63032: both add `specialized_decode/hooks.py` and `runtime/` (`hooks.py` and `runtime/routing.py` are identical). With this PR serving 1–16 rows as well, only one of the two needs to land.

---

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

🚀

Hi @samremes, I pushed 5 commits on top of `c2550fce02`. Each is a separate change, so any of them can be dropped or reverted on its own.

The commits act from 13 rows up. Below that, your resident GEMMs (≤ 16 rows) and small-batch MoE (≤ 12 rows) take over. Those paths already issue the next phase's first weights inside the barrier, which is what commit 3 adds for the wider steps. At 1-12 rows, all layer kernels compile to the same LLVM IR as your head, in bf16 and INT4.

**In practice**
- Gains: decode-heavy serving at about 12-64 concurrent requests (decode steps of 13-64 rows).
- Per-user decode speed (1 / median ITL): +2.2 to +6.3 %, e.g. c24 130 → 138 tok/s, c32 122 → 128 tok/s.
- 32K-token prompts at c16-32: +3 to +4 %.
- c1-8 and c128: no measurable change.
- Output throughput in this benchmark (1K in, 128 out): +1.7 to +3.6 % at c12-64. It rises less because prefill steps are unchanged.

**Commits**
1. **`router_gate` on vLLM main's post-load gate fusion.** vllm#64692 replaced `MoERunner._maybe_fuse_gate_weights()` with `process_weights_after_loading()`. On current main (and the ROCm nightly), the branch fails at start-up with an `AttributeError`. `router_gate` now uses the runner's fused weight, and falls back to the old method on the branch's own base. Once the branch is rebased past #64692, the fallback can go.
2. **Spread few-item phases, and preload mix_up's operands.**
   - mix_reduce, quantize_rows, route and the MoE combine place item i on CTA i % BLOCKS (`Grid.spread`, or `Grid.mirror` where they share CTAs). The MoE part acts from 13 rows, past the small path; the mix part from 17.
   - mix_up's loads that don't depend on `down` are issued as mix_reduce starts.
   - The preloaded chunks travel in your `pending` slot. So at streamed widths, `Gemm.run(pending)` now uses them instead of raising.
3. **At 17-96 rows, preload the next phase's static weights** in the phase before it, while the grid waits (`tiled.unit_preload`, masked loads).
4. **Take the conv loads and `[b | a]` units off the GDN projection's fold chain** (17-128 rows; the resident projection is unchanged).
5. **At 17-48 rows, only the last arriving unit issues the conv loads,** at the start of its fold.

**Correctness**
- `test_stages.py`: 198 collected at each commit, and no commit fails a test the head passes.
- GSM8K, served (n = 1319, strict match; two nodes):
  - head: 0.958, the mean of 2 server lifetimes;
  - with the series: 0.962, the mean of 4;
  - Δ +0.004 ± 0.005, and every single lifetime within 2 SE of its node's head.

**Performance**
- Setup: MI355X, TP2, your serve command from the PR body (capture sizes 1-128, `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.85`, `--monokernel`, INT4 quick reduce), `amd/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Quark-MXFP4` (real weights), the vLLM ROCm nightly `40941f2c` with the PR's files.
- Benchmark: your protocol. `vllm bench serve` random, output 128, max(8, 4C) prompts, max(4, C) warm-ups; median ITL of two runs, the second in reverse order.
- Both arms include commit 1, which the nightly needs.
- Run on two nodes. The table is the quieter node; its last row is the second node.

| Concurrency | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 8 | 12 | 16 | 24 | 32 | 64 | 128 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| head, ITL ms | 3.494 | 3.742 | 4.085 | 4.106 | 4.773 | 4.883 | 5.967 | 6.132 | 7.684 | 8.186 | 10.623 | 15.516 |
| + this series, ITL ms | 3.494 | 3.750 | 4.075 | 4.099 | 4.768 | 4.878 | 5.770 | 5.951 | 7.230 | 7.808 | 10.391 | 15.439 |
| Δ | 0.0 % | +0.2 % | −0.2 % | −0.2 % | −0.1 % | −0.1 % | −3.3 % | −3.0 % | −5.9 % | −4.6 % | −2.2 % | −0.5 % |
| Δ, second node | +0.3 % | +0.2 % | +0.7 % | +0.3 % | +0.6 % | +0.1 % | −2.3 % | −2.4 % | −5.4 % | −3.8 % | −1.6 % | −0.1 % |

- At c1-8 the kernels are identical (widths 1-8). Those columns show the run-to-run noise: within ±0.25 % for the median of two runs on the quiet node, and up to 1.1 % for a single run on the second.
- c12 runs at width 16, where the MoE placement of commit 2 acts.

Long inputs, the same protocol (max(4, 2C) prompts, 2 warm-ups), median ITL, Δ against the head:

| Input | 32K c1 | 32K c4 | 32K c16 | 32K c32 | 128K c1 | 128K c4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Δ | +0.1 % | −0.1 % | −3.0 % | −3.9 % | +0.2 % | −0.3 % |
| Δ, second node | +0.6 % | +0.8 % | −2.2 % | −4.2 % | +0.3 % | +0.2 % |

| 5 | 5.900 | 4.843 | −17.9% | 5.884 | 4.816 |
| 8 | 5.909 | 4.961 | −16.0% | 5.902 | 4.941 |
| 12 | 7.857 | 5.945 | −24.3% | 7.839 | 5.914 |
| 16 | 7.829 | 6.072 | −22.4% | 7.774 | 6.041 |
| 24 | 10.408 (stock) | 7.316 | −29.7% | 11.392 | 8.326 |
| 32 | 11.083 (stock) | 7.915 | −28.6% | 13.165 | 10.047 |
| 64 | 13.663 (stock) | 10.444 | −23.6% | 18.534 | 15.561 |
| 128 | 18.877 (stock) | 15.443 | −18.2% | 31.195 | 27.830 |

3, 5 and 12 concurrent run the captured widths 4, 8 and 16 in both arms. Stock at 1 / 2 / 4 / 8 / 16 concurrent on the same engine base (an earlier run, same flags and client): 6.291 / 6.554 / 7.116 / 7.671 / 8.947 ms.

**Serving, long inputs** (as above with `max(4, 2 × concurrency)` prompts and 2 warmups). Median ITL in ms.

| input | conc. | #63032 | this PR | Δ |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 32K | 1 | 4.291 | 3.870 | −9.8% |
| 32K | 4 | 5.254 | 4.433 | −15.6% |
| 32K | 16 | 8.202 | 6.364 | −22.4% |
| 32K | 32 | 12.091 (stock) | 8.290 | −31.4% |
| 128K | 1 | 4.426 | 4.415 | −0.2% |
| 128K | 4 | 5.487 | 5.032 | −8.3% |

At 128K and 16 concurrent the median step carries a prefill chunk in both arms (~0.4 s), so it is not a decode measurement. ITL is the decode-step latency; TPOT also carries the prefill of later requests mixed into decode steps, which run stock in both arms.

**GSM8K** (lm_eval 0.4.13 `local-chat-completions`, `--apply_chat_template --fewshot_as_multiturn`, 5-shot, `chat_template_kwargs={"enable_thinking": false}`, `max_gen_toks` 1024, 1319 questions, `--max-model-len 8448`, default capture sizes up to 128): `--monokernel` 0.964 / 0.964 at 128 concurrent and 0.961 / 0.962 at 4 concurrent (strict / flexible); stock 0.958 / 0.959. 47123 of 49152 engine steps ran on the kernels.

**Long-context retrieval** (8 key-value needles at random depths in 8K, 16K and 32K-token haystacks, 40 prompts a length, greedy, thinking off; same prompts in both arms). Contexts past the indexer's 2048-token budget score and select 512 compressed blocks at every decode step, so the answers depend on the decode-time select. Asked for one code (24 tokens) or all eight in a given order (~80 decode tokens, 1956 of the first 2048 engine steps on the kernels):

| task | conc. | 8K | 16K | 32K |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| one code, stock / `--monokernel` | 4 | 40/40 / 40/40 | 40/40 / 40/40 | 40/40 / 40/40 |
| one code, stock / `--monokernel` | 32 | 40/40 / 40/40 | 40/40 / 40/40 | 40/40 / 40/40 |
| all eight codes, stock / `--monokernel` | 4 | 320/320 / 320/320 | 320/320 / 320/320 | 320/320 / 320/320 |
| all eight codes, stock / `--monokernel` | 32 | 320/320 / 320/320 | 320/320 / 320/320 | 320/320 / 320/320 |

The greedy all-codes replies are identical in 197 of 240 prompts; the others list the same codes in a different order.

**Host syncs**: none under `VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=error` at `c2550fce02` (dummy weights, `--max-cudagraph-capture-size 128`, 1 / 4 / 16 / 32 / 128 concurrent, 736 requests of 512 output tokens, 18379 of the first 18432 engine steps on the kernels). The run uses `--gdn-prefill-backend triton`, because AITER's FlyDSL GDN prefill metadata (the ROCm default) syncs the host on its own, as #63032 notes.

**Tests**: `tests/models/qwen4_exp/amd_specialized_decode/test_stages.py` (198 tests; the codec selection included) checks every stage at 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8, 12, 16, 32 and 128 rows against float references with the stock rounding points: the batch-tiled GEMM on bf16 and both MXFP4 layouts (summed, folded, resident), the gated residual (stats, mix, exchange push, combine; bf16 and INT4 lines), a two-rank exchange with partial lines, the gated delta net (projection + conv with null slots, recurrence, gated norm, out_proj through the exchange; the one-phase resident form), the MoE (routing as sets, weights, outputs of the agreeing rows; random, hot and skewed routing; the small-batch path at 1–12 rows with shared and padding rows), the QSA projections, the fused prepare against `ops.qsa_prepare`, the indexer scores and the in-kernel select against vLLM's top-k (as sets), and the sparse attention (strided paged pools, contexts from none to past the budget, padded rows, a hole in a block list, dense and spread merges).

```bash
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 pytest tests/models/qwen4_exp/amd_specialized_decode/test_stages.py tests/models/qwen4_exp/test_qsa_amd.py
```

225 tests, ~6.5 min on one MI355X. A new Buildkite step (`:amd: (MI355) Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Specialized Decode`) runs the stage tests; `test_qsa_amd.py` runs in the existing `:amd: (MI300) Qwen4 Exp` step.

## Details

Each launch runs one decoder layer as a sequence of bulk-synchronous phases over the whole batch, inside vLLM's step: vLLM schedules, samples and owns the weights and caches, which the kernels read and update in place.

| layer | launches | phases |
|---|---|---|
| GDN ×36 | `gdn` | attn HC mix, GDN in_proj (MXFP4) + in_proj_ba + conv update, gated delta rule + gated RMSNorm, out_proj (MXFP4) + TP exchange + HC combine, MLP HC mix, router, routing + MXFP4 activation quant, experts, MoE combine + TP exchange + HC combine |
| QSA ×12 | `qsa_front`, `qsa_score`, `qsa_attn`, `qsa_back` | attn HC mix → x, qkv_proj + index_qk_proj; the fused prepare (queries, gate, K/V and indexer cache writes), indexer scores and the top-k select; sparse attention; gated o_proj + TP exchange + HC combine, then the MLP half |

- 256 CTAs × 256 threads co-resident; bulk-synchronous phases; a striped grid barrier (64 counters, wave-0 ballot poll).
- Batch-tiled MFMA GEMMs (`v_mfma_f32_16x16x32_bf16`): bf16 weights or MXFP4 weights decoded in registers from either AITER layout (Triton row-major, ASM shuffled), split-K partials summed in order by a later phase or folded by the last arriving unit.
- Up to 16 rows, a GEMM unit stages its whole K slice once, the next phase's first weights are issued between a grid barrier's arrival and its wait, and a mix, and the GDN projection through the attention combine, each run as one phase whose CTAs hand data over as tagged (value, tag) pairs instead of grid barriers.
- Expert-major fused W4A4 MoE on AITER's `AITER_MXFP4_MXFP4` weights in place (gate-up, SiLU, MXFP4 requant with AITER's scale rule, down), the fused shared expert as expert 512. The schedule adapts to the step's expert distribution: one expert's units run on one XCD (one L2), and a last round at most half full runs as intermediate halves. Up to 12 rows a small-batch path spreads each expert over the grid instead: whole router logits per CTA, gate/up pieces of 32 intermediate rows, and 160 CTAs owning the down projection's output rows and pushing the exchange lines.
- Gated delta rule: one CTA per (row, key head) (one value head a unit up to 16 rows), the next head's state loads in flight, a halving 16-row reduction, non-temporal state traffic.
- QSA (`wide/indexer.py`, `wide/select.py`, `wide/attention.py`), on vLLM's paged caches in place. The scores load the row's page table into LDS and run four 16-column tiles a wave a round on the matrix unit; a radix select (three levels of an LDS histogram) picks the decode top-k's set in the same launch, and a row whose visible blocks fit the budget takes all of them unscored. The attention expands its share of the selected blocks into an LDS table of cache byte offsets, stages 16 tokens a wave (`S^T = K Q^T`, wave-private online softmax, `O^T += V^T P^T`), and merges the waves through LDS and the splits in the row's last CTA (spread over the splits at small widths). FP8 or Octave K/V, FP8 indexer keys and MTP top-k reuse keep vLLM's QSA.
- TP exchange: one-shot lines (8 tokens × 64 columns, the last line of a column group partial when the rows are not a multiple of 8) pushed to every rank's uncached mailbox, one flag per line at a fixed offset; readers sum the ranks' copies in rank order and apply the HC combine. With `VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION=INT4` the lines carry QuickReduce's INT4 codec (16-column groups, bf16 group scales; 320 B lines), otherwise exact bf16. Each partial is quantized once (one-shot); on dumped real decode partials that is 22.0 dB SQNR against 18.7 dB for QuickReduce's two-shot, which quantizes twice.

60 layer launches a step plus two QSA kernels on each QSA layer. Four layer builds a capture size in 1–128 compile at startup, one after another (36 for the capture sizes above, ~2 min with an empty FlyDSL cache; 76 for the default list up to 128, ~5.5 min); the QSA kernels compile on first use during graph capture. For profiling, `runtime.layers.TRACE = True` (set in the worker, e.g. from a `--worker-extension-cls` module) builds every launch with per-phase clock stamps.

**Stock QSA scoring.** `_qsa_mqa_paged_kernel` launched one program per 32 columns of the page table's capacity for every query row, so its cost followed `--max-model-len`, not the context, in decode steps and prefill chunks alike. It now launches a fixed grid of at most 4096 programs (CUDA graph safe), and each row's programs stride over its visible column tiles only. Visible scores are bitwise identical; the columns past them, which the decode top-k never reads, are left unwritten, as on the NVIDIA kernel. `test_qsa_mqa_paged_scores_visible_columns` covers it.

**Scope and limitations**

- Follows RFC #60904: `--monokernel`, default-deny refusals (config, model, caches; every reason listed; the TP ranks agree), one `plan()` per step, MRV2 only, model-owned code under `vllm/models/qwen4_exp/amd/specialized_decode/`. Bounded in-kernel waits (grid barriers, exchange flags and tagged hand-offs) with health words; the TP ranks raise together (`FailStop`) rather than hang.
- Speculative decoding is refused, as in #63032. FP8 or Octave K/V, FP8 indexer keys and MTP top-k reuse keep vLLM's QSA inside the specialized step.
- The select runs one CTA per row: at 128K context and one row it is no faster than vLLM's decode top-k, hence the parity with #63032 there.
- vLLM's embedding, PLE, LM head, logits all-gather and sampling stay stock.
- Size: ~9.1K lines of Python, all under the model's `specialized_decode/` except the QSA scoring kernel, the `--monokernel` docstring and the Buildkite step. The kernels are specific to this model, hardware and TP degree; the stage tests pin their numerics.
- Overlap with #63032: both add `specialized_decode/hooks.py` and `runtime/` (`hooks.py` and `runtime/routing.py` are identical). With this PR serving 1–16 rows as well, only one of the two needs to land.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Float64 references of the wide decode's stages with the stock path's bf16
+rounding points (``bf``), at Qwen3.8-Flash-Next's TP2 shapes."""
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+E2M1 = torch.tensor(
+    [
+        0.0,
+        0.5,
+        1.0,
+        1.5,
+        2.0,
+        3.0,
+        4.0,
+        6.0,
+        -0.0,
+        -0.5,
+        -1.0,
+        -1.5,
+        -2.0,
+        -3.0,
+        -4.0,
+        -6.0,
+    ]
+)
+
+
+def bf(t):
+    return t.to(torch.bfloat16).double()
+
+
+def mxfp4(n, k, gen, lo=118, hi=124):
+    """Random e2m1 codes and E8M0 scales: (packed [n, k / 2], scales [n, k /
+    32], the dequantized float32 [n, k])."""
+    codes = torch.randint(0, 16, (n, k), generator=gen, dtype=torch.uint8)
+    sc = torch.randint(lo, hi, (n, k // 32), generator=gen, dtype=torch.uint8)
+    deq = E2M1[codes.long()] * torch.pow(2.0, sc.float() - 127).repeat_interleave(32, 1)
+    return codes[:, 0::2] | (codes[:, 1::2] << 4), sc, deq
+
+
+def shuffle_data(packed):
+    """AITER's ``shuffle_weight(layout=(16, 16))`` of fp4 codes [.., n, k / 2]."""
+    *lead, n, kb = packed.shape
+    v = packed.reshape(-1, n // 16, 16, kb // 16, 16).permute(0, 1, 3, 2, 4)
+    return v.contiguous().view(*lead, n, kb)
+
+
+def shuffle_scale(sc):
+    """AITER's ``e8m0_shuffle`` of [rows, cols] scales (cols padded to 8)."""
+    rows, cols = sc.shape
+    pad = (cols + 7) // 8 * 8
+    if pad != cols:
+        sc = torch.cat([sc, torch.full((rows, pad - cols), 127, dtype=torch.uint8)], 1)
+    return (
+        sc.view(rows // 32, 2, 16, pad // 8, 2, 4)
+        .permute(0, 3, 5, 2, 4, 1)
+        .contiguous()
+        .view(rows, pad)
+    )
+
+
+def dequant_mx(q, s):
+    """Dequantized [.., k] of packed e2m1 codes ``q`` [.., k / 2] and E8M0
+    scales ``s`` [.., >= k / 32]."""
+    q = q.cpu().long()
+    vals = torch.stack([E2M1[q & 15], E2M1[q >> 4]], -1).flatten(-2)
+    return (
+        vals
+        * torch.pow(2.0, s.cpu().float() - 127).repeat_interleave(32, -1)[
+            ..., : vals.shape[-1]
+        ]
+    )
+
+
+def gated_residual(state, norm_w, w_di, w_up, y, hc: int, lowrank: int, eps: float):
+    """The gated residual's mix of ``state`` [rows, hc * hidden] and the
+    combine of a block output ``y`` [rows, hidden]: (mixed x, injection
+    scales, new state, rrms of state, rrms of the new state)."""
+    rows = state.shape[0]
+    hidden = y.shape[1]
+    x = state.double().view(rows, hc, hidden)
+    rrms = torch.rsqrt(x.pow(2).mean(-1) + eps)
+    yn = x * rrms[..., None]
+    xn = bf(yn + yn * norm_w.double().view(hc, hidden)).view(rows, hc * hidden)
+    dn = bf(xn @ w_di.double().T)
+    low = bf(F.silu(dn[:, :lowrank] / hc))
+    inj = 2 * torch.sigmoid(dn[:, lowrank : lowrank + hc] / hc)
+    gate = bf(low @ w_up.double().T)
+    mixed = bf((torch.sigmoid(gate) * xn).view(rows, hc, hidden).sum(1) / hc)
+    new = bf(x + bf(y.double())[:, None, :] * inj[..., None]).view(rows, hc * hidden)
+    rrms2 = torch.rsqrt(new.view(rows, hc, hidden).pow(2).mean(-1) + eps)
+    return mixed, inj, new, rrms, rrms2
+
+
+def gated_delta_net(
+    x, wq, wba, wconv, a_log, dt_bias, normw, wo, st_idx, conv_state, ssm, eps: float
+):
+    """The GDN block of rows ``x`` with state slots ``st_idx`` (<= 0: none):
+    (conv output q | k | v, z, new conv states, new recurrent states, core
+    [rows, NV * 128], out_proj output). Dims from the weights: ``wq`` [q | k |
+    v | z rows, hidden], ``wba`` [b | a rows, hidden]."""
+    rows = x.shape[0]
+    nv = a_log.numel()
+    dk = 128
+    key_dim = (wq.shape[0] - 2 * nv * dk) // 2
+    nk = key_dim // dk
+    conv_dim = 2 * key_dim + nv * dk
+    qkvz = bf(x.double() @ wq.double().T)
+    bav = bf(x.double() @ wba.double().T)
+    mixed, z = qkvz[:, :conv_dim], qkvz[:, conv_dim:]
+    conv_state = conv_state.double().clone()
+    ssm = ssm.double().clone()
+    out = torch.zeros(rows, conv_dim, dtype=torch.float64)
+    for r in range(rows):
+        sl = int(st_idx[r])
+        s = conv_state[sl] if sl > 0 else torch.zeros(3, conv_dim, dtype=torch.float64)
+        win = torch.cat([s, mixed[r : r + 1]], 0)
+        out[r] = bf(F.silu((win.T * wconv.double().view(conv_dim, 4)).sum(1)))
+        if sl > 0:
+            conv_state[sl] = torch.cat([s[1:], mixed[r : r + 1]], 0)
+    q = out[:, :key_dim].view(rows, nk, dk)
+    k = out[:, key_dim : 2 * key_dim].view(rows, nk, dk)
+    v = out[:, 2 * key_dim :].view(rows, nv, dk)
+    q = q / torch.sqrt((q * q).sum(-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-6) * dk**-0.5
+    k = k / torch.sqrt((k * k).sum(-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-6)
+    beta = torch.sigmoid(bav[:, :nv])
+    g = -torch.exp(a_log.double()) * F.softplus(bav[:, nv:] + dt_bias.double())
+    core = torch.zeros(rows, nv, dk, dtype=torch.float64)
+    per_k = nv // nk
+    for r in range(rows):
+        sl = int(st_idx[r])
+        if sl <= 0:
+            continue
+        for vh in range(nv):
+            kh = vh // per_k
+            h = ssm[sl, vh] * torch.exp(g[r, vh])  # [V, K]
+            dv = (v[r, vh] - h @ k[r, kh]) * beta[r, vh]
+            h = h + torch.outer(dv, k[r, kh])
+            o = bf(h @ q[r, kh])
+            ssm[sl, vh] = h
+            gate = torch.sigmoid(z[r].view(nv, dk)[vh])
+            core[r, vh] = bf(
+                o * torch.rsqrt((o * o).mean() + eps) * normw.double() * gate
+            )
+    core = core.view(rows, nv * dk)
+    return out, z, conv_state, ssm, core, bf(core @ wo.double().T)
+
+
+def moe(x, w_gate, w13d, w2d, experts: int, topk: int, ri: int, rip: int):
+    """The MoE of rows ``x``: softmax top-k over the bf16 router logits of the
+    routed experts plus the shared expert (index ``experts``, sigmoid
+    weight), activations quantized to MXFP4 as AITER does (input and the
+    gate-up product). Returns (y f64, expert ids, weights)."""
+    from aiter.ops.triton.quant import dynamic_mxfp4_quant
+
+    rows, hidden = x.shape
+    logits = bf(x.double() @ w_gate.double().T)
+    top_v, top_i = torch.topk(logits[:, :experts], topk, dim=-1)
+    ids = torch.cat([top_i, torch.full((rows, 1), experts)], 1)
+    ws = torch.cat(
+        [torch.softmax(top_v, -1), torch.sigmoid(logits[:, experts])[:, None]], 1
+    )
+    xq, xs = dynamic_mxfp4_quant(x.cuda())
+    xd = dequant_mx(xq, xs).double()
+    y = torch.zeros(rows, hidden, dtype=torch.float64)
+    for b in range(rows):
+        for j in range(topk + 1):
+            e = int(ids[b, j])
+            gu = w13d[e].double() @ xd[b]
+            act = (F.silu(gu[:ri]) * gu[rip : rip + ri]).float()
+            aq, as_ = dynamic_mxfp4_quant(act[None].cuda())
+            y[b] += ws[b, j] * (
+                w2d[e][:, :ri].double() @ dequant_mx(aq, as_)[0].double()
+            )
+    return y, ids, ws
+
+
+def int4_roundtrip(y):
+    """The TP exchange's INT4 line codec on ``y`` [rows, cols] (f32 math as
+    the kernels do): groups of 16 columns, ``scale = bf16(extremum / -8)``,
+    codes ``roundeven(y * (1 / scale))`` clamped to [-8, 7]."""
+    v = y.float().view(y.shape[0], -1, 16)
+    hi, lo = v.amax(-1, keepdim=True), v.amin(-1, keepdim=True)
+    ext = torch.where(hi > -lo, hi, lo)
+    scale = (ext * -0.125).to(torch.bfloat16).float()
+    inv = torch.where(scale == 0, torch.zeros_like(scale), 1.0 / scale)
+    q = torch.round(v * inv).clamp(-8, 7)
+    return (q * scale).view_as(y)
+
+
+def int4_lines(words, rows: int, groups: int, lpg: int, hidden: int):
+    """Decode an exchange row of INT4 lines (i32 ``words``) to [rows, hidden]
+    f32: a line's 64 code dwords (token ``t``, segment ``s`` at ``8 t + s``),
+    then each token's two scale dwords (bf16 pairs of its four groups)."""
+    lines = words.view(groups, lpg, 80).cpu().long() & 0xFFFFFFFF
+    codes = lines[..., :64].view(groups, lpg, 8, 8)  # [g, blk, token, seg]
+    nib = torch.stack([(codes >> (4 * e)) & 15 for e in range(8)], -1) - 8
+    sc = lines[..., 64:].view(groups, lpg, 8, 2)
+    halves = torch.stack([sc & 0xFFFF, sc >> 16], -1).view(groups, lpg, 8, 4)
+    scale = (halves << 16).to(torch.int32).view(torch.float32)  # [g, blk, token, group]
+    vals = nib.float() * scale.repeat_interleave(2, -1)[..., None]
+    out = vals.view(groups, lpg, 8, 64).permute(1, 2, 0, 3).reshape(lpg * 8, hidden)
+    return out[:rows]

@@ -0,0 +1,2147 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The wide decode's stages on MI355X against float64 references with the
+stock path's rounding points, at the shapes of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next at TP2, one
+GPU (the TP exchange with one rank): the batch-tiled GEMM on each weight
+format, the gated residual (stats, mix, combine), the gated delta net (input
+projection + conv, recurrence + gated norm, out_proj into the exchange) and
+the MoE (router, routing, AITER-layout experts in place, combine).
+
+Tolerances: an output rounded to bf16 is within one bf16 ulp (2^-8 relative)
+of the reference rounded at the same points, two where it follows another
+bf16-rounded value; a max-relative bound of 1e-2 covers that. Routing is
+compared as sets: bf16 logits tie at the top-k boundary, so a few rows may
+pick different experts; their outputs are excluded from the MoE bound."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+from . import reference as ref
+from .reference import mxfp4, shuffle_data, shuffle_scale
+
+
+def _on_gfx950() -> bool:
+    if not current_platform.is_rocm():
+        return False
+    from vllm.platforms.rocm import on_gfx950
+
+    return on_gfx950()
+
+

+    """A one-GPU launch environment: sync slots, health, a one-rank mailbox."""

+    def __init__(self):

+    def sync_args(self):
+        from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.common.grid import (
+            FOLD_BASE,
+            SLOT_WORDS,
+        )
+
+        base = self.sync.data_ptr()
+        k = self.seq % 2
+        self.seq += 1
+        return [
+            base + 4 * k * SLOT_WORDS,
+            base + 4 * (1 - k) * SLOT_WORDS,
+            base + 4 * FOLD_BASE,
+            self.health.data_ptr(),
+        ]
+
+    def exchange_y(self, rows, slot, codec="bf16"):
+        """The rank's partial in exchange slot ``slot`` as [rows, HIDDEN]."""
+        return exchange_lines(self.mbox_t, 1, slot, 0, rows, codec)

+def exchange_lines(mbox, tp, slot, src, rows, codec):
+    """Source rank ``src``'s lines in exchange slot ``slot`` of a mailbox (i32
+    words) as [rows, HIDDEN]."""
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.layout import HIDDEN
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.stages import (
+        exchange as ex,
+    )
+
+    words, lpg = ex.row_words(), ex.lines_per_group(rows)
+    at = (slot * tp + src) * words
+    row = mbox[at : at + ex.payload_words(rows, codec)]
+    if codec == "int4":
+        return ref.int4_lines(row, rows, ex.GROUPS, lpg, HIDDEN)
+    y = row.contiguous().view(torch.bfloat16).view(ex.GROUPS, lpg, ex.TOKENS, ex.COLS)
+    return y.permute(1, 2, 0, 3).reshape(lpg * ex.TOKENS, HIDDEN)[:rows]

+def _gemm_kernel(rows, n, k, splits, fmt, fold):
+    import flydsl.compiler as flyc
+    import flydsl.expr as fx
+    from flydsl.expr.typing import Int64
+
+    default_stream = fx.Stream(None)
+
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.common.grid import (
+        Grid,
+        grid_sync,
+        prologue,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.common.ops import CM_DEV, st
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.layout import BLOCKS, THREADS
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.stages import tiled
+
+    plan = tiled.SplitK(n, k, splits)
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class Smem:
+        stage: fx.Array[fx.Int32, tiled.stage_words(rows, plan.per), 16]
+        word: fx.Array[fx.Int32, 4, 16]
+
+    def weights(w, ws):
+        if fmt == "bf16":
+            return tiled.Bf16Weights(w, n, k)
+        return tiled.Fp4Weights(w, ws, n, k, shuffled=fmt == "fp4_asm")
+
+    @flyc.kernel(
+        name=f"t_gemm_{rows}_{n}_{k}_{splits}_{fmt}_{int(fold)}",
+        known_block_size=[THREADS, 1, 1],
+    )
+    def kern(
+        x: Int64,
+        w: Int64,
+        ws: Int64,
+        out: Int64,
+        part: Int64,
+        s0: Int64,
+        s1: Int64,
+        folds: Int64,
+        health: Int64,
+    ):
+        tid, bid = fx.thread_idx.x, fx.block_idx.x
+        sm = fx.SharedAllocator().allocate(Smem).peek()
+        g = Grid(tid, bid, s0, s1, folds, health, fx.Int64(0), sm.word.ptr)
+        prologue(g)
+        gemm = tiled.Gemm(sm.stage.ptr, rows, tid, k_total=k, chunks=plan.per)
+        if fx.const_expr(not fold):
+            tiled.gemm_units(
+                bid,
+                BLOCKS,
+                gemm,
+                tiled.Source(x, k),
+                weights(w, ws),
+                plan,
+                tiled.partial_epilogue(gemm, plan, part),
+            )
+            grid_sync(g)
+            n4 = plan.padded // 4
+            for i in range(bid * THREADS + tid, rows * n4, BLOCKS * THREADS):
+                tot = tiled.sum_partials4(part, plan, rows, i // n4, i % n4 * 4)
+                st(out, i * 4, fx.Vector.from_elements(tot, fx.Float32), cm=CM_DEV)
+        else:
+
+            def finish(group, first, lane, acc):
+                for t in fx.range_constexpr(gemm.tiles):
+                    token = t * 16 + lane % 16
+                    if token < rows:
+                        st(out, token * plan.padded + first + lane // 16 * 4, acc[t])
+
+            epi, after = tiled.fold(g, gemm, plan, part, 0, finish)
+            tiled.gemm_units(
+                bid, BLOCKS, gemm, tiled.Source(x, k), weights(w, ws), plan, epi, after
+            )
+
+    @flyc.jit
+    def launch(
+        x: Int64,
+        w: Int64,
+        ws: Int64,
+        out: Int64,
+        part: Int64,
+        s0: Int64,
+        s1: Int64,
+        folds: Int64,
+        health: Int64,
+        stream: fx.Stream = default_stream,
+    ):
+        kern(x, w, ws, out, part, s0, s1, folds, health).launch(
+            grid=(BLOCKS,), block=(THREADS,), stream=stream
+        )
+
+    return launch, plan
+
+
+def _check_gemm(harness, rows, n, k, splits, fmt, fold):
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)
+    x = torch.randn(rows, k, generator=gen).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    if fmt == "bf16":
+        w = (torch.randn(n, k, generator=gen) * 0.05).to(torch.bfloat16)
+        wref, wd, wsd = w.double(), w.cuda(), torch.zeros(1, device="cuda")
+    else:
+        packed, sc, wref = mxfp4(n, k, gen)
+        if fmt == "fp4_triton":
+            wd, wsd = packed.cuda(), sc.T.contiguous().cuda()
+        else:
+            wd, wsd = shuffle_data(packed).cuda(), shuffle_scale(sc).cuda()
+    launch, plan = _gemm_kernel(rows, n, k, splits, fmt, fold)
+    out = torch.zeros(rows, plan.padded, device="cuda")
+    part = torch.zeros(plan.partial_words(rows), device="cuda")
+    xd = x.cuda()
+    launch(
+        xd.data_ptr(),
+        wd.data_ptr(),
+        wsd.data_ptr(),
+        out.data_ptr(),
+        part.data_ptr(),
+        *harness.sync_args(),
+        torch.cuda.current_stream(),
+    )
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    assert harness.health[0].item() == 0
+    assert rel(out[:, :n], x.double() @ wref.double().T) < 1e-5
+

+EPS = 1e-6

+def _hc_kernel(rows, codec="bf16", combine=True, cold=False):
+    import flydsl.compiler as flyc
+    import flydsl.expr as fx
+    from flydsl.expr.typing import Int64
+
+    default_stream = fx.Stream(None)
+
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.common.grid import (
+        Grid,
+        grid_sync,
+        prologue,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.common.ops import (
+        CM_DEV,
+        ld_i32x4,
+        lds_st,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.layout import (
+        BLOCKS,
+        HIDDEN,
+        LOWRANK,
+        THREADS,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.stages import exchange as ex
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.stages import hc, tiled
+
+    chunks = max(hc.down_plan(rows).per, hc.UP_CHUNKS)
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class Smem:
+        stage: fx.Array[fx.Int32, tiled.stage_words(rows, chunks), 16]
+        red: fx.Array[fx.Float32, hc.up_lds_words(rows), 16]
+        tile: fx.Array[fx.Int32, ex.GroupTile.words(rows), 16]
+        word: fx.Array[fx.Int32, 4, 16]
+
+    @flyc.kernel(
+        name=f"t_hc_{rows}_{codec}_{int(combine)}_{int(cold)}",
+        known_block_size=[THREADS, 1, 1],
+    )
+    def kern(
+        state: Int64,
+        norm_w: Int64,
+        w_di: Int64,
+        w_up: Int64,
+        x_out: Int64,
+        inj: Int64,
+        rrms: Int64,
+        part: Int64,
+        down: Int64,
+        y: Int64,
+        mbox: Int64,
+        rrms2: Int64,
+        epoch: Int64,
+        s0: Int64,
+        s1: Int64,
+        folds: Int64,
+        health: Int64,
+    ):
+        tid, bid = fx.thread_idx.x, fx.block_idx.x
+        sm = fx.SharedAllocator().allocate(Smem).peek()
+        g = Grid(tid, bid, s0, s1, folds, health, fx.Int64(0), sm.word.ptr)
+        prologue(g)
+        # past the resident widths the down weights issued during the stats, as
+        # the layer kernels do up to ``tiled.PRELOAD_ROWS``
+        pre = None
+        if fx.const_expr(not tiled.resident(rows)):
+            down_w = hc.down_weights(w_di)
+            early = tiled.Gemm(sm.stage.ptr, rows, tid, chunks=chunks)
+            pre = tiled.unit_preload(early, down_w, hc.down_plan(rows), g.bid)
+        hc.stats(g, state, rrms, rows, EPS)
+        gemm = tiled.Gemm(sm.stage.ptr, rows, tid, chunks=chunks)
+        up = tiled.Gemm(sm.stage.ptr, rows, tid, k_total=LOWRANK, chunks=chunks)
+        if fx.const_expr(tiled.resident(rows)):
+            # one phase with tagged hand-offs, its weights issued inside the
+            # barrier before it (or, ``cold``, in it), as the layer kernels do
+            # (``part``, ``down``: the tagged partials and low-rank rows)
+            issue = None if cold else (lambda: hc.mix_issue(g, w_di, w_up, rows))
+            pending = grid_sync(g, issue)
+            tag = fx.Int32(ld_i32x4(epoch, 0)[0]) * 128 + 7
+            hc.mix_resident(
+                g,
+                gemm,
+                up,
+                sm.red.ptr,
+                state,
+                rrms,
+                norm_w,
+                w_di,
+                w_up,
+                x_out,
+                inj,
+                (part, down),
+                tag,
+                rows,
+                pending,
+            )
+        else:
+            grid_sync(g)
+            pre_up = hc.UpLoads(g, up, w_up, state, rrms, norm_w, rows)
+            hc.mix_down(g, gemm, state, rrms, norm_w, w_di, part, pre)
+            grid_sync(g)
+            hc.mix_reduce(g, part, down, inj, rows, True)
+            grid_sync(g)
+            hc.mix_up(g, up, sm.red.ptr, down, w_up, x_out, rows, pre_up)
+        if fx.const_expr(combine):
+            grid_sync(g)
+            # y through a one-rank exchange (a 64-column group a CTA), then the
+            # combine
+            tag = fx.Int32(ld_i32x4(epoch, 0)[0]) * 128 + 5
+            xch = ex.Exchange([fx.Int64(mbox)], mbox, 0, 1, 1, tag, rows, codec)
+            tile = ex.GroupTile(sm.tile.ptr, rows)
+            for grp in range(bid, ex.GROUPS, BLOCKS):
+                for idx in range(tid, rows * 8, THREADS):
+                    token, piece = idx // 8, idx % 8
+                    at = (token * HIDDEN + grp * 64 + piece * 8) // 2
+                    w = ld_i32x4(y, at, CM_DEV)
+                    lds_st(tile.ptr + token * ex.GroupTile.STRIDE + piece * 4, w)
+                fx.barrier()
+                ex.push_tile(g, xch, tile, grp)
+                fx.barrier()
+            hc.combine(g, xch, state, inj, rrms2, rows, EPS)
+
+    @flyc.jit
+    def launch(
+        state: Int64,
+        norm_w: Int64,
+        w_di: Int64,
+        w_up: Int64,
+        x_out: Int64,
+        inj: Int64,
+        rrms: Int64,
+        part: Int64,
+        down: Int64,
+        y: Int64,
+        mbox: Int64,
+        rrms2: Int64,
+        epoch: Int64,
+        s0: Int64,
+        s1: Int64,
+        folds: Int64,
+        health: Int64,
+        stream: fx.Stream = default_stream,
+    ):
+        kern(
+            state,
+            norm_w,
+            w_di,
+            w_up,
+            x_out,
+            inj,
+            rrms,
+            part,
+            down,
+            y,
+            mbox,
+            rrms2,
+            epoch,
+            s0,
+            s1,
+            folds,
+            health,
+        ).launch(grid=(BLOCKS,), block=(THREADS,), stream=stream)
+
+    return launch
+

+        push: Int32,
+        combine: Int32,
+        s0: Int64,
+        s1: Int64,
+        folds: Int64,
+        health: Int64,
+    ):
+        tid, bid = fx.thread_idx.x, fx.block_idx.x
+        sm = fx.SharedAllocator().allocate(Smem).peek()
+        g = Grid(tid, bid, s0, s1, folds, health, fx.Int64(0), sm.word.ptr)
+        prologue(g)
+        bases = [fx.Int64(mbox0), fx.Int64(mbox1)]
+        own = (rank == 1).select(bases[1], bases[0])
+        tag = fx.Int32(ld_i32x4(epoch, 0)[0]) * 128 + 7
+        xch = ex.Exchange(bases, own, rank, 2, 1, tag, rows, codec)
+        tile = ex.GroupTile(sm.tile.ptr, rows)
+        if push != 0:
+            for grp in range(bid, ex.GROUPS, BLOCKS):
+                for idx in range(tid, rows * 8, THREADS):
+                    token, piece = idx // 8, idx % 8
+                    w = ld_i32x4(
+                        y, (token * HIDDEN + grp * 64 + piece * 8) // 2, CM_DEV
+                    )
+                    lds_st(tile.ptr + token * ex.GroupTile.STRIDE + piece * 4, w)
+                fx.barrier()
+                ex.push_tile(g, xch, tile, grp)
+                fx.barrier()
+        if combine != 0:
+            hc.combine(g, xch, state, inj, rrms, rows, EPS)
+
+    @flyc.jit
+    def launch(
+        y: Int64,
+        mbox0: Int64,
+        mbox1: Int64,
+        state: Int64,
+        inj: Int64,
+        rrms: Int64,
+        epoch: Int64,
+        rank: Int32,
+        push: Int32,
+        combine: Int32,
+        s0: Int64,
+        s1: Int64,
+        folds: Int64,
+        health: Int64,
+        stream: fx.Stream = default_stream,
+    ):
+        kern(
+            y,
+            mbox0,
+            mbox1,
+            state,
+            inj,
+            rrms,
+            epoch,
+            rank,
+            push,
+            combine,
+            s0,
+            s1,
+            folds,
+            health,
+        ).launch(grid=(BLOCKS,), block=(THREADS,), stream=stream)
+
+    return launch
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("codec", CODECS)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("rows", WIDTHS)
+def test_exchange_two_ranks(harness, mailboxes, rows, codec):
+    """Rank 1 pushes, then rank 0 pushes and combines, then rank 1 combines:
+    both ranks' new states are the same bits (each decodes both copies, its
+    own included, and adds them in rank order) and match the reference; each
+    mailbox holds both ranks' lines and tagged flags, and nothing past a
+    partial line's rows, past the step's payload or past its flags."""
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.layout import (
+        HC,
+        HC_HIDDEN,
+        HIDDEN,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.stages import exchange as ex
+
+    ptrs, views = mailboxes
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(4)
+    ys = [torch.randn(rows, HIDDEN, generator=gen).to(torch.bfloat16) for _ in "01"]
+    state = (torch.randn(rows, HC_HIDDEN, generator=gen) * 2).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    inj = 0.5 + torch.rand(rows, HC, generator=gen)
+    lines = [ref.int4_roundtrip(y) if codec == "int4" else y.float() for y in ys]
+    y = ref.bf((lines[0] + lines[1]).double())
+    x = state.double().view(rows, HC, HIDDEN)
+    new = ref.bf(x + y[:, None, :] * inj[..., None]).view(rows, HC_HIDDEN)
+
+    for v in views:
+        v.fill_(SENTINEL)
+    yd = [y.cuda() for y in ys]
+    states = [state.cuda() for _ in "01"]
+    injd = inj.cuda()
+    rrms = [torch.zeros(rows, HC, device="cuda") for _ in "01"]
+    launch = _exchange_kernel(rows, codec)
+    for rank, push, combine in ((1, 1, 0), (0, 1, 1), (1, 0, 1)):
+        launch(
+            yd[rank].data_ptr(),
+            *ptrs,
+            states[rank].data_ptr(),
+            injd.data_ptr(),
+            rrms[rank].data_ptr(),
+            harness.epoch.data_ptr(),
+            rank,
+            push,
+            combine,
+            *harness.sync_args(),
+            torch.cuda.current_stream(),
+        )
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    assert harness.health[0].item() == 0
+    assert torch.equal(states[0], states[1])
+    assert torch.equal(rrms[0], rrms[1])
+    assert rel(states[0], new) < 1e-2
+
+    tag = harness.epoch[0].item() * 128 + 7
+    words, lpg, lw = ex.row_words(), ex.lines_per_group(rows), ex.line_words(codec)
+    live = torch.zeros(lpg * ex.TOKENS, dtype=torch.bool)
+    live[:rows] = True
+    for mbox in views:
+        for src in range(2):
+            got = exchange_lines(mbox, 2, 1, src, rows, codec).double().cpu()
+            if codec == "int4":
+                assert rel(got, lines[src]) < 1e-2
+            else:
+                assert torch.equal(got, ys[src].double())
+            row = mbox[(2 + src) * words : (3 + src) * words].cpu()
+            payload = row[: ex.payload_words(rows, codec)].view(ex.GROUPS, lpg, lw)
+            if codec == "bf16":
+                dead = payload.view(ex.GROUPS, lpg * ex.TOKENS, 32)[:, ~live]
+            else:
+                codes = payload[..., :64].reshape(ex.GROUPS, lpg * ex.TOKENS, 8)
+                scales = payload[..., 64:].reshape(ex.GROUPS, lpg * ex.TOKENS, 2)
+                dead = torch.cat([codes[:, ~live], scales[:, ~live]], -1)
+            assert (dead == SENTINEL).all()
+            rest = row[ex.payload_words(rows, codec) : ex.FLAGS_AT]
+            assert (rest == SENTINEL).all()
+            flags = row[ex.FLAGS_AT :]
+            assert (flags[: ex.flag_words(rows)] == tag).all()
+            assert (flags[ex.flag_words(rows) :] == SENTINEL).all()

+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# the gated delta net: in_proj + conv, recurrence + gated norm, out_proj
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def _gdn_kernel(rows, out=True):
+    import flydsl.compiler as flyc
+    import flydsl.expr as fx
+    from flydsl.expr.typing import Int64
+
+    default_stream = fx.Stream(None)
+
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.common.grid import (
+        Grid,
+        grid_sync,
+        prologue,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.common.ops import ld_i32x4
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.layout import (
+        BLOCKS,
+        CONV_DIM,
+        HIDDEN,
+        NV,
+        THREADS,
+        VALUE_DIM,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.stages import exchange as ex
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.stages import (
+        gdn,
+        tagged,
+        tiled,
+    )
+
+    chunks = max(gdn.proj_plan().per, gdn.out_plan().per)
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class Smem:
+        stage: fx.Array[fx.Int32, tiled.stage_words(rows, chunks), 16]
+        tile: fx.Array[fx.Int32, ex.GroupTile.words(rows), 16]
+        red: fx.Array[fx.Float32, gdn.recur_lds_words(), 16]
+        word: fx.Array[fx.Int32, 4, 16]
+
+    @flyc.kernel(name=f"t_gdn_{rows}_{int(out)}", known_block_size=[THREADS, 1, 1])
+    def kern(
+        x: Int64,
+        wq: Int64,
+        wq_scale: Int64,
+        wba: Int64,
+        wconv: Int64,
+        a_log: Int64,
+        dt_bias: Int64,
+        normw: Int64,
+        wo: Int64,
+        wo_scale: Int64,
+        qkv: Int64,
+        z: Int64,
+        ba: Int64,
+        core: Int64,
+        part: Int64,
+        st_idx: Int64,
+        conv_state: Int64,
+        ssm: Int64,
+        mbox: Int64,
+        epoch: Int64,
+        s0: Int64,
+        s1: Int64,
+        folds: Int64,
+        health: Int64,
+    ):
+        tid, bid = fx.thread_idx.x, fx.block_idx.x
+        sm = fx.SharedAllocator().allocate(Smem).peek()
+        g = Grid(tid, bid, s0, s1, folds, health, fx.Int64(0), sm.word.ptr)
+        prologue(g)
+        w = gdn.Bufs(
+            qkvz=wq,
+            qkvz_s=wq_scale,
+            shuffled=False,
+            ba=wba,
+            conv=wconv,
+            a_log=a_log,
+            dt_bias=dt_bias,
+            norm=normw,
+        )
+        b = gdn.Bufs(
+            x=x,
+            qkv=qkv,
+            z=z,
+            ba=ba,
+            core=core,
+            part=part,
+            st_idx=st_idx,
+            conv_state=conv_state,
+            ssm=ssm,
+            conv_stride=fx.Int64(3 * CONV_DIM),
+            ssm_stride=fx.Int64(NV * 128 * 128),
+        )
+        # at the resident widths each GEMM's first weights are issued ahead,
+        # the out_proj's inside the barrier before it, and the recurrence
+        # polls the projection's tagged outputs, as the layer kernels do
+        pre = tiled.resident(rows)
+        gemm = tiled.Gemm(sm.stage.ptr, rows, tid, chunks=chunks)
+        weights = tiled.Fp4Weights(wo, wo_scale, HIDDEN, VALUE_DIM, False)
+        if fx.const_expr(pre):
+            gtag = fx.Int32(ld_i32x4(epoch, 0)[0]) * 128 + 9
+            gdn.proj(g, gemm, w, b, rows, 0, gdn.proj_issue(g, w), gtag)
+            gdn.recur(g, w, b, sm.red.ptr, rows, EPS, None, gtag)
+            out_w = tiled.issue_unit(bid, tid, weights, gdn.out_plan())
+            source = tagged.Pairs(g, core, VALUE_DIM, gtag)
+        else:
+            # each GEMM's first weights preloaded, out_proj's during the
+            # recurrence, as the layer kernels do up to ``tiled.PRELOAD_ROWS``
+            proj_w = tiled.unit_preload(
+                gemm, gdn.proj_weights(w), gdn.proj_plan(), g.bid
+            )
+            gdn.proj(g, gemm, w, b, rows, 0, proj_w)
+            grid_sync(g)
+            out_w = None
+            if fx.const_expr(out):
+                out_w = tiled.unit_preload(gemm, weights, gdn.out_plan(), g.bid)
+            gdn.recur(g, w, b, sm.red.ptr, rows, EPS)
+            source = tiled.Source(core, VALUE_DIM)
+            if fx.const_expr(out):
+                grid_sync(g)
+        if fx.const_expr(out):
+            tag = fx.Int32(ld_i32x4(epoch, 0)[0]) * 128 + 3
+            xch = ex.Exchange([fx.Int64(mbox)], mbox, 0, 1, 0, tag, rows)
+            gdn.out(
+                g,
+                gemm,
+                weights,
+                source,
+                part,
+                ex.GroupTile(sm.tile.ptr, rows),
+                xch,
+                VALUE_DIM,
+                200,
+                out_w,
+            )
+
+    @flyc.jit
+    def launch(
+        x: Int64,
+        wq: Int64,
+        wq_scale: Int64,
+        wba: Int64,
+        wconv: Int64,
+        a_log: Int64,
+        dt_bias: Int64,
+        normw: Int64,
+        wo: Int64,
+        wo_scale: Int64,
+        qkv: Int64,
+        z: Int64,
+        ba: Int64,
+        core: Int64,
+        part: Int64,
+        st_idx: Int64,
+        conv_state: Int64,
+        ssm: Int64,
+        mbox: Int64,
+        epoch: Int64,
+        s0: Int64,
+        s1: Int64,
+        folds: Int64,
+        health: Int64,
+        stream: fx.Stream = default_stream,
+    ):
+        kern(
+            x,
+            wq,
+            wq_scale,
+            wba,
+            wconv,
+            a_log,
+            dt_bias,
+            normw,
+            wo,
+            wo_scale,
+            qkv,
+            z,
+            ba,
+            core,
+            part,
+            st_idx,
+            conv_state,
+            ssm,
+            mbox,
+            epoch,
+            s0,
+            s1,
+            folds,
+            health,
+        ).launch(grid=(BLOCKS,), block=(THREADS,), stream=stream)
+
+    return launch
+

+
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(2)

+    x = torch.randn(rows, HIDDEN, generator=gen).to(torch.bfloat16)

+    wconv = (torch.randn(CONV_DIM, 1, 4, generator=gen) * 0.5).to(torch.bfloat16)

+    normw = (1 + torch.randn(128, generator=gen) * 0.1).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    wo_data, wo_scale, wo = mxfp4(HIDDEN, VALUE_DIM, gen, 116, 121)
+    st_idx = (torch.randperm(slots - 1, generator=gen)[:rows] + 1).to(torch.int32)
+    st_idx[pads] = 0
+    conv_state = torch.randn(slots, 3, CONV_DIM, generator=gen).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    ssm = torch.randn(slots, NV, 128, 128, generator=gen) * 0.05
+    conv_r, z_r, cs_r, ssm_r, core_r, y_r = ref.gated_delta_net(
+        x, wq, wba, wconv, a_log, dt_bias, normw, wo, st_idx, conv_state, ssm, EPS
+    )
+
+    d = {
+        n: v.cuda()
+        for n, v in dict(
+            x=x,
+            wq_data=wq_data,
+            wq_scale=wq_scale.T.contiguous(),
+            wba=wba,
+            wconv=wconv,
+            a_log=a_log,
+            dt_bias=dt_bias,
+            normw=normw,
+            wo_data=wo_data,
+            wo_scale=wo_scale.T.contiguous(),

+            conv_state=conv_state,
+            ssm=ssm,
+        ).items()
+    }
+    qkv_words, ba_words, core_words = gdn.handoff_words(rows)
+    qkv = torch.zeros(qkv_words, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    z = torch.zeros(rows, VALUE_DIM, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+    ba = torch.zeros(ba_words, device="cuda")
+    core = torch.zeros(core_words, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    part = torch.zeros(
+        max(gdn.proj_plan().partial_words(rows), gdn.out_plan().partial_words(rows)),
+        device="cuda",
+    )
+    harness.mbox_t.zero_()
+    _gdn_kernel(rows, out)(
+        *[
+            d[n].data_ptr()
+            for n in (
+                "x",
+                "wq_data",
+                "wq_scale",
+                "wba",
+                "wconv",
+                "a_log",
+                "dt_bias",
+                "normw",
+                "wo_data",
+                "wo_scale",

+        ],
+        qkv.data_ptr(),
+        z.data_ptr(),
+        ba.data_ptr(),
+        core.data_ptr(),

+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    assert harness.health[0].item() == 0
+    if qkv_words == rows * QKVZ:  # tagged (bf16 pair, tag) pairs, z included
+        qkvz = qkv.view(rows, QKVZ // 2, 2)[:, :, 0].contiguous()
+        qkvz = qkvz.view(torch.bfloat16).view(rows, QKVZ)
+        qkv, z = qkvz[:, :CONV_DIM], qkvz[:, CONV_DIM:]

+RIP = 384  # the padded intermediate of a TP2 rank (320 real)

+
+def _moe_kernel(rows, codec="bf16"):
+    import flydsl.compiler as flyc
+    import flydsl.expr as fx
+    from flydsl.expr.typing import Int64
+
+    default_stream = fx.Stream(None)
+
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.common.grid import (
+        Grid,
+        grid_sync,
+        prologue,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.common.ops import ld_i32x4
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.common.plan import (
+        source_digest,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.layout import BLOCKS, THREADS
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.stages import exchange as ex
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.stages import moe, tiled
+
+    digest = source_digest()  # FlyDSL does not hash the stages' sources
+    shape = moe.Shape(rows, RIP)
+    MoeLds = moe.lds_struct(shape)
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class GemmLds:
+        stage: fx.Array[fx.Int32, tiled.stage_words(rows), 16]
+
+    @fx.union
+    class PhaseLds:
+        gemm: GemmLds
+        moe: MoeLds  # type: ignore[valid-type]
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class Smem:
+        word: fx.Array[fx.Int32, 4, 16]
+
+    @flyc.kernel(name=f"t_moe_{rows}_{codec}", known_block_size=[THREADS, 1, 1])
+    def kern(
+        x: Int64,
+        w_gate: Int64,
+        w13: Int64,
+        w13s: Int64,
+        w2: Int64,
+        w2s: Int64,
+        part: Int64,
+        route: Int64,
+        x4: Int64,
+        x4s: Int64,
+        mpart: Int64,
+        mpart2: Int64,
+        flags: Int64,
+        mbox: Int64,
+        epoch: Int64,
+        s0: Int64,
+        s1: Int64,
+        folds: Int64,
+        health: Int64,
+    ):
+        _ = digest
+        tid, bid = fx.thread_idx.x, fx.block_idx.x
+        alloc = fx.SharedAllocator()
+        sm = alloc.allocate(Smem).peek()
+        ph = alloc.allocate(PhaseLds)
+        g = Grid(tid, bid, s0, s1, folds, health, fx.Int64(0), sm.word.ptr)
+        prologue(g)
+        tag = fx.Int32(ld_i32x4(epoch, 0)[0]) * 128 + 9
+        gemm = tiled.Gemm(ph.gemm.peek().stage.ptr, rows, tid)
+        # past the resident widths the router's weights issued ahead, as the
+        # layer kernels do up to ``tiled.PRELOAD_ROWS``
+        pre = None
+        if fx.const_expr(not tiled.resident(rows)):
+            router_w = moe.router_weights(w_gate)
+            pre = tiled.unit_preload(gemm, router_w, moe.router_plan(), g.bid)
+        moe.mlp(
+            g,
+            shape,
+            gemm,
+            ph.moe.peek(),
+            x,
+            moe.Weights(w_gate, w13, w13s, w2, w2s),
+            moe.Bufs(part, route, x4, x4s, mpart, mpart2, flags),
+            ex.Exchange([fx.Int64(mbox)], mbox, 0, 1, 2, tag, rows, codec),
+            lambda name: grid_sync(g),
+            pre,
+        )
+
+    @flyc.jit
+    def launch(
+        x: Int64,
+        w_gate: Int64,
+        w13: Int64,
+        w13s: Int64,
+        w2: Int64,
+        w2s: Int64,
+        part: Int64,
+        route: Int64,
+        x4: Int64,
+        x4s: Int64,
+        mpart: Int64,
+        mpart2: Int64,
+        flags: Int64,
+        mbox: Int64,
+        epoch: Int64,
+        s0: Int64,
+        s1: Int64,
+        folds: Int64,
+        health: Int64,
+        stream: fx.Stream = default_stream,
+    ):
+        _ = digest
+        kern(
+            x,
+            w_gate,
+            w13,
+            w13s,
+            w2,

+            x4s,
+            mpart,
+            mpart2,
+            flags,
+            mbox,
+            epoch,
+            s0,
+            s1,
+            folds,
+            health,
+        ).launch(grid=(BLOCKS,), block=(THREADS,), stream=stream)

+def _expert_weights(gen, experts, rows, k, rows_real, k_real):
+    """MXFP4 experts [experts, rows, k] in AITER's shuffled layouts, zero past
+    ``rows_real`` rows of each half (``rows`` covers two) and past ``k_real``:
+    (data, scales [experts, rows, pad8(k / 32)], dequantized f32)."""
+    codes = torch.randint(0, 16, (experts, rows, k), generator=gen, dtype=torch.uint8)
+    codes[:, :, k_real:] = 0
+    cols = (k // 32 + 7) // 8 * 8
+    sc = torch.full((experts, rows, cols), 127, dtype=torch.uint8)
+    sc[:, :, : k // 32] = torch.randint(
+        118, 124, (experts, rows, k // 32), generator=gen, dtype=torch.uint8
+    )
+    half = rows // 2 if rows_real < rows else rows
+    for h in range(rows // half):
+        codes[:, h * half + rows_real : (h + 1) * half] = 0
+    deq = ref.E2M1[codes.long()] * torch.pow(
+        2.0, sc[:, :, : k // 32].float() - 127
+    ).repeat_interleave(32, -1)
+    packed = codes[..., 0::2] | (codes[..., 1::2] << 4)
+    return (
+        shuffle_data(packed),
+        shuffle_scale(sc.view(experts * rows, cols)).view(experts, rows, cols),
+        deq,
+    )
+
+
+def _routed_inputs(gen, rows, picks):
+    """``x`` and a router gate whose top-k of row ``b`` is ``picks[b]``: each
+    expert has a near-orthogonal direction ``u_e``; a row is the sum of its
+    experts' directions (slightly unequal) plus noise, the gate rows ``2
+    u_e``."""
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.layout import (
+        E_ALL,
+        EXPERTS,
+        HIDDEN,
+    )
+
+    u = torch.randn(EXPERTS, HIDDEN, generator=gen)
+    u = u / u.norm(dim=1, keepdim=True)
+    x = 0.05 * torch.randn(rows, HIDDEN, generator=gen)
+    for b, pick in enumerate(picks):
+        w = 1 + 0.1 * torch.rand(len(pick), 1, generator=gen)
+        x[b] += (u[list(pick)] * w).sum(0) * 4
+    gate = torch.randn(E_ALL, HIDDEN, generator=gen) * 0.05
+    gate[:EXPERTS] = u * 2
+    return x.to(torch.bfloat16), gate.to(torch.bfloat16)
+
+
+def _split_assignments(ids):
+    """The (row, slot) assignments of a step's split units (``moe.pieces``):
+    units are (expert, <= 16 rows) in expert order, and a last round at most
+    half full (every unit below 129 units, so every row of a narrow step)
+    runs as two halves a unit."""
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.layout import (
+        BLOCKS,
+        E_ALL,
+    )
+
+    counts = torch.bincount(ids.flatten().long(), minlength=E_ALL).tolist()
+    sizes = [min(16, c - k) for c in counts for k in range(0, c, 16)]
+    r = len(sizes) % BLOCKS
+    split = r if 0 < r <= BLOCKS // 2 else 0
+    return sum(sizes[len(sizes) - split :])
+
+
+def _skewed_picks(rows, gen):
+    """A real-checkpoint-like B128 routing: 20 hot experts of 24 rows and 280
+    of about 3 (328 units with the shared expert's 8: 72 run as halves)."""
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.layout import TOPK
+
+    left = torch.zeros(512, dtype=torch.long)
+    left[:20] = 24
+    rest = rows * TOPK - 480
+    left[20:300] = rest // 280
+    left[20 : 20 + rest % 280] += 1
+    picks = []
+    for _ in range(rows):
+        pick = torch.topk(left.float() + 1e-3 * torch.rand(512, generator=gen), TOPK)
+        left[pick.indices] -= 1
+        picks.append(pick.indices.tolist())
+    return picks
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "rows, routing, codec",
+    [
+        (32, "random", "bf16"),
+        (128, "random", "bf16"),
+        (32, "hot", "bf16"),
+        (128, "skewed", "bf16"),
+        (128, "random", "int4"),
+    ]
+    + [(w, "random", c) for w in SMALL for c in CODECS]
+    + [(w, "hot", "bf16") for w in (1, 4, 12)],
+)
+def test_moe(harness, rows, routing, codec):
+    """Routing (as sets: bf16 logits tie at the top-k boundary) and weights,
+    then the rows whose routing agrees against the reference's MXFP4
+    activations; at most a few rows may route differently. ``hot`` (every
+    row on the same experts) and ``skewed`` routings run split units as
+    intermediate halves; their marks must be set."""
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.layout import (
+        E_ALL,
+        EXPERTS,
+        HIDDEN,
+        RI,
+        SLOTS,
+        TOPK,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.stages import moe
+
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(3)
+    if routing == "random":
+        x = torch.randn(rows, HIDDEN, generator=gen).to(torch.bfloat16)
+        w_gate = (torch.randn(E_ALL, HIDDEN, generator=gen) * 0.05).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    elif routing == "hot":
+        x, w_gate = _routed_inputs(gen, rows, [list(range(TOPK))] * rows)
+    else:
+        x, w_gate = _routed_inputs(gen, rows, _skewed_picks(rows, gen))
+    w13, w13s, w13d = _expert_weights(gen, E_ALL, 2 * RIP, HIDDEN, RI, HIDDEN)
+    w2, w2s, w2d = _expert_weights(gen, E_ALL, HIDDEN, RIP, HIDDEN, RI)
+    y_r, ids_r, ws_r = ref.moe(x, w_gate, w13d, w2d, EXPERTS, TOPK, RI, RIP)
+
+    d = {
+        n: v.cuda()
+        for n, v in dict(x=x, w_gate=w_gate, w13=w13, w13s=w13s, w2=w2, w2s=w2s).items()
+    }
+    part = torch.zeros(moe.router_plan().partial_words(rows), device="cuda")
+    route = torch.zeros(2 * rows * SLOTS, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    x4 = torch.zeros(rows, HIDDEN // 8, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    x4s = torch.zeros(rows, HIDDEN // 32, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    mpart = torch.zeros(rows * SLOTS, HIDDEN, device="cuda")
+    mpart2 = torch.zeros(rows * SLOTS, HIDDEN, device="cuda")
+    flags = torch.zeros(rows * SLOTS, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    harness.mbox_t.zero_()
+    _moe_kernel(rows, codec)(
+        *[d[n].data_ptr() for n in ("x", "w_gate", "w13", "w13s", "w2", "w2s")],
+        part.data_ptr(),
+        route.data_ptr(),
+        x4.data_ptr(),
+        x4s.data_ptr(),
+        mpart.data_ptr(),
+        mpart2.data_ptr(),
+        flags.data_ptr(),
+        harness.mbox,
+        harness.epoch.data_ptr(),
+        *harness.sync_args(),
+        torch.cuda.current_stream(),
+    )
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    assert harness.health[0].item() == 0
+    ids = route[: rows * SLOTS].view(rows, SLOTS).cpu()
+    ws = route[rows * SLOTS :].view(torch.float32).view(rows, SLOTS).cpu()
+    agree = (torch.sort(ids, 1).values == torch.sort(ids_r.int(), 1).values).all(1)
+    assert agree.float().mean().item() >= 0.85
+    ws_err = (torch.sort(ws, 1).values - torch.sort(ws_r.float(), 1).values).abs()[
+        agree
+    ]
+    assert ws_err.max().item() < 1e-5
+    y = harness.exchange_y(rows, 2, codec).double().cpu()
+    err = ((y - y_r).norm(dim=1) / y_r.norm(dim=1))[agree]
+    if codec == "int4":
+        # the codec's own error: a 16-column group's step is its extremum / 8
+        q_err = (ref.int4_roundtrip(y_r) - y_r).norm(dim=1) / y_r.norm(dim=1)
+        assert err.median().item() < 1.5 * q_err.median().item() + 5e-3
+    else:
+        assert err.median().item() < 5e-3
+        assert err.max().item() < 5e-2
+    tag = harness.epoch[0].item() * 128 + 9
+    marked = (flags == tag).sum().item()
+    if moe.small(rows):  # the small-batch path splits no units (test_moe_small)
+        assert marked == 0
+        return
+    assert marked == _split_assignments(ids)
+    if routing == "random" and rows >= 32:
+        assert marked == 0
+    if routing != "random":
+        assert marked > 0
+    if routing == "hot":
+        assert marked == rows * SLOTS

+class _LazyDequant:
+    """``w[e]``: expert ``e`` of e2m1 ``codes`` / E8M0 ``scales`` dequantized to
+    f32 on first use (a test routes to few of the 513 experts)."""
+
+    def __init__(self, codes, scales, k):
+        self.codes, self.scales, self.k, self.cache = codes, scales, k, {}
+
+    def __getitem__(self, e):
+        if e not in self.cache:
+            sc = self.scales[e][:, : self.k // 32].float()
+            self.cache[e] = ref.E2M1[self.codes[e].long()] * torch.pow(
+                2.0, sc - 127
+            ).repeat_interleave(32, -1)
+        return self.cache[e]
+
+
+def _lazy_expert_weights(gen, experts, rows, k, rows_real, k_real):
+    """``_expert_weights`` with the dequantized copy made per expert on use."""
+    codes = torch.randint(0, 16, (experts, rows, k), generator=gen, dtype=torch.uint8)
+    codes[:, :, k_real:] = 0
+    cols = (k // 32 + 7) // 8 * 8
+    sc = torch.full((experts, rows, cols), 127, dtype=torch.uint8)
+    sc[:, :, : k // 32] = torch.randint(
+        118, 124, (experts, rows, k // 32), generator=gen, dtype=torch.uint8
+    )
+    half = rows // 2 if rows_real < rows else rows
+    for h in range(rows // half):
+        codes[:, h * half + rows_real : (h + 1) * half] = 0
+    packed = codes[..., 0::2] | (codes[..., 1::2] << 4)
+    return (
+        shuffle_data(packed),
+        shuffle_scale(sc.view(experts * rows, cols)).view(experts, rows, cols),
+        _LazyDequant(codes, sc, k),
+    )
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("rows", WIDTHS)
+def test_qsa_sparse_attention(rows):
+    """``wide.attention`` over a strided paged K | V pool against float64
+    softmax attention of each row's tokens: the selected compressed blocks
+    (all of a row's complete blocks in any order up to 512, else 512 of them)
+    and the open tail, from no context to past the 2048-token budget, with a
+    hole (-1) in a list and (from two rows) a padded row (request -1, zero
+    output)."""
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide import attention
+
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(rows)
+    page, heads, hd, top, ratio = 96, 12, 256, 512, 4
+    contexts = [[5001, 0, 1, 37, 2048, 2051, 3003][r % 7] for r in range(rows)]
+    pages_per_row = -(-max(contexts) // page)
+    blocks = rows * pages_per_row + 1
+    stride = page * 2 * hd + 4096  # pages apart in the pool, as vLLM's hybrid pool
+    pool = torch.randn(blocks * stride, generator=gen).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    kv = pool.as_strided((blocks, 1, page, 2 * hd), (stride, page * 2 * hd, 2 * hd, 1))
+    table = (
+        torch.randperm(blocks - 1, generator=gen)[: rows * pages_per_row] + 1
+    ).view(rows, -1)
+    t2r = torch.arange(rows, dtype=torch.int32)
+    pad = 1 if rows > 1 else None
+    if pad is not None:
+        t2r[pad] = -1
+    sel = torch.full((rows, top), -1, dtype=torch.int32)
+    for r, c in enumerate(contexts):
+        sel[r, : min(c // ratio, top)] = torch.randperm(c // ratio, generator=gen)[
+            :top
+        ].int()
+    sel[4 if rows > 4 else 0, 3] = -1  # a hole
+    q = (torch.randn(rows, heads, hd, generator=gen) * 0.5).to(torch.bfloat16)
+
+    expect = torch.zeros(rows, heads, hd, dtype=torch.float64)
+    for r, c in enumerate(contexts):
+        chosen = sel[r][sel[r] >= 0].long()
+        t = torch.cat(
+            [
+                (chosen[:, None] * ratio + torch.arange(ratio)).flatten(),
+                torch.arange(c // ratio * ratio, c),
+            ]
+        )
+        if t2r[r] < 0 or not t.numel():
+            continue
+        rec = kv[table[r][t // page], 0, t % page].double()  # [tokens, 512]
+        k, v = rec[:, :hd], rec[:, hd:]
+        p = torch.softmax(q[r].double() @ k.T / hd**0.5, dim=-1)
+        expect[r] = p @ v
+
+    dev = torch.device("cuda")
+    out = torch.empty(rows, heads, hd, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=dev)
+    attention.sparse_attention(
+        q.to(dev),
+        pool.to(dev).as_strided(kv.shape, kv.stride()),
+        sel.to(dev),
+        table.int().to(dev).contiguous(),
+        t2r.to(dev),
+        torch.tensor(contexts, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev),
+        ratio,
+        out,
+    )
+    if pad is not None:
+        assert out[pad].abs().max().item() == 0
+    assert rel(out.float(), expect) < 1e-2
+
