+def test_qsa_select(rows):
+    """``wide.indexer.score`` with the in-kernel top-k (``selected``) against
+    vLLM's ``top_k_per_row_decode`` on the same scores, compared as sets: a
+    row within the budget lists all of its blocks in order (-1 after) without
+    scoring; a longer row picks stock's 512 but for ties at the boundary
+    (stock's pick among ties is arbitrary; ours takes the lowest blocks), in
+    ascending order. Rows from no context to past the LDS-staged keys
+    (``select.MAX_KEYS``), and a padded row."""
+    from vllm import _custom_ops as ops
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide import indexer, select
+
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(rows)
+    page, heads, dim, ratio, top = 64, 4, 128, 4, 512
+    base = [9001, 0, 3, 2048, 2051, 2120, 37, 6000, 33000, 2600]
+    contexts = [base[r % len(base)] for r in range(rows)]
+    if rows >= 8:
+        # past the LDS-staged keys: the select re-reads the scores
+        contexts[rows // 2] = (select.MAX_KEYS + 300) * ratio
+    width = -(-max(contexts) // page)
+    need = [-(-c // page) for c in contexts]
+    stride = page * dim + 1024
+    pool_pages = sum(need) + 1
+    pool = torch.randn(pool_pages * stride, generator=gen).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    kc = pool.as_strided((pool_pages, page, 1, dim), (stride, dim, dim, 1))
+    order = (torch.randperm(pool_pages - 1, generator=gen) + 1).int()
+    table = torch.full((rows, width), -1, dtype=torch.int32)
+    at = 0
+    for r, n in enumerate(need):
+        table[r, :n] = order[at : at + n]
+        at += n
+    t2r = torch.arange(rows, dtype=torch.int32)
+    if rows > 1:
+        t2r[1] = -1
+    q = torch.randn(rows, heads, dim, generator=gen).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    seq = torch.tensor(contexts, dtype=torch.int32)
+    positions = (seq - 1).clamp(min=0).long()
+
+    dev = torch.device("cuda")
+    args = (
+        q.to(dev),
+        pool.to(dev).as_strided(kc.shape, kc.stride()),
+        table.to(dev),
+        t2r.to(dev),
+        positions.to(dev),
+        seq.to(dev),
+        ratio,
+    )
+    columns = width * page
+    logits = torch.zeros(rows, columns, device=dev)
+    visible = torch.empty(rows, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev)
+    indexer.score(*args, logits, visible)
+    stock = torch.empty(rows, top, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev)
+    ops.top_k_per_row_decode(
+        logits, 1, visible, stock, rows, logits.stride(0), logits.stride(1), top
+    )
+    mine_logits = torch.zeros(rows, columns, device=dev)
+    mine_visible = torch.empty(rows, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev)
+    mine = torch.full((rows, top), -7, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev)
+    for _ in range(2):  # the arrival counters reset themselves
+        indexer.score(*args, mine_logits, mine_visible, selected=mine)
+    assert torch.equal(mine_visible, visible)
+    logits, stock, mine, visible = logits.cpu(), stock.cpu(), mine.cpu(), visible.cpu()
+    for r in range(rows):
+        v = visible[r].item()
+        got = mine[r][mine[r] >= 0]
+        assert torch.equal(got, got.sort().values), r
+        assert (mine[r] >= 0).sum().item() == min(v, top), r
+        assert set(stock[r][stock[r] >= 0].tolist()) <= set(range(v)), r
+        if v <= top:
+            assert torch.equal(mine[r][:v], torch.arange(v, dtype=torch.int32)), r
+            assert (mine[r][v:] == -1).all(), r
+            assert set(stock[r][stock[r] >= 0].tolist()) == set(range(v)), r
+            continue
+        scores = logits[r, :v]
+        ours, theirs = set(got.tolist()), set(stock[r].tolist())
+        boundary = scores[got.long()].min().item()
+        assert scores[stock[r].long()].min().item() == boundary, r
+        # every score above the boundary is in both; they differ only in ties
+        above = set(torch.nonzero(scores > boundary).flatten().tolist())
+        assert above <= ours and above <= theirs, r
+        assert all(scores[i].item() == boundary for i in ours ^ theirs), r
+        ties = torch.nonzero(scores == boundary).flatten()
+        assert torch.equal(
+            got[scores[got.long()] == boundary], ties[: top - len(above)].int()

+def test_qsa_sparse_attention_dense(rows, spread):
+    """``wide.attention`` with ``dense``: a row within the budget attends all
+    of its complete blocks and the tail whatever its list holds; a longer row
+    reads its list as before. ``spread``: every split merges a slice of the
+    output. Twice (the arrival counters reset themselves), against float64
+    softmax attention."""
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide import attention
+
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(100 + rows)
+    page, heads, hd, top, ratio = 96, 12, 256, 512, 4
+    contexts = [[1100, 0, 1, 37, 2048, 2051, 3003, 5001][r % 8] for r in range(rows)]
+    pages_per_row = -(-max(contexts) // page)
+    blocks = rows * pages_per_row + 1
+    stride = page * 2 * hd + 4096
+    pool = torch.randn(blocks * stride, generator=gen).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    kv = pool.as_strided((blocks, 1, page, 2 * hd), (stride, page * 2 * hd, 2 * hd, 1))
+    table = (
+        torch.randperm(blocks - 1, generator=gen)[: rows * pages_per_row] + 1
+    ).view(rows, -1)
+    t2r = torch.arange(rows, dtype=torch.int32)
+    if rows > 1:
+        t2r[1] = -1
+    sel = torch.full((rows, top), -3, dtype=torch.int32)  # unread for short rows
+    for r, c in enumerate(contexts):
+        if c // ratio > top:
+            sel[r] = torch.randperm(c // ratio, generator=gen)[:top].int()
+    if rows > 7:
+        sel[7, 3] = -1  # a hole in a long row's list
+    q = (torch.randn(rows, heads, hd, generator=gen) * 0.5).to(torch.bfloat16)
+
+    expect = torch.zeros(rows, heads, hd, dtype=torch.float64)
+    for r, c in enumerate(contexts):
+        if c // ratio > top:
+            chosen = sel[r][sel[r] >= 0].long()
+        else:
+            chosen = torch.arange(c // ratio)
+        t = torch.cat(
+            [
+                (chosen[:, None] * ratio + torch.arange(ratio)).flatten(),
+                torch.arange(c // ratio * ratio, c),
+            ]
+        )
+        if t2r[r] < 0 or not t.numel():
+            continue
+        rec = kv[table[r][t // page], 0, t % page].double()
+        k, v = rec[:, :hd], rec[:, hd:]
+        p = torch.softmax(q[r].double() @ k.T / hd**0.5, dim=-1)
+        expect[r] = p @ v
+
+    dev = torch.device("cuda")
+    args = (
+        q.to(dev),
+        pool.to(dev).as_strided(kv.shape, kv.stride()),
+        sel.to(dev),
+        table.int().to(dev).contiguous(),
+        t2r.to(dev),
+        torch.tensor(contexts, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev),
+        ratio,
+    )
+    for _ in range(2):
+        out = torch.full((rows, heads, hd), 3.0, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=dev)
+        attention.sparse_attention(*args, out, dense=True, spread=spread)
+        if rows > 1:
+            assert out[1].abs().max().item() == 0
+        assert rel(out.float(), expect) < 1e-2
+

+def _qsa_proj_kernel(rows):
+    import flydsl.compiler as flyc
+    import flydsl.expr as fx
+    from flydsl.expr.typing import Int64
+
+    default_stream = fx.Stream(None)
+
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.common.grid import (
+        Grid,
+        prologue,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.layout import BLOCKS, THREADS
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.stages import qsa, tiled
+
+    chunks = max(qsa.qkv_plan().per, qsa.ix_plan().per)  # a resident unit's K slice
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class Smem:
+        stage: fx.Array[fx.Int32, tiled.stage_words(rows, chunks), 16]
+        word: fx.Array[fx.Int32, 4, 16]
+
+    @flyc.kernel(name=f"t_qsa_proj_{rows}", known_block_size=[THREADS, 1, 1])
+    def kern(
+        x: Int64,
+        w_qkv: Int64,
+        w_ix: Int64,
+        qkv: Int64,
+        ix: Int64,
+        part: Int64,
+        s0: Int64,
+        s1: Int64,
+        folds: Int64,
+        health: Int64,
+    ):
+        tid, bid = fx.thread_idx.x, fx.block_idx.x
+        sm = fx.SharedAllocator().allocate(Smem).peek()
+        g = Grid(tid, bid, s0, s1, folds, health, fx.Int64(0), sm.word.ptr)
+        prologue(g)
+        gemm = tiled.Gemm(sm.stage.ptr, rows, tid, chunks=chunks)
+        qsa.proj(g, gemm, w_qkv, w_ix, x, qkv, ix, part, rows)
+
+    @flyc.jit
+    def launch(
+        x: Int64,
+        w_qkv: Int64,
+        w_ix: Int64,
+        qkv: Int64,
+        ix: Int64,
+        part: Int64,
+        s0: Int64,
+        s1: Int64,
+        folds: Int64,
+        health: Int64,
+        stream: fx.Stream = default_stream,
+    ):
+        kern(x, w_qkv, w_ix, qkv, ix, part, s0, s1, folds, health).launch(
+            grid=(BLOCKS,), block=(THREADS,), stream=stream
+        )
+
+    return launch
+

+        torch.randperm(pages - 1, device="cuda")[: num_requests * table_width] + 1
+    ).to(torch.int32)
+    page_table = page_table.view(num_requests, table_width).contiguous()
+    page_table[2, table_width // 2 :] = -1  # a request whose late pages are unmapped
+    q = torch.randn(num_rows, heads, head_dim, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    token_to_req = torch.arange(num_rows, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32) % 3
+    token_to_req[-1] = -1  # a padding row
+    capacity = table_width * page_size * compress_ratio
+    sequence_lengths = torch.tensor(
+        [capacity, capacity // 3, capacity], device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32
+    )
+    query_positions = torch.randint(
+        0, capacity, (num_rows,), device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32
+    )
+
+    logits, visible = qsa_ops.qsa_mqa_paged(
+        q,
+        k_cache,
+        page_table,
+        token_to_req,
+        query_positions,
+        sequence_lengths,
+        compress_ratio,
+    )
+
+    request = token_to_req.clamp_min(0).long()
+    expected_visible = torch.minimum(
+        (query_positions + 1) // compress_ratio,
+        sequence_lengths[request] // compress_ratio,
+    )
+    expected_visible = torch.where(token_to_req >= 0, expected_visible, 0)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(visible, expected_visible.to(torch.int32))
+    table = page_table[request].long()
+    keys = k_cache[table.clamp_min(0), :, 0, :].flatten(1, 2).float()
+    mapped = (table >= 0).repeat_interleave(page_size, dim=1)
+    scores = torch.einsum("rhd,rnd->rnh", q.float(), keys).relu().sum(-1)
+    reference = torch.where(mapped, scores / math.sqrt(head_dim), -torch.inf)
+    for row in range(num_rows):
+        n = int(visible[row])
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            logits[row, :n], reference[row, :n], rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-4

+# Qwen3.8-Flash-Next specialized decode (wide)
+
+`--monokernel` on MI355X/gfx950 runs each pure decode step of 1 to 128 rows
+of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (`amd/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Quark-MXFP4`) at TP2 as one
+persistent FlyDSL launch per decoder layer (`runtime/decode.py`,
+`wide/layer.py`):
+
+| layer | launches | phases |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| GDN (36) | `gdn` | [stats] attn mix, GDN projection + conv, gated delta rule + gated norm, out_proj + all-reduce + combine, MLP mix, router, routing + MXFP4 quantization, experts, MoE combine + all-reduce + combine |
+| QSA (12) | `qsa_front`, indexer, attention, `qsa_back` | attn mix → x, qkv_proj + index_qk_proj; vLLM's fused prepare, the indexer scores and the top-k select (`wide/indexer.py`, `wide/select.py`); sparse attention on the paged KV (`wide/attention.py`); gated o_proj + all-reduce + combine and the MLP half |
+
+The embedding, the PLE layer, the final mixer, the head and sampling stay
+vLLM's. Steps of a width without a build, prefill and mixed steps run vLLM's
+forward. The kernels are built for each of the deployment's CUDA graph capture
+sizes in 1-128; a decode step runs the smallest captured width that holds it
+(vLLM's graph padding), so capture sizes 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 serve 3 rows at width
+4 and 12 at 16.
+
+The kernels are built from an expert-major fused W4A4 MoE, batch-tiled
+MFMA GEMMs with split-K folded by the last arriver, a line-based in-kernel TP
+exchange and a striped grid barrier, in vLLM's execution model: one launch
+per layer on vLLM's buffers, weights and caches in place, no multi-step
+device loop. Up to 16 rows (`tiled.RESIDENT_MAX`) a GEMM unit stages its whole
+K slice once, and a mix, and the GDN projection through the attention combine,
+each run as one phase whose CTAs hand data over as tagged pairs
+(`wide/stages/tagged.py`) rather than through grid barriers. Up to 12 rows
+(`moe.SMALL_MAX`) the MoE takes a small-batch path: every CTA computes whole
+router logits for its gate rows, each routed or shared expert's gate/up runs
+as pieces of 32 intermediate rows spread over the grid, and 160 CTAs own the
+down projection's output rows and push the exchange lines.
+
+## MoE schedule
+
+A unit is one expert and up to 16 of its rows; its time is one CU's stream
+of the expert's weights (~1.3 MB a rank), whatever its row count. Real
+routing is far from uniform (128 rows of natural text: ~300 distinct experts
+a layer, up to ~80 rows on one; uniform: ~470), so the schedule
+(`wide/stages/moe.py`, `experts`) adapts to the step's distribution:
+
+- units of one expert are consecutive and run on one XCD (runs of 8 rotate
+  over the XCDs), so a hot expert's weights come through one L2;
+- a last round at most half full (for example 300 units on 256 CTAs) runs
+  as two intermediate halves a unit (half the gate/up rows and the down
+  projection's K each, the second half's partial in its own buffer, marked
+  for the combine), so the round ends after about half a unit instead of a
+  whole one.
+
+## Supported
+
+- TP2 on dedicated, unpartitioned GPUs (256 CUs, one CTA per CU), Model
+  Runner V2, FULL CUDA graphs for decode (PIECEWISE steps run vLLM's forward);
+- pure decode of 1-128 rows (graph padding rows are inert: their GDN state
+  slot is the null block);
+- the checkpoint's shapes (`wide/layout.py`, `SHAPES`) and formats: online
+  MXFP4 GDN projections (`--quantization-config.targets` for
+  `linear_attn.in_proj_qkv`, `in_proj_z`, `out_proj`) on either AITER FP4
+  GEMM layout (ASM: shuffled; Triton: row-major, transposed scales),
+  `AITER_MXFP4_MXFP4` experts with `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS=1`
+  (the shared expert is routed expert 512; gate and up padded to any multiple
+  of 128 rows), a BF16 conv state and an FP32 recurrent state with
+  `--no-enable-prefix-caching`.
+
+## Refusals
+
+Default-deny, in three stages, each reporting every reason in one error
+(`runtime/__init__.py`, `runtime/guards.py`): the config (TP other than 2,
+PP, DP, EP, EPLB, DCP, PCP, DBO, HC/MoE sequence parallelism, LoRA, KV
+connectors, routed-expert capture, speculative decoding, sleep mode, CPU
+weight offload, weight updates, GDN prefix caching, other GDN cache dtypes,
+an unfused shared expert, the V1 runner, `STOCK_TORCH_COMPILE`, other model
+shapes, no capture size in 1-128, a platform other than unpartitioned
+gfx950); the loaded model (every layer's modules, quantization methods,
+weight layouts and shapes); the GDN caches at every bind (dtypes, shapes,
+dense slots). The TP ranks agree on every stage.
+
+## Numerics
+
+The stock path's rounding points are kept: bf16 multi-stream state, bf16
+gated-residual GEMM outputs, bf16 router logits, MXFP4 MoE activations and
+intermediate with AITER's scale rule, bf16 GDN projection outputs and core
+output. The online-MXFP4 dense projections run W4A16 (the weights decoded to
+bf16 in registers; stock quantizes the activations to MXFP4 too).
+
+The TP all-reduces follow the deployment's QuickReduce setting
+(`VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION`, which already quantizes the prefill
+all-reduces): with `INT4` (or `INT3`) they send QuickReduce's INT4 codec
+(16-column groups, the group's signed extremum mapped to -8, here with a bf16
+scale so small partials do not flush to zero), 3.2x fewer bytes on the link;
+otherwise they are exact bf16 sums in rank order, as stock's custom
+all-reduce at decode sizes. Every rank decodes every rank's copy, its own
+included, so the ranks agree. The lines are one-shot: each rank quantizes
+its partial once, where QuickReduce's two-shot all-reduce quantizes twice
+(the scattered partials, then the reduced shard); at TP2 two-shot would move
+the same bytes and add a round trip.
+
+## Failure
+
+Every in-kernel wait (grid barrier, TP exchange line) gives up after 10 s:
+the CTA records it in the rank's health words, raises the rank's flag on the
+output rank and sets FAILED, so the launch runs to its end.
+`runtime/guards.FailStop` reads FAILED after every step and the ranks raise
+together every 16 steps.
+
+## Code
+
+- `runtime/`: config refusals and widths (`__init__`), step routing
+  (`routing`), model and cache refusals and `FailStop` (`guards`), the per-rank
+  launch state and the layer launches (`layers`), the executor (`decode`), peer
+  memory (`peer`, as the Kimi-K3 decode's).
+- `wide/`: the build key, ABI and scratch layout (`layer`), the shapes
+  (`layout`), the health words (`abi`); `common/`: device primitives (`ops`),
+  the grid barrier and fold counters (`grid`), build keys (`plan`);
+  `stages/`: the batch-tiled GEMM (`tiled`), the gated residual (`hc`), the
+  gated delta net (`gdn`), the MoE (`moe`), MXFP4 activations (`mx`), the TP
+  exchange (`exchange`).
+
+For profiling, `runtime.layers.TRACE = True` (set in the worker before the
+model is built, for example by a `--worker-extension-cls` module) builds
+every launch with per-phase clock stamps (`Launcher.trace`,
+`wide.layer.phase_names`).
+
+## Toolchain
+
+FlyDSL comes in through AITER; measured with FlyDSL 0.4.0.
+`tests/models/qwen4_exp/amd_specialized_decode/` checks each stage against a
+float64 reference with the stock rounding points.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""The specialized decode's hooks on ``Qwen4ExpForCausalLM``, kept here so the
+model only calls them: ``init_specialized_decode`` in ``__init__`` (the config
+check, before any module allocates weights), then ``plan_specialized_decode``
+and ``run_specialized_decode`` in ``forward`` (and in the multimodal wrapper's
+``forward``, through its language model), and ``after_specialized_decode_step``
+in ``compute_logits``. The model state (``Qwen4ExpModelState``) builds the
+executor after load."""
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.runtime import (
+    DecodeConfig,
+    specialized_decode_config,
+)
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.model import Qwen4ExpModel
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.runtime.decode import (
+        SpecializedDecode,
+        Step,
+    )
+
+
+class SpecializedDecodeMixin:
+    """``self.model`` is the ``Qwen4ExpModel`` the executor runs over."""
+
+    model: "Qwen4ExpModel"
+    specialized_decode_config: DecodeConfig | None
+    specialized_decode: "SpecializedDecode | None"
+
+    def init_specialized_decode(self, vllm_config) -> None:
+        """Raises for ``--monokernel`` on a deployment the kernels cannot
+        serve."""
+        self.specialized_decode_config = specialized_decode_config(vllm_config)
+        self.specialized_decode = None
+
+    def build_specialized_decode(self) -> None:
+        from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.runtime.decode import (
+            SpecializedDecode,
+        )
+
+        assert self.specialized_decode_config is not None
+        self.specialized_decode = SpecializedDecode(
+            self.model, self.specialized_decode_config
+        )
+
+    def plan_specialized_decode(
+        self, input_ids, positions: torch.Tensor, intermediate_tensors
+    ) -> "Step | None":
+        """This step's plan, None for the stock forward."""
+        decode = self.specialized_decode
+        if decode is None:
+            return None
+        return decode.plan(input_ids, positions, intermediate_tensors)
+
+    def after_specialized_decode_step(self) -> None:
+        if self.specialized_decode is not None:
+            self.specialized_decode.after_step()
+
+    def run_specialized_decode(
+        self, step: "Step", input_ids, positions, inputs_embeds, kwargs
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        decode = self.specialized_decode
+        assert decode is not None
+        return decode.run(
+            step,
+            input_ids,
+            positions,
+            inputs_embeds,
+            kwargs.get("query_start_loc"),
+            kwargs.get("ngram_context"),
+        )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Qwen3.8-Flash-Next specialized decode on MI355X (TP2), enabled by
+``--monokernel`` (``KernelConfig.monokernel``).
+
+``specialized_decode_config`` runs in the model's ``__init__``, before the
+weights load. It returns None for the stock decode, and raises with every
+reason from ``unsupported`` when ``--monokernel`` is set for a deployment the
+kernels cannot serve (default-deny). Checks that need the loaded model run when
+the executor is built (``decode.SpecializedDecode``), those that need the GDN
+states at every KV cache bind (``decode.SpecializedDecode.bind_caches``)."""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide import layout as L
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+NAME = "Qwen3.8-Flash-Next specialized decode (--monokernel)"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class DecodeConfig:
+    """``widths``: the step widths (rows) the wide kernels are built for, the
+    deployment's CUDA graph capture sizes in [MIN_TOKENS, MAX_TOKENS]; a step
+    of another width runs vLLM's decode."""
+
+    widths: tuple[int, ...]
+
+
+def decode_widths(vllm_config) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+    sizes = vllm_config.compilation_config.cudagraph_capture_sizes or ()
+    return tuple(sorted(s for s in set(sizes) if L.MIN_TOKENS <= s <= L.MAX_TOKENS))
+
+
+def specialized_decode_config(vllm_config) -> DecodeConfig | None:
+    """The deployment's specialized decode settings, None for the stock decode.
+    Raises when ``--monokernel`` is set for an unsupported deployment, listing
+    every reason."""
+    if not vllm_config.kernel_config.monokernel:
+        return None
+    reasons = unsupported(vllm_config)
+    widths = decode_widths(vllm_config)
+    if not widths:
+        reasons.append(
+            f"no CUDA graph capture size in {L.MIN_TOKENS}-{L.MAX_TOKENS}: the wide "
+            "kernels serve FULL decode graphs of those widths"
+        )
+    if reasons:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"{NAME} does not support: " + "; ".join(reasons) + " (without "
+            "--monokernel, vLLM's decode runs)"
+        )
+    if piecewise_graphs_only(vllm_config):
+        logger.warning(
+            "%s: PIECEWISE-only CUDA graphs capture every decode step as stock; "
+            "use FULL decode graphs",
+            NAME,
+        )
+    return DecodeConfig(widths=widths)
+
+
+def unsupported(vllm_config) -> list[str]:
+    """Every reason this deployment cannot run the specialized decode (empty: it
+    can). Config only: the loaded model is checked when the executor is built.
+    Default-deny: every feature below is refused, the kernels serve none of
+    them."""
+    import torch
+
+    from vllm import envs
+    from vllm.config import CompilationMode
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.mamba.mamba_utils import (
+        MambaStateDtypeCalculator,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.common.hyperconnection import (
+        is_hc_sequence_parallel_enabled,
+    )
+
+    mc, pc, cc = (
+        vllm_config.model_config,
+        vllm_config.parallel_config,
+        vllm_config.cache_config,
+    )
+    oc = vllm_config.offload_config
+    checks = (
+        (
+            pc.tensor_parallel_size != L.TP,
+            f"TP {pc.tensor_parallel_size} (TP{L.TP} only)",
+        ),
+        (pc.pipeline_parallel_size != 1, "pipeline parallelism"),
+        (pc.data_parallel_size != 1, "data parallelism"),
+        (pc.enable_expert_parallel, "expert parallelism"),
+        (pc.enable_eplb, "EPLB"),
+        (pc.decode_context_parallel_size != 1, "decode context parallelism"),
+        (pc.prefill_context_parallel_size != 1, "prefill context parallelism"),
+        # the kernels read one batch's attention metadata per step
+        (pc.use_ubatching, "DBO (dual-batch overlap)"),
+        # the kernels take and return every token row on every rank
+        (
+            is_hc_sequence_parallel_enabled(vllm_config),
+            "sequence parallelism (HC or MoE)",
+        ),
+        (vllm_config.lora_config is not None, "LoRA"),
+        (vllm_config.kv_transfer_config is not None, "KV transfer connectors"),
+        (
+            vllm_config.aux_output_config.enable_return_routed_experts,
+            "routed-expert capture",
+        ),
+        # the kernels read the loaded weights in place
+        (mc.enable_sleep_mode, "sleep mode"),
+        (
+            oc.uva.cpu_offload_gb > 0 or oc.prefetch.offload_group_size > 0,
+            "CPU weight offload",
+        ),
+        (vllm_config.weight_transfer_config is not None, "weight updates"),
+        # the GDN phase runs plain decode rows, one token a request
+        (vllm_config.speculative_config is not None, "speculative decoding"),
+        # the GDN phase reads and writes one state slot a request in place
+        (
+            cc.mamba_cache_mode != "none",
+            (
+                f"GDN prefix caching (mamba_cache_mode {cc.mamba_cache_mode!r}; "
+                "pass --no-enable-prefix-caching)"
+            ),
+        ),
+        (
+            MambaStateDtypeCalculator.gated_delta_net_state_dtype(
+                mc.dtype, cc.mamba_cache_dtype, cc.mamba_ssm_cache_dtype
+            )
+            != (torch.bfloat16, torch.float32),
+            (
+                "GDN cache dtypes other than a BF16 conv state and an FP32 "
+                "recurrent state (mamba cache dtype)"
+            ),
+        ),
+        # the MoE phase runs the shared expert as routed expert 512
+        (
+            not envs.VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS,
+            (
+                "an unfused shared expert (set "
+                "VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS=1)"
+            ),
+        ),
+        # the model state builds the executor and binds it to each KV cache
+        (
+            not vllm_config.use_v2_model_runner,
+            "the V1 model runner (set VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1)",
+        ),
+        # plan() and the launches run in forward; a compiled forward would
+        # trace them
+        (
+            vllm_config.compilation_config.mode == CompilationMode.STOCK_TORCH_COMPILE,
+            "torch.compile (compilation mode STOCK_TORCH_COMPILE)",
+        ),
+    )
+    reasons = [why for bad, why in checks if bad]
+    text = mc.hf_text_config
+    shapes = text_shapes(text)
+    if shapes != L.SHAPES:
+        reasons.append(
+            f"model shapes {shapes} ({', '.join(L.SHAPE_NAMES)}; "
+            f"Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is {L.SHAPES})"
+        )
+    if not getattr(text, "norm_topk_prob", True):
+        reasons.append("router weights without top-k renormalization")
+    gate = getattr(text, "output_gate_type", "sigmoid")
+    if gate != "sigmoid":
+        reasons.append(f"GDN output gate {gate!r} (sigmoid only)")
+    layers = getattr(text, "num_hidden_layers", 0)
+    if layers > L.MAX_LAYERS:
+        reasons.append(f"{layers} decoder layers (at most {L.MAX_LAYERS})")
+    return reasons + platform_reasons()
+
+
+def text_shapes(text) -> tuple:
+    return tuple(getattr(text, name, None) for name in L.SHAPE_NAMES)
+
+
+def platform_reasons() -> list[str]:
+    from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+    if not current_platform.is_rocm():
+        return ["this platform (ROCm only)"]
+    from vllm.platforms.rocm import on_gfx950
+
+    if not on_gfx950():
+        return ["this GPU (gfx950 / MI355X only)"]
+    import torch
+
+    cus = current_platform.num_compute_units(torch.accelerator.current_device_index())
+    if cus != L.BLOCKS:
+        # every CTA of a launch must be resident: a partitioned GPU deadlocks
+        return [f"{cus} CUs (a partitioned GPU; the kernels need {L.BLOCKS})"]
+    return []
+
+
+def piecewise_graphs_only(vllm_config) -> bool:
+    """Decode steps captured as PIECEWISE graphs only: plan() runs them stock."""
+    from vllm.config import CUDAGraphMode
+
+    mode = vllm_config.compilation_config.cudagraph_mode
+    if mode is None or mode == CUDAGraphMode.NONE:
+        return False
+    return mode.decode_mode() != CUDAGraphMode.FULL

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The Qwen3.8-Flash-Next specialized decode executor (step mode): one routing
+decision per step, then the whole forward on the wide kernels.
+
+Built by the model state once the weights are loaded (``Qwen4ExpModelState``):
+checks the loaded model, builds the per-rank launch state (``Launcher``) and
+compiles every kernel build of every width, before memory profiling and graph
+capture. ``bind_caches`` checks the GDN states vLLM binds (the CUDA-graph
+memory-profiling cache, then the real one). Each step ``plan`` returns a
+``Step`` or None, and ``run`` runs a planned step's forward. Weight reloads are
+not supported.
+
+A planned step runs one persistent launch per GDN layer and two per QSA layer
+around vLLM's attention (``wide.layer``):
+
+    GDN layer   gdn        attn mix, GDN, out_proj + all-reduce + combine,
+                           MLP mix, MoE + all-reduce + combine
+    QSA layer   qsa_front  attn mix -> x, qkv_proj + index_qk_proj
+                (vLLM)     QSA attention -> attention output, gate
+                qsa_back   o_proj + all-reduce + combine, MLP half
+
+The PLE layer, the final mixer and the embedding stay vLLM's. The kernels keep
+the multi-stream state materialized (stock defers each combine to the next
+mix, with the same bf16 rounding), so the PLE layer and the final mixer read a
+plain state."""
+
+from typing import Any, NamedTuple
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.distributed import get_tp_group
+from vllm.forward_context import (
+    get_forward_context,
+    in_piecewise_cudagraph,
+    is_forward_context_available,
+)
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.runtime import NAME, DecodeConfig
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.runtime.guards import (
+    FailStop,
+    cache_reasons,
+    model_reasons,
+)
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.runtime.layers import (
+    Launcher,
+    qsa_core,
+)
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.runtime.routing import step_reason
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide import layer as K
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide import layout as L
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.abi import FAILED
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+
+class Step(NamedTuple):
+    """A planned step: ``width`` rows, one decode token a request."""
+
+    width: int
+    attn_metadata: dict[str, Any]  # by layer name
+
+
+def agree(reasons: list[str], group, what: str) -> None:
+    """Raises on every TP rank if any rank has ``reasons``: a rank that refused
+    alone would leave the others spinning in-kernel."""
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.runtime.peer import tp_agree
+
+    if not tp_agree(not reasons, group):
+        why = "; ".join(reasons) if reasons else "another TP rank refused"
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"{NAME} does not support {what}: {why} (without --monokernel, "
+            "vLLM's decode runs)"
+        )
+
+
+class SpecializedDecode:
+    """The executor over one ``Qwen4ExpModel``: builds the launch state, binds
+    it to each KV cache and plans and runs every decode step."""
+
+    def __init__(self, model, config: DecodeConfig):
+        tp = get_tp_group()
+        agree(model_reasons(model, tp.world_size), tp.cpu_group, "the loaded model")
+        self.model, self.config = model, config
+        self.gdn_prefix = next(
+            ly.linear_attn.prefix
+            for ly in model.layers
+            if ly.layer_type == "linear_attention"
+        )
+        dev = model.embed_tokens.weight.device
+        self.launch = Launcher(
+            model, config.widths, tp.world_size, tp.rank_in_group, tp.cpu_group, dev
+        )
+        builds = sorted({k for s in config.widths for k in self._keys(s)}, key=repr)
+        for key in builds:
+            K.compile_only(key)
+        self.failstop = FailStop(
+            self.launch.health[FAILED : FAILED + 1],
+            tp.rank_in_group,
+            tp.world_size,
+            tp.cpu_group,
+        )
+        self._kv: tuple[int, int] | None = None
+        self.steps = 0
+        # the epoch at the last LOG_EVERY step, copied without blocking
+        self.counted = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int32, pin_memory=True)
+        self.counted_event: torch.cuda.Event | None = None
+        self.counted_at = 0
+        logger.info(
+            "%s: %d layers, widths %s, %d builds, %d launches a step, %s TP "
+            "all-reduce lines; other steps run vLLM's decode",
+            NAME,
+            len(model.layers),
+            ",".join(map(str, config.widths)),
+            len(builds),
+            self.launch.launches,
+            self.launch.allreduce,
+        )
+
+    def _keys(self, rows: int) -> list:
+        """Every layer's builds at ``rows``, in step order."""
+        out, stats = [], True
+        for layer in self.model.layers:
+            stats |= layer.ple is not None
+            out += self.launch.keys(layer, rows, stats)
+            stats = False
+        return out
+
+    def _kv_key(self) -> tuple[int, int] | None:
+        layer = next(
+            ly for ly in self.model.layers if ly.layer_type == "linear_attention"
+        )
+        state = layer.linear_attn.kv_cache
+        if not isinstance(state, (list, tuple)) or len(state) != 2:
+            return None
+        if state[1].numel() == 0:
+            return None
+        return state[1].data_ptr(), state[1].numel()
+
+    def bind_caches(self) -> None:
+        """Checks the GDN states vLLM just bound (the CUDA-graph memory
+        profiling cache, then the real one) and binds them."""
+        self._kv = None
+        if self._kv_key() is None:
+            return
+        tp = get_tp_group()
+        agree(cache_reasons(self.model, tp.world_size), tp.cpu_group, "the KV caches")
+        self.launch.bind_caches()
+        self._kv = self._kv_key()
+
+    def plan(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor | None,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        intermediate_tensors,
+    ) -> Step | None:
+        """This step's plan, or None to run vLLM's forward.
+
+        Steps that run vLLM's forward:
+        - pipeline-parallel stage inputs, and steps before a KV cache is bound
+          (profiling, dummy runs);
+        - PIECEWISE steps: they run (or capture) the compiled stock model's
+          graphs, and taking one would leave them uncaptured for the prefills
+          of that size;
+        - widths without a build (``DecodeConfig.widths``);
+        - steps that are not pure decode steps (``step_reason``).
+
+        Eager steps of a built width run the kernels too. Every predicate is the
+        same on all TP ranks: the kernels' exchanges need every rank on one
+        path. Under FULL graphs this runs at capture only and the plan is baked
+        in; a replay with fewer requests than its graph pads rows with
+        NULL_BLOCK_ID state slots, whose GDN state the kernels leave alone."""
+        if intermediate_tensors is not None or self._kv is None or input_ids is None:
+            return None
+        if not is_forward_context_available() or in_piecewise_cudagraph():
+            return None
+        width = input_ids.size(0)
+        if width not in self.config.widths:
+            return None
+        md = get_forward_context().attn_metadata
+        if step_reason(md, self.gdn_prefix, width) is not None:
+            return None
+        assert isinstance(md, dict)
+        if self._kv_key() != self._kv:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"{NAME}: the KV cache was re-bound without bind_caches "
+                "(ModelState.initialize_kv_cache)"
+            )
+        logger.info_once("%s: first specialized step (%d rows)", NAME, width)
+        return Step(width, md)
+
+    def run(
+        self,
+        step: Step,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        inputs_embeds: torch.Tensor | None,
+        query_start_loc: torch.Tensor | None,
+        ngram_context: torch.Tensor | None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """``Qwen4ExpModel.forward`` of a planned step -> the final mixer's
+        hidden states [S, H]. ``inputs_embeds``: the multimodal wrapper's
+        embeddings of the step's tokens (decode rows are sampled text tokens,
+        so the token embeddings), else None."""
+        model, la, md, rows = self.model, self.launch, step.attn_metadata, step.width
+        la.epoch.add_(1)
+        if inputs_embeds is None:
+            inputs_embeds = model.embed_input_ids(input_ids)
+        state = inputs_embeds.repeat(1, L.HC)
+        x = la.x[:rows]
+        seq, stats = 0, True
+        for i, layer in enumerate(model.layers):
+            if layer.ple is not None:
+                state = layer.ple(state, input_ids, query_start_loc, ngram_context)
+                stats = True
+            keys = la.keys(layer, rows, stats)
+            dyn = {"state": state, "x": x}
+            if layer.layer_type == "linear_attention":
+                dyn["st_idx"] = md[
+                    layer.linear_attn.prefix
+                ].non_spec_state_indices_tensor
+                seq = la.launch(keys[0], i, seq, dyn)
+            else:
+                seq = la.launch(keys[0], i, seq, dyn)
+                attn, gate = qsa_core(
+                    layer.self_attn, x, la.qkv[:rows], la.ixqk[:rows], positions
+                )
+                seq = la.launch(keys[1], i, seq, dyn | {"attn": attn, "gate": gate})
+            stats = False
+        _, h, _ = model.hyper_connection_mixer.mix(state)
+        return h
+
+    LOG_EVERY = 1024
+
+    def after_step(self) -> None:
+        """Once per executed step, from compute_logits (eager on every rank,
+        also under graph replay). Raises on every rank once a rank gave up an
+        in-kernel wait; every LOG_EVERY steps logs how many of the steps up to
+        the previous LOG_EVERY ran on the kernels (the epoch counts
+        specialized steps, graph replays included; copied without a host
+        sync, so the count trails by LOG_EVERY steps)."""
+        self.failstop.after_step()
+        if torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():
+            return
+        self.steps += 1
+        if self.steps % self.LOG_EVERY:
+            return
+        if self.counted_event is not None and self.counted_event.query():
+            logger.info(
+                "%s: %d specialized steps of %d",
+                NAME,
+                int(self.counted[0]),
+                self.counted_at,
+            )
+        self.counted.copy_(self.launch.epoch[:1], non_blocking=True)
+        self.counted_event = torch.cuda.Event()
+        self.counted_event.record()
+        self.counted_at = self.steps

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The refusals that need the loaded model (``model_reasons``: the module
+variants and every weight's dtype and layout as the kernels read it in place)
+and the GDN states vLLM binds (``cache_reasons``), each listing every reason;
+and ``FailStop``, which stops the engine once an in-kernel wait gave up."""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.mamba.mamba_utils import is_conv_state_dim_first
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.runtime import NAME
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide import layout as L
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.stages import qsa
+
+FP4 = (torch.uint8, torch.float4_e2m1fn_x2)
+
+
+def mxfp4_shuffled(linear) -> bool | None:
+    """An online-MXFP4 linear on AITER's FP4 GEMMs: True with its weight and
+    scales shuffled for the ASM FP4 GEMM, False row-major with transposed
+    scales for the Triton FP4 GEMM (AITER picks per shape); None otherwise."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.mxfp4.aiter import AiterMxfp4LinearKernel
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.online.mxfp4 import (
+        Mxfp4OnlineLinearMethod,
+    )
+
+    qm = linear.quant_method
+    if not (
+        isinstance(qm, Mxfp4OnlineLinearMethod)
+        and isinstance(qm.kernel, AiterMxfp4LinearKernel)
+    ):
+        return None
+    return bool(qm.kernel.use_asm_gemm)
+
+
+def fp4_scale_shape(rows: int, k: int, shuffled: bool) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    cols = k // 32
+    return (rows, (cols + 7) // 8 * 8) if shuffled else (cols, rows)
+
+
+def _fp4_reasons(name: str, linear, rows: int, k: int) -> list[str]:
+    shuffled = mxfp4_shuffled(linear)
+    if shuffled is None:
+        return [f"{name} not online MXFP4 on AITER's FP4 GEMMs"]
+    w, ws = linear.weight, linear.weight_scale
+    if tuple(w.shape) != (rows, k // 2) or w.dtype not in FP4 or not w.is_contiguous():
+        return [f"{name} {tuple(w.shape)} {w.dtype}"]
+    if (
+        tuple(ws.shape) != fp4_scale_shape(rows, k, shuffled)
+        or ws.element_size() != 1
+        or not ws.is_contiguous()
+    ):
+        return [f"{name} scales {tuple(ws.shape)} {ws.dtype}"]
+    return []
+
+
+def gdn_states(attn) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """A GDN layer's (conv state [slots, 3, CONV_DIM], recurrent state [slots,
+    NV, DV, DK]) as vLLM binds them (slot strides as they come)."""
+    conv_state, rstate = attn.kv_cache
+    return conv_state, rstate
+
+
+def router_gate(mlp) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The router gate with the shared expert's gate as its last row, [E + 1,
+    HIDDEN] bf16: the MoE runner's own fused copy (the stock fused shared
+    expert path routes with it), made here if it does not exist yet."""
+    runner = mlp.experts
+    if getattr(runner, "_fse_fuse_gate", False):
+        if runner._combined_gate_weight is None:
+            # The loader fuses it (process_weights_after_loading, vllm#64692);
+            # before #64692 the runner fused it on first use.
+            fuse = getattr(runner, "process_weights_after_loading", None)
+            (fuse or runner._maybe_fuse_gate_weights)()
+        return runner._combined_gate_weight
+    return torch.cat([mlp.gate.weight, mlp.shared_expert_gate.weight], 0).contiguous()
+
+
+def experts_rip(mlp) -> int:
+    return mlp.experts.routed_experts.w13_weight.shape[1] // 2
+
+
+def _compact(idx: list[int]) -> str:
+    """[0, 1, 2, 5] -> '0-2, 5'."""
+    runs: list[list[int]] = []
+    for i in idx:
+        if runs and i == runs[-1][1] + 1:
+            runs[-1][1] = i
+        else:
+            runs.append([i, i])

+class FailStop:
+    """Stops every TP rank at the same step once any of them gave up an in-kernel
+    wait (its health word FAILED, ``wide.abi``). Each step queues a D2H copy of
+    this rank's word and keeps the newest copy that has landed, without blocking;
+    every CHECK_EVERY steps the ranks agree on those over the TP CPU group and all
+    raise together. A rank that raised alone would leave the others in the next
+    collective for ever. A failure is seen within about CHECK_EVERY steps."""
+

+
+    def __init__(self, failed: torch.Tensor, rank: int, world: int, group):
+        self.failed, self.rank, self.world, self.group = failed, rank, world, group
+        self.host = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int32, pin_memory=True)
+        self.copied: torch.cuda.Event | None = None
+        self.seen = False
+        self.steps = 0
+
+    def after_step(self) -> None:
+        """Once per step on every TP rank (compute_logits, itself collective)."""
+        if torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():

+        votes[self.rank] = int(self.seen)
+        torch.distributed.all_reduce(votes, group=self.group)
+        if votes.any():
+            ranks = [r for r, v in enumerate(votes.tolist()) if v]
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"{NAME}: TP ranks {ranks} gave up an in-kernel wait; stopping the "

+def qsa_core(attn, x, qkv, ixqk, positions) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """``Qwen4ExpQSAAttention.forward`` up to the output gate (the qsa_back
+    launch applies it to o_proj's input) -> (attention output [S, heads HD],
+    gate [S, heads HD]). ``qkv`` and ``ixqk``: ``attn.qkv_proj(x)`` and
+    ``attn.indexer.index_qk_proj(x)`` (qsa_front's projections). The wide
+    indexer launch runs vLLM's fused prepare (the queries, the gate, the K/V
+    and indexer caches; ``indexer.Prep``), scores the compressed blocks and
+    selects them (the decode top-k's set; a row within the budget takes all
+    of its blocks unscored), and ``wide.attention`` attends their tokens in
+    place (other cache formats run vLLM's whole QSA; other ropes or metadata
+    vLLM's prepare)."""
+    from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd import qsa
+
+    n = x.shape[0]
+    name = qsa._encode_layer_name(attn.layer_name)
+    out = qkv.new_empty(n, attn.num_heads, attn.head_dim)
+    gate = torch.empty_like(out)
+    if _wide_qsa(attn):
+        ix = attn.indexer
+        md = get_forward_context().attn_metadata
+        main = cast(Qwen4ExpQSAMetadata, md[attn.layer_name])
+        raw = cast(QSAIndexerMetadata, md[ix.raw_key_cache.prefix])
+        comp = cast(QSAIndexerMetadata, md[ix.compressed_key_cache.prefix])
+        rows = raw.num_actual_tokens
+        query = torch.empty_like(out)
+        prep = _prep(attn, rows, qkv, ixqk, query, gate, positions, main, raw, comp)
+        q_ix = None
+        if prep is None:
+            q_raw, raw_keys = ixqk[:rows].split(
+                (ix.index_n_heads * ix.index_head_dim, ix.index_head_dim), dim=-1
+            )
+            q_ix, (query, _) = ix._fused_prepare(
+                q_raw,
+                raw_keys,
+                positions[..., :rows],
+                raw,
+                comp,
+                attn,
+                qkv,
+                main.slot_mapping,
+                gate,
+            )
+        keys = ix.compressed_key_cache.kv_cache
+        top = ix.token_topk // ix.compress_ratio
+        logits, visible, blocks = _select_buffers(
+            n, comp.block_table.shape[1] * keys.shape[1], top, x.device
+        )
+        logits, visible, blocks = logits[:rows], visible[:rows], blocks[:rows]
+        token_to_req = comp.token_to_req[:rows]
+        indexer.score(
+            q_ix,
+            keys,
+            comp.block_table,
+            token_to_req,
+            comp.logical_positions[:rows],
+            comp.seq_lens,
+            ix.compress_ratio,
+            logits,
+            visible,
+            selected=blocks,
+            prep=prep,
+        )
+        attention.sparse_attention(
+            query[:rows],
+            attn.kv_cache,
+            blocks,
+            main.block_table,
+            token_to_req,
+            comp.seq_lens,
+            ix.compress_ratio,
+            out[:rows],
+            dense=True,
+        )
+        if rows < n:
+            # padded rows: zero output, as vLLM's attention leaves them
+            out[rows:].zero_()
+            gate[rows:].zero_()
+    elif current_platform.opaque_attention_op():
+        torch.ops.vllm.qwen4_exp_qsa_prepare_with_output(
+            x, positions, qkv, out, gate, name
+        )
+    else:
+        qsa.qwen4_exp_qsa_prepare_with_output(x, positions, qkv, out, gate, name)
+    return out.view(n, -1), gate.view(n, -1)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+# Copied from the Kimi-K3 decode's ``runtime/peer.py`` (adapted from ROCm/ATOM
+# a526f0d, MIT License, Copyright (C) 2026, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.).
+"""Peer memory for in-kernel TP collectives: one uncached buffer a rank, every
+rank holding every peer's address, and the TP agreements that must precede
+anything collective."""
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+
+class _DeviceBytes:
+    """``__cuda_array_interface__`` of ``nbytes`` bytes at a raw device address, for a
+    non-owning torch view."""
+
+    def __init__(self, ptr: int, nbytes: int):
+        self.__cuda_array_interface__ = {
+            "shape": (nbytes,),
+            "typestr": "|u1",
+            "data": (ptr, False),
+            "version": 3,
+        }
+
+
+class PeerBuffer:
+    """One uncached buffer per rank, every rank holding every peer's address
+    (``addresses``, int64, indexed by TP rank). What lives where, and why no rank
+    overwrites a peer's unread data, is the model's layout's to say.
+
+    ``bytes`` is the whole buffer: the kernels tag every pair with the step's
+    epoch, so it is never zeroed between steps.
+
+    The constructor is collective over ``group`` (the handle exchange, then an
+    agreement that every rank mapped every peer): every rank must reach it, so a
+    runner reaches it only after ``tp_agree``. A failed mapping on any rank raises
+    ``RuntimeError`` on all of them.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        nbytes: int,
+        group,
+        rank: int,
+        npes: int,
+        device: torch.device,
+    ):
+        from aiter.ops.flydsl.quick_allreduce_int4_ipc import UncachedIpcHeap
+
+        self._heap = UncachedIpcHeap
+        self.local = UncachedIpcHeap.alloc_uncached(nbytes)
+        # a view, not an owner: close() frees the memory under it
+        self.bytes = torch.as_tensor(_DeviceBytes(self.local, nbytes), device=device)
+        self.rank = rank
+        self._opened: list[int] = []
+        addresses = [self.local]
+        if npes > 1:
+            handles = UncachedIpcHeap.gather_object_list_via_broadcast(
+                group, UncachedIpcHeap.get_mem_handle_bytes(self.local)
+            )
+            addresses, failure = [], None
+            try:
+                for peer, handle in enumerate(handles):
+                    if peer == rank:
+                        addresses.append(self.local)
+                    else:
+                        base = UncachedIpcHeap.open_mem_handle(handle)
+                        self._opened.append(base)
+                        addresses.append(base)
+            except RuntimeError as err:  # every rank must still reach the agreement
+                failure = err
+            if not tp_agree(failure is None, group):
+                self.close()
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    "peer memory handshake failed on "
+                    f"{'this' if failure else 'another'}"
+                    " TP rank"
+                ) from failure
+        self.addresses = torch.tensor(addresses, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        """Close the peer mappings and free the local buffer; idempotent. Only once no
+        kernel of any rank can still touch it (the runner is being dropped)."""
+        opened, self._opened = self._opened, []
+        for base in opened:
+            self._heap.close_mem_handle(base)
+        if self.local:
+            self.bytes = None
+            self._heap.free_device_mem(self.local)
+            self.local = 0
+
+
+# Decisions every TP rank must take alike.
+#
+# A mono kernel waits in-kernel on every peer rank, so a rank that turned mono off
+# alone -- or failed to build what the others launch -- leaves the others spinning
+# on the GPU for ever. Each such decision is a local verdict agreed on over the TP
+# group's CPU group before anything collective (peer handshake, launch) follows.
+#
+
+
+def tp_agree(ok: bool, group) -> bool:
+    """True when every rank of ``group`` passed ``ok`` true. Every rank must call
+    it at the same point; ``group`` is a CPU (gloo) process group, or None for a
+    single rank."""
+    if group is None:
+        return ok
+    flag = torch.tensor([int(ok)], dtype=torch.int32)
+    dist.all_reduce(flag, op=dist.ReduceOp.MIN, group=group)
+    return bool(flag.item())

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Which decode steps the kernels take, from the step's attention metadata
+alone (no kernel imports: the host tests run it without a GPU)."""
+
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+
+
+def step_reason(attn_metadata, gdn_prefix: str, width: int) -> str | None:
+    """None if a step's GDN metadata (identical on every TP rank) is a pure
+    decode step of one token a request whose state indices cover ``width``
+    rows, else why not."""
+    if not isinstance(attn_metadata, dict):
+        return "no metadata"
+    m: Any = attn_metadata.get(gdn_prefix)
+    if m is None or m.num_prefills != 0:
+        return "not pure decode"
+    if m.spec_sequence_masks is not None or m.num_spec_decodes != 0:
+        return "spec-verify"
+    if m.num_decodes < 1:
+        return "no decode"
+    idx = m.non_spec_state_indices_tensor
+    # a graph's pad rows read NULL_BLOCK_ID entries: the indices cover every row
+    if idx is None or idx.dtype != torch.int32:
+        return "no int32 state indices"
+    if idx.numel() < width or not idx.is_contiguous():
+        return "state indices do not cover the rows"
+    return None

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The words the kernels and the host share outside the kernels' arguments.
+
+A rank's health words: word FAILED is set once any in-kernel wait of the rank
+gave up (sticky: its later waits exit at once, so a failed step runs to its
+end), then a record a CTA of the first wait it gave up on: flag, site, the
+counter or flag seen, the target, CTA, clock.
+
+The output rank's flags: one int32 word a TP rank in the first PEER_HEAD bytes
+of rank 0's peer buffer. A rank whose wait gives up raises its word there and
+drains the store before it sets FAILED. ``runtime.guards.FailStop`` reads
+them after every step.
+"""
+
+RECORD_WORDS = 8
+FAILED = 0
+PEER_HEAD = 256  # bytes: the output rank's flags, a word a rank
+WAIT_SECONDS = 10  # an in-kernel wait gives up after this long
+WAIT_TICKS = WAIT_SECONDS * 100_000_000  # s_memrealtime ticks at 100 MHz
+
+# wait sites a record names
+SITE_GRID = 1  # a grid barrier
+SITE_PEER = 2  # a TP exchange line
+SITE_FOLD = 3  # a split-K fold's arrival count
+
+
+def health_words(ctas: int) -> int:
+    """A rank's health words for a grid of ``ctas``: the header, a record a CTA."""
+    return (ctas + 1) * RECORD_WORDS

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""QSA sparse attention of a decode batch over vLLM's paged K/V cache.
+
+A row attends to the tokens of the compressed blocks its indexer selected
+(``sel``: [rows, top_blocks] the top-k's block indices; all of them while
+the row has at most ``top_blocks``), each block ``ratio`` tokens, then to
+the open tail of its last incomplete block: the list the stock expansion
+builds. ``splits`` CTAs a row each attend a contiguous range of the list's
+64-token stages:
+
+* The CTA first expands its tokens and translates them through the block
+  table into an LDS table of byte offsets into the cache (-1: not
+  attended), every load issued before the first use.
+* A stage is 16 tokens a wave. The wave multiplies their keys with the kv
+  head's queries on the matrix unit (``S^T = K Q^T``, 16x16x32) and keeps a
+  running max, sum and full-width output of its own (``O^T += V^T P^T``,
+  16x16x16, V read transposed from LDS), with the next stage's K and V loads
+  in flight while it computes. The softmax is wave-private: the bounds of a
+  joint one, not its reduction order.
+* The four waves merge through LDS; with several splits, each stores its
+  partial and the row's last-arriving CTA merges them in the ``exp2`` domain
+  and resets the row's counter for the next launch. With ``spread`` (four
+  splits a row or more, the small batches) every split instead waits until
+  the row's splits have all arrived and merges its own slice of the output
+  (one CTA reading every partial is the slowest part of a short row).
+
+The kernel reads the cache in place: a token's K and V are one 1 KiB record
+(``[blocks, kv heads, block_size, 2 head_dim]``, one kv head on a rank), pages
+any stride apart. Rows past the batch's requests (``token_to_req`` out of
+range) output zeros, like the stock kernel.
+"""
+
+import math
+from dataclasses import astuple, dataclass
+
+import flydsl.compiler as flyc
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+import torch
+from flydsl.expr import const_expr, range_constexpr
+from flydsl.expr.typing import Int32, Int64
+
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.abi import WAIT_TICKS
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.common.ops import (
+    CM_DEV,
+    LOG2E,
+    atomic_add,
+    drain_stores,
+    gld,
+    hw_exp2,
+    hw_rcp,
+    ld,
+    lds_ld,
+    lds_ld_tr16,
+    lds_st,
+    memrealtime,
+    mfma_bf16,
+    mfma_bf16_k16,
+    pack_bf16,
+    st,
+    traced,
+    uniform,
+    zeros,
+)
+
+i32 = fx.Int32
+f32 = fx.Float32
+
+THREADS = 256
+WAVES = THREADS // 64
+HEAD_DIM = 256
+STAGE = 64  # tokens a CTA stages at a time, 16 a wave
+COLS = 16  # query-head columns of the matrix instruction
+RECORD = 2 * HEAD_DIM * 2  # bytes of a token's K | V
+NEG = -1e30
+COUNTER_WORDS = 16  # one 64-byte line a row's arrival counter
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class AttnBuild:
+    rows: int
+    splits: int
+    page: int  # tokens a cache block
+    top_blocks: int  # the selection's blocks a row
+    group: int  # query heads a kv head
+    ratio: int  # the indexer's compression ratio
+    # a row with at most ``top_blocks`` complete blocks attends all of them
+    # without reading ``sel`` (the selection stock would make, in order)
+    dense: bool = False
+    # every split merges a slice of the row's output once all have arrived
+    # (else the last to arrive merges all of it)
+    spread: bool = False
+
+
+def splits_for(rows: int) -> int:
+    """CTAs a row: the 256 CUs shared by the rows, at most 16."""
+    return max(1, min(16, 1 << max(0, (256 // max(rows, 1)).bit_length() - 1)))
+
+
+def _stages(key: AttnBuild) -> int:
+    """Stages of the longest split, plus the one the last stage prefetches."""
+    total = -(-(key.top_blocks * key.ratio + key.ratio - 1) // STAGE)
+    return -(-total // key.splits) + 1
+
+
+def _table_rounds(key: AttnBuild) -> int:
+    return -(-_stages(key) * STAGE // THREADS)
+
+
+_BUILDS: dict = {}
+_STREAM = fx.Stream(None)
+
+
+def build(key: AttnBuild):
+    if key in _BUILDS:
+        return _BUILDS[key]
+    assert key.group <= COLS
+    rounds = _table_rounds(key)
+    tbl_words = 2 * rounds * THREADS
+    splits, group = key.splits, key.group
+    top_blocks, ratio = key.top_blocks, key.ratio
+    scale = LOG2E / math.sqrt(HEAD_DIM)
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class Lds:
+        # V stages (bf16 [wave][32 dim chunks][16 tokens][8]), then the waves'
+        # outputs (f32 [wave][16 heads][head_dim])
+        big: fx.Array[fx.Int32, WAVES * COLS * HEAD_DIM, 16]
+        aux: fx.Array[fx.Int32, 2 * WAVES * COLS + 4, 16]
+        tbl: fx.Array[fx.Int32, tbl_words, 16]
+
+    name = f"q4w_qsa_attn_s{key.rows}_x{splits}" + ("_d" if key.dense else "")
+    name += "_m" if key.spread else ""
+    # FlyDSL keys its compile cache on closure scalars and tuples, not on the
+    # dataclass: both functions reference the key's fields
+    keyed = astuple(key)
+
+    @flyc.kernel(name=name, known_block_size=[THREADS, 1, 1])
+    def kernel(
+        q: Int64,
+        kv: Int64,
+        page_bytes: Int64,
+        sel: Int64,
+        sel_stride: Int32,
+        bt: Int64,
+        bt_stride: Int32,
+        bt_width: Int32,
+        reqs: Int32,
+        token_to_req: Int64,
+        seq_lens: Int64,
+        out: Int64,
+        part: Int64,
+        counters: Int64,
+    ):
+        _ = keyed
+        tid = i32(fx.thread_idx.x)
+        bid = i32(fx.block_idx.x)
+        alloc = fx.SharedAllocator()
+        sm = alloc.allocate(Lds).peek()
+        vbuf = fx.recast_iter(fx.BFloat16, sm.big.ptr)
+        obuf = fx.recast_iter(fx.Float32, sm.big.ptr)
+        aux = fx.recast_iter(fx.Float32, sm.aux.ptr)
+        verdict = sm.aux.ptr + 2 * WAVES * COLS
+        tbl = fx.recast_iter(fx.Int64, sm.tbl.ptr)
+        lane, wave = tid % 64, tid // 64
+        n, g = lane % 16, lane // 16
+        row, member = bid // splits, bid % splits
+
+        req = uniform(ld(token_to_req, row, Int32))
+        live = (req >= 0) & (req < reqs)
+        req = live.select(req, i32(0))
+        seq = live.select(uniform(ld(seq_lens, req, Int32)), i32(0))
+        # the list: ``blocks`` selected blocks, then the open tail
+        complete = seq // ratio
+        blocks = (complete < top_blocks).select(complete, i32(top_blocks))
+        expanded = blocks * ratio
+        count = expanded + seq % ratio
+        total = (count + STAGE - 1) // STAGE
+        s0 = member * total // splits
+        local = (member + 1) * total // splits - s0
+
+        # the split's token positions, then their byte offsets
+        first = s0 * STAGE
+        selected = []
+        listed = None
+        sel_bytes = None
+        if const_expr(key.dense):
+            listed = complete > i32(top_blocks)
+            sel_bytes = i32(key.rows) * sel_stride * i32(4)
+        for r in range_constexpr(rounds):
+            j = first + tid + r * THREADS
+            bi = (j < expanded).select(j // ratio, i32(0))
+            if const_expr(key.dense):
+                # a short row's list is its blocks in order: no load (masked)
+                v = ld(sel, row * sel_stride + bi, Int32, nbytes=sel_bytes, mask=listed)
+                selected.append(listed.select(v, bi))  # type: ignore[union-attr]
+            else:
+                selected.append(ld(sel, row * sel_stride + bi, Int32))
+        pos = []
+        for r in range_constexpr(rounds):
+            j = first + tid + r * THREADS
+            in_blocks = j < expanded
+            tok = in_blocks.select(
+                selected[r] * ratio + j % ratio, complete * ratio + j - expanded
+            )
+            keep = (
+                (j < count)
+                & (tok >= 0)
+                & (tok < seq)
+                & (in_blocks.select(selected[r], i32(0)) >= 0)
+            )
+            pos.append(keep.select(tok, i32(-1)))
+        pages = []
+        for r in range_constexpr(rounds):
+            slot = (pos[r] >= 0).select(pos[r] // key.page, i32(0))
+            slot = (slot < bt_width).select(slot, bt_width - 1)
+            pages.append(ld(bt, req * bt_stride + slot, Int32))
+        for r in range_constexpr(rounds):
+            mapped = (pos[r] >= 0) & (pages[r] >= 0)
+            record = Int64(pages[r]) * page_bytes + Int64(pos[r] % key.page) * Int64(
+                RECORD
+            )
+            lds_st(tbl + tid + r * THREADS, mapped.select(record, Int64(-1)))
+        fx.barrier()
+
+        head = (n < group).select(n, i32(group - 1))
+        qrow = (row * group + head) * (HEAD_DIM // 2)
+        qs = [
+            ld(q, qrow + k * 16 + g * 4, Int32, 4).bitcast(fx.BFloat16)
+            for k in range(8)
+        ]
+
+        def kv_loads(s):
+            """Stage ``s``'s K and V of the lane's token (``n``): the 32-dim
+            steps' 8 dims of the lane's quarter (``g``), as stored."""
+            off = lds_ld(tbl + s * STAGE + wave * 16 + n)
+            # past the split (the last stage's prefetch) or no token: the
+            # cache's first record, one hot line for every lane
+            ok = (s < local) & (off >= 0)
+            at = kv + ok.select(off, Int64(0)) + Int64(g * 16)
+            return [gld(at + Int64(k * 64), Int32, 4) for k in range(8)] + [
+                gld(at + Int64(HEAD_DIM * 2 + k * 64), Int32, 4) for k in range(8)
+            ]
+
+        current = kv_loads(i32(0))
+        top, den = f32(NEG), f32(0.0)
+        acc = [zeros(4) for _ in range(16)]
+        for s in range(i32(0), local, i32(1)):
+            pending = kv_loads(s + 1)
+            scores = zeros(4)
+            mine = lds_ld(tbl + s * STAGE + wave * 16 + n) >= 0
+            for k in range_constexpr(8):
+                scores = mfma_bf16(current[k].bitcast(fx.BFloat16), qs[k], scores)
+                v = mine.select(current[8 + k], zeros(4, Int32))
+                lds_st(
+                    vbuf + wave * 4096 + (4 * k + g) * 128 + n * 8,
+                    v.bitcast(fx.BFloat16),
+                )
+            base = s * STAGE + wave * 16 + g * 4
+            live4 = [lds_ld(tbl + base + e) >= 0 for e in range(4)]
+            sc = [live4[e].select(scores[e] * f32(scale), f32(NEG)) for e in range(4)]
+            m = fx.max(fx.max(sc[0], sc[1]), fx.max(sc[2], sc[3]))
+            m = fx.max(m, m.shuffle_xor(16, 64))
+            m = fx.max(m, m.shuffle_xor(32, 64))
+            new_top = fx.max(top, m)
+            corr = hw_exp2(top - new_top)
+            probs = [
+                live4[e].select(hw_exp2(sc[e] - new_top), f32(0.0)) for e in range(4)
+            ]
+            den = den * corr + probs[0] + probs[1] + probs[2] + probs[3]
+            p = (
+                fx.Vector.from_elements(probs, fx.Float32)
+                .to(fx.BFloat16)
+                .bitcast(fx.Int16)
+            )
+            for mt in range_constexpr(16):
+                at = (
+                    wave * 4096
+                    + (2 * mt + (n % 4) // 2) * 128
+                    + (4 * g + n // 4) * 8
+                    + (n % 2) * 4
+                )
+                vt = lds_ld_tr16(vbuf + at)
+                scaled = fx.Vector.from_elements(
+                    [acc[mt][e] * corr for e in range(4)], fx.Float32
+                )
+                acc[mt] = mfma_bf16_k16(vt, p, scaled)
+            top, current = new_top, pending
+        den = den + den.shuffle_xor(16, 64)
+        den = den + den.shuffle_xor(32, 64)
+
+        # the waves' merge
+        fx.barrier()
+        if g == 0:
+            lds_st(aux + wave * 16 + n, top)
+            lds_st(aux + WAVES * 16 + wave * 16 + n, den)
+        for mt in range_constexpr(16):
+            lds_st(obuf + (wave * 16 + n) * HEAD_DIM + mt * 16 + g * 4, acc[mt])
+        fx.barrier()
+        tops = [lds_ld(aux + w * 16 + n) for w in range(WAVES)]
+        m = fx.max(fx.max(tops[0], tops[1]), fx.max(tops[2], tops[3]))
+        factors = [hw_exp2(tops[w] - m) for w in range(WAVES)]
+        tot = f32(0.0)
+        for w in range_constexpr(WAVES):
+            tot = tot + factors[w] * lds_ld(aux + WAVES * 16 + w * 16 + n)
+        dims = [wave * 64 + mt * 16 + g * 4 for mt in range(4)]
+        nums = []
+        for d in dims:
+            vals = [f32(0.0)] * 4
+            for w in range_constexpr(WAVES):
+                o = lds_ld(obuf + (w * 16 + n) * HEAD_DIM + d, 4, fx.Float32)
+                vals = [vals[e] + o[e] * factors[w] for e in range(4)]
+            nums.append(vals)
+        orow = (row * group + n) * (HEAD_DIM // 2)
+
+        if const_expr(splits == 1):
+            _store_out(out, orow, n < group, dims, nums, tot)
+        else:
+            # partial: [row][member][head][head_dim] f32, then
+            # [row][member][head] (max, sum)
+            pbase = (row * splits + member) * COLS
+            if n < group:
+                for i in range_constexpr(4):
+                    st(
+                        part,
+                        (pbase + n) * HEAD_DIM + dims[i],
+                        fx.Vector.from_elements(nums[i], fx.Float32),
+                        CM_DEV,
+                    )
+            ml = Int64(key.rows * splits * COLS * HEAD_DIM)
+            if (wave == 0) & (g == 0):
+                st(
+                    part + ml * Int64(4),
+                    (pbase + n) * 2,
+                    fx.Vector.from_elements([m, tot], fx.Float32),
+                    CM_DEV,
+                )
+            if const_expr(key.spread):
+                _gather(counters, row, splits, tid)
+                _merge_slice(part, ml, out, row, member, splits, group, tid)
+                _depart(counters, row, splits, tid)
+            elif _arrive(counters, row, splits, tid, verdict):
+                mls = [
+                    ld(
+                        part + ml * Int64(4),
+                        ((row * splits + j) * COLS + n) * 2,
+                        fx.Float32,
+                        2,
+                        cm=CM_DEV,
+                    )
+                    for j in range(splits)
+                ]
+                mx = mls[0][0]
+                for j in range_constexpr(1, splits):
+                    mx = fx.max(mx, mls[j][0])
+                fs = [hw_exp2(mls[j][0] - mx) for j in range(splits)]
+                tot = f32(0.0)
+                for j in range_constexpr(splits):
+                    tot = tot + fs[j] * mls[j][1]
+                merged = []
+                for i in range_constexpr(4):
+                    vals = [f32(0.0)] * 4
+                    for j in range_constexpr(splits):
+                        o = ld(
+                            part,
+                            ((row * splits + j) * COLS + n) * HEAD_DIM + dims[i],
+                            fx.Float32,
+                            4,
+                            cm=CM_DEV,
+                        )
+                        vals = [vals[e] + o[e] * fs[j] for e in range(4)]
+                    merged.append(vals)
+                _store_out(out, orow, n < group, dims, merged, tot)
+
+    @flyc.jit
+    def launch(
+        q: Int64,
+        kv: Int64,
+        page_bytes: Int64,
+        sel: Int64,
+        sel_stride: Int32,
+        bt: Int64,
+        bt_stride: Int32,
+        bt_width: Int32,
+        reqs: Int32,
+        token_to_req: Int64,
+        seq_lens: Int64,
+        out: Int64,
+        part: Int64,
+        counters: Int64,
+        stream: fx.Stream = _STREAM,
+    ):
+        _ = keyed
+        kernel(
+            q,
+            kv,
+            page_bytes,
+            sel,
+            sel_stride,
+            bt,
+            bt_stride,
+            bt_width,
+            reqs,
+            token_to_req,
+            seq_lens,
+            out,
+            part,
+            counters,
+        ).launch(grid=(key.rows * splits,), block=(THREADS,), stream=stream)
+
+    _BUILDS[key] = launch
+    return launch
+
+
+@traced
+def _store_out(out, orow, ok, dims, nums, tot):
+    """A thread's 16 normalized outputs of its head (``ok``) as bf16; zeros
+    for a row without attended tokens."""
+    inv = (tot > f32(0.0)).select(hw_rcp(tot), f32(0.0))
+    if ok:
+        for i in range_constexpr(4):
+            v = [nums[i][e] * inv for e in range(4)]
+            words = fx.Vector.from_elements(
+                [pack_bf16(v[0], v[1]), pack_bf16(v[2], v[3])], Int32
+            )
+            st(out, orow + dims[i] // 2, words)
+
+
+@traced
+def _gather(counters, row, arrivals: int, tid):
+    """The split's arrival on its row's counter after its partial, then a
+    wait (bounded) until every split of the row has arrived: the row's
+    splits are co-resident (at most one CTA a CU)."""
+    drain_stores()
+    fx.barrier()
+    if tid == 0:
+        addr = counters + Int64(row * (COUNTER_WORDS * 4))
+        atomic_add(addr, 1)
+        t0 = memrealtime()
+        seen = ld(addr, 0, Int32, cm=CM_DEV)
+        late = Int64(0)
+        while (seen < i32(arrivals)) & (late < Int64(WAIT_TICKS)):
+            seen = ld(addr, 0, Int32, cm=CM_DEV)
+            late = memrealtime() - t0
+    fx.barrier()
+
+
+@traced
+def _depart(counters, row, arrivals: int, tid):
+    """After the split's merge: the row's last to leave resets both counters
+    for the next launch (every split has seen all arrivals by then)."""
+    fx.barrier()
+    if tid == 0:
+        addr = counters + Int64(row * (COUNTER_WORDS * 4))
+        old = atomic_add(addr + Int64(4 * (COUNTER_WORDS // 2)), 1)
+        if old == i32(arrivals - 1):
+            st(addr, 0, i32(0), cm=CM_DEV)
+            st(addr, COUNTER_WORDS // 2, i32(0), cm=CM_DEV)
+
+
+@traced
+def _merge_slice(part, ml, out, row, member, splits: int, group: int, tid):
+    """Split ``member``'s slice of the row's output (``HEAD_DIM / splits``
+    dims of every head) from all splits' partials, in the ``exp2`` domain."""
+    span = HEAD_DIM // splits
+    quads = span // 4
+    chunks = group * quads
+    for r in range_constexpr(-(-chunks // THREADS)):
+        c = tid + i32(r * THREADS)
+        if c < i32(chunks):
+            head = c // i32(quads)
+            d = member * i32(span) + c % i32(quads) * i32(4)
+            mls = [
+                ld(
+                    part + ml * Int64(4),
+                    ((row * splits + j) * COLS + head) * 2,
+                    fx.Float32,
+                    2,
+                    cm=CM_DEV,
+                )
+                for j in range(splits)
+            ]
+            parts = [
+                ld(
+                    part,
+                    ((row * splits + j) * COLS + head) * HEAD_DIM + d,
+                    fx.Float32,
+                    4,
+                    cm=CM_DEV,
+                )
+                for j in range(splits)
+            ]
+            mx = mls[0][0]
+            for j in range_constexpr(1, splits):
+                mx = fx.max(mx, mls[j][0])
+            fs = [hw_exp2(mls[j][0] - mx) for j in range(splits)]
+            tot = f32(0.0)
+            vals = [f32(0.0)] * 4
+            for j in range_constexpr(splits):
+                tot = tot + fs[j] * mls[j][1]
+                vals = [vals[e] + parts[j][e] * fs[j] for e in range(4)]
+            inv = (tot > f32(0.0)).select(hw_rcp(tot), f32(0.0))
+            words = fx.Vector.from_elements(
+                [
+                    pack_bf16(vals[0] * inv, vals[1] * inv),
+                    pack_bf16(vals[2] * inv, vals[3] * inv),
+                ],
+                Int32,
+            )
+            st(out, ((row * group + head) * HEAD_DIM + d) // 2, words)
+
+
+@traced
+def _arrive(counters, row, arrivals: int, tid, verdict):
+    """The split's arrival on its row's counter after its partial: True on
+    the row's last CTA, which resets the counter."""
+    drain_stores()
+    fx.barrier()
+    if tid == 0:
+        addr = counters + Int64(row * (COUNTER_WORDS * 4))
+        old = atomic_add(addr, 1)
+        last = old == i32(arrivals - 1)
+        if last:
+            st(addr, 0, i32(0), cm=CM_DEV)
+        lds_st(verdict, last.select(i32(1), i32(0)))
+    fx.barrier()
+    is_last = lds_ld(verdict) != i32(0)
+    return is_last
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# host side
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+_WORKSPACES: dict = {}
+
+
+def _workspace(rows: int, splits: int, device) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """The splits' partials and the rows' arrival counters (zero; the last
+    arriver leaves its counter zero)."""
+    k = (rows, splits, str(device))
+    if k not in _WORKSPACES:
+        part = torch.empty(
+            rows * splits * COLS * (HEAD_DIM + 2), dtype=torch.float32, device=device
+        )
+        counters = torch.zeros(rows * COUNTER_WORDS, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+        _WORKSPACES[k] = (part, counters)
+    return _WORKSPACES[k]
+
+
+def sparse_attention(
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    kv_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    selected: torch.Tensor,
+    block_table: torch.Tensor,
+    token_to_req: torch.Tensor,
+    seq_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    ratio: int,
+    out: torch.Tensor,
+    splits: int | None = None,
+    dense: bool = False,
+    spread: bool | None = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """``out`` [rows, heads, 256] bf16: attention of ``q`` [rows, heads, 256]
+    over the tokens of the compressed blocks ``selected`` [rows, top_blocks]
+    lists (the indexer top-k's) and the open tail, in ``kv_cache`` [blocks, 1,
+    block_size, 512] bf16 (K | V a token). ``dense``: a row with at most
+    ``top_blocks`` complete blocks attends all of them, its list unread.
+    ``spread``: every split merges a slice of the output (``AttnBuild.spread``;
+    default: at 4 splits a row or more, where it is faster)."""
+    from vllm.v1.attention.ops.flydsl_kernels import _run_compiled
+
+    rows, group, hd = q.shape
+    blocks, kv_heads, page, rec = kv_cache.shape
+    assert hd == HEAD_DIM and kv_heads == 1 and rec == 2 * HEAD_DIM
+    assert q.dtype == kv_cache.dtype == out.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+    assert q.is_contiguous() and out.is_contiguous() and out.shape == q.shape
+    assert kv_cache.stride(3) == 1 and kv_cache.stride(2) == rec
+    assert selected.dtype == block_table.dtype == token_to_req.dtype == torch.int32
+    assert seq_lens.dtype == torch.int32 and selected.stride(1) == 1
+    assert block_table.stride(1) == 1
+    splits = splits or splits_for(rows)
+    key = AttnBuild(
+        rows,
+        splits,
+        page,
+        selected.shape[1],
+        group,
+        ratio,
+        dense,
+        (splits >= 4 if spread is None else spread) and splits > 1,
+    )
+    part, counters = _workspace(rows, splits, q.device)
+    _run_compiled(
+        build(key),
+        q.data_ptr(),
+        kv_cache.data_ptr(),
+        kv_cache.stride(0) * kv_cache.element_size(),
+        selected.data_ptr(),
+        selected.stride(0),
+        block_table.data_ptr(),
+        block_table.stride(0),
+        block_table.shape[1],
+        block_table.shape[0],
+        token_to_req.data_ptr(),
+        seq_lens.data_ptr(),
+        out.data_ptr(),
+        part.data_ptr(),
+        counters.data_ptr(),
+        torch.cuda.current_stream(),
+    )
+    return out
