+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""A launch's identity and its synchronization: the grid barrier between
+phases and the split-K fold's last-arriver count, both behind a bounded wait.
+
+Grid barrier (striped): a CTA adds one to its
+arrival stripe, one of ``STRIPES`` counters on separate 256-byte lines, four
+CTAs a stripe; wave 0's 64 lanes poll every stripe at once, one load each, and
+a ballot says when all reached the barrier's count. The counters are a launch
+slot's: the k-th barrier of a launch waits for ``k * 4`` on every stripe, so
+each launch must start from zeroed counters. Launches alternate between two
+slots, and each zeroes the slot the next one uses (the launch before it is
+done by then): ``sync`` is this launch's slot, ``sync_next`` the next one's.
+Every CTA must take every barrier of a launch: the kernels run one CTA per
+CU, all co-resident.
+
+Every wait gives up after ``WAIT_TICKS``: the CTA records the site in its
+health record, raises its rank's flag on the output rank (``alarm``) and sets
+the rank's FAILED word, so its later waits, and every other CTA's, exit at
+once and the launch runs to its end. The host reads FAILED after the step.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from flydsl.expr import rocdl
+from flydsl.expr.typing import T
+
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.abi import (
+    FAILED,
+    RECORD_WORDS,
+    SITE_GRID,
+    WAIT_TICKS,
+)
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.common.ops import (
+    CM_DEV,
+    CM_SYS,
+    atomic_add,
+    drain_stores,
+    ld,
+    memrealtime,
+    st,
+    traced,
+    uniform,
+)
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.layout import BLOCKS, WAVES
+
+STRIPES = 64  # arrival counters: wave 0's lanes poll them all at once
+STRIPE_WORDS = 64  # one 256-byte line a counter
+PER_STRIPE = BLOCKS // STRIPES
+SLOT_WORDS = STRIPES * STRIPE_WORDS  # a launch slot's barrier counters
+FOLD_BASE = 2 * SLOT_WORDS  # the fold counters follow both slots' stripes
+FOLD_STRIDE = 16  # a fold counter's words: one 64-byte line
+FOLD_COUNTERS = 512
+
+
+def sync_words() -> int:
+    """i32 words of a rank's sync buffer: two launch slots, then the fold
+    counters."""
+    return FOLD_BASE + FOLD_COUNTERS * FOLD_STRIDE
+
+
+class TraceInvariant:
+    """A handle never reassigned inside traced control flow: FlyDSL carries any
+    local that is subscripted or has a method called in a dynamic loop or
+    branch, and these reference only values defined before it, so they carry
+    no IR values and rebuild as themselves."""
+
+    def __extract_to_ir_values__(self):
+        return []
+
+    @classmethod
+    def __construct_from_ir_values__(cls, values, exemplar):
+        return exemplar
+
+
+class Grid(TraceInvariant):
+    """The CTA's identity and its synchronization words.
+
+    ``sync`` / ``sync_next``: this launch's barrier slot and the next launch's
+    (byte addresses); ``folds``: the fold counters; ``health``: the rank's
+    health words; ``alarm``: this rank's flag word on the output rank (0:
+    none); ``scratch``: an LDS word the CTA's threads share verdicts in."""
+
+    def __init__(self, tid, bid, sync, sync_next, folds, health, alarm, scratch):
+        self.tid = fx.Int32(tid)
+        self.bid = fx.Int32(bid)
+        self.lane = self.tid % fx.Int32(64)
+        self.wave = self.tid // fx.Int32(64)
+        self.sync = fx.Int64(sync)
+        self.sync_next = fx.Int64(sync_next)
+        self.folds = fx.Int64(folds)
+        self.health = fx.Int64(health)
+        self.alarm = fx.Int64(alarm)
+        self.scratch = scratch
+        self.barriers = 0  # trace-time count of the launch's grid barriers
+        # the arrival stripe: the XCD the CTA runs on (CTAs are dispatched
+        # round-robin over the 8 XCDs), then its rank there
+        self.stripe = (self.bid % fx.Int32(8)) * fx.Int32(8) + (
+            self.bid // fx.Int32(8)
+        ) % fx.Int32(8)
+        # a phase of few independent items (a row, a (row, stream), a run of
+        # 64 items) takes item i on CTA i % BLOCKS, wave i // BLOCKS: one wave
+        # a CU first, so a CU's memory pipe queues one wave's loads where four
+        # waves of a quarter of the CUs did. ``mirror``: CTA BLOCKS - 1 - i %
+        # BLOCKS, wave WAVES - 1 - i // BLOCKS, for a phase that shares the
+        # CTAs with another. Loop ``range(g.spread, items, BLOCKS * WAVES)``.
+        self.spread = self.wave * fx.Int32(BLOCKS) + self.bid
+        self.mirror = (fx.Int32(WAVES - 1) - self.wave) * fx.Int32(BLOCKS) + (
+            fx.Int32(BLOCKS - 1) - self.bid
+        )
+
+
+@traced
+def give_up(g, site, seen, target):
+    """A wait that timed out: this CTA's record (once), the alarm, FAILED."""
+    rec = (g.bid + 1) * RECORD_WORDS
+    if ld(g.health, rec, fx.Int32, cm=CM_SYS) == 0:
+        at = fx.Int32(memrealtime() & fx.Int64(0x7FFFFFFF))
+        words = [fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(site), fx.Int32(seen), fx.Int32(target)]
+        st(g.health, rec, fx.Vector.from_elements(words, fx.Int32), cm=CM_SYS)
+        tail = [g.bid, at, fx.Int32(0), fx.Int32(0)]
+        st(g.health, rec + 4, fx.Vector.from_elements(tail, fx.Int32), cm=CM_SYS)
+    if g.alarm != fx.Int64(0):
+        st(g.alarm, 0, fx.Int32(1), cm=CM_SYS)
+    rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)
+    st(g.health, FAILED, fx.Int32(1), cm=CM_SYS)
+
+
+def failed(g):
+    return ld(g.health, FAILED, fx.Int32, cm=CM_SYS) != fx.Int32(0)
+
+
+@traced
+def prologue(g):
+    """The launch's first act: CTA 0 zeroes the next launch's barrier slot."""
+    if (g.bid == 0) & (g.tid < STRIPES):
+        st(g.sync_next, g.tid * STRIPE_WORDS, fx.Int32(0), cm=CM_DEV)
+
+
+@traced
+def _poll_stripes(g, target):
+    """Wave 0: poll every stripe until all reached ``target``, bounded. A rank
+    that failed before this barrier does not wait; one that fails while this
+    CTA waits lets it time out on its own (the poll loop stays one load)."""
+    lane_word = g.lane * STRIPE_WORDS  # the descriptor base stays wave-uniform
+    t0 = memrealtime()
+    seen = ld(g.sync, lane_word, fx.Int32, cm=CM_DEV)
+    behind = fx.Int64(rocdl.ballot(T.i64, (seen < target).ir_value()))
+    why = failed(g).select(fx.Int32(2), fx.Int32(0))
+    while (behind != fx.Int64(0)) & (why == 0):
+        seen = ld(g.sync, lane_word, fx.Int32, cm=CM_DEV)
+        behind = fx.Int64(rocdl.ballot(T.i64, (seen < target).ir_value()))
+        late = memrealtime() - t0 > fx.Int64(WAIT_TICKS)
+        why = late.select(fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0))
+    if (why == 1) & (g.lane == 0):
+        give_up(g, SITE_GRID, seen, target)
+
+
+def grid_sync(g, between=None):
+    """Every CTA's stores so far visible to every CTA, then all CTAs past this
+    point: drain, CTA barrier, one arrival on the CTA's stripe, wave 0 polls
+    all stripes for this barrier's count. ``between()``, when given, runs
+    after the arrival and before the wait (loads of data no CTA writes, such
+    as the next phase's weights); its result is returned. Wave 0's poll waits
+    for its loads (``vmcnt`` counts in issue order)."""
+    g.barriers += 1
+    _arrive(g)
+    out = None if between is None else between()
+    _wait(g, fx.Int32(g.barriers * PER_STRIPE))
+    return out
+
+
+@traced
+def _arrive(g):
+    drain_stores()
+    fx.barrier()
+    if g.tid == 0:
+        atomic_add(g.sync + fx.Int64(g.stripe * (STRIPE_WORDS * 4)), 1)
+
+
+@traced
+def _wait(g, target):
+    if uniform(g.wave) == 0:
+        _poll_stripes(g, target)
+    fx.barrier()
+    fx.memory_fence(syncscope="workgroup", ordering=fx.AtomicOrdering.Acquire)
+
+
+@traced
+def fold_arrive(g, counter, arrivals):
+    """A split-K unit's arrival at fold counter ``counter`` after its partials:
+    True on the CTA that arrives last of ``arrivals``, which resets the counter
+    for the next launch."""
+    drain_stores()
+    fx.barrier()
+    if g.tid == 0:
+        addr = g.folds + fx.Int64(counter * (FOLD_STRIDE * 4))
+        old = atomic_add(addr, 1)
+        last = old == fx.Int32(arrivals - 1)
+        if last:
+            st(addr, 0, fx.Int32(0), cm=CM_DEV)
+        fx.ptr_store(last.select(fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0)), g.scratch)
+    fx.barrier()
+    verdict = fx.ptr_load(g.scratch) != fx.Int32(0)
+    fx.barrier()
+    return verdict

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Device primitives of the wide kernels: global accesses through buffer
+descriptors with explicit cache policies, LDS vectors, wave reductions,
+activations, bf16 packing and the clock.
+
+Kernels take raw ``Int64`` byte addresses. A buffer descriptor's offset is 32
+bits, so a pool past 4 GiB (the GDN state) is addressed from a 64-bit base per
+slot. Offsets here count elements of the access's dtype.
+
+Cache policy (gfx950 ``CPol``): data one CTA writes and another CTA reads in
+the same launch goes through ``CM_DEV`` (sc1) on both sides, past the per-XCD
+caches; peer data through ``CM_SYS`` (sc0 | sc1). Weights a launch reads once
+stream with ``CM_NT``.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops as bo
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels.dpp_utils import update_dpp_i32
+from flydsl._mlir import ir
+from flydsl._mlir.dialects import llvm
+from flydsl.compiler.ast_rewriter import ASTRewriter
+from flydsl.expr import math as fmath
+from flydsl.expr import rocdl
+from flydsl.expr.typing import T, as_ir_value
+
+CM_DEV = 16
+CM_SYS = 17
+CM_NT = 2
+
+LOG2E = 1.4426950408889634
+
+
+def traced(fn):
+    """FlyDSL's AST rewriting on a helper, so its ``while`` / ``if`` over
+    traced values lower to scf ops (kernels rewrite only their own body)."""
+    return ASTRewriter.transform(fn)
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# global memory
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def rsrc(addr, nbytes=None):
+    """A buffer descriptor at byte address ``addr``, which must be wave-uniform:
+    a lane-varying base makes the compiler loop over the wave's distinct
+    descriptors one at a time. Lane variation goes in the access's offset."""
+    return bo.create_buffer_resource_from_addr(fx.Int64(addr), num_records_bytes=nbytes)
+
+
+def ld(addr, i, dtype=fx.Int32, n=1, cm=0, nbytes=None, mask=None):
+    """``n`` (1, 2, 4) elements of ``dtype`` at element ``i`` of address ``addr``.
+    With ``mask`` (and the descriptor bounded by ``nbytes``), a lane whose mask
+    is false reads zeros without a memory request."""
+    v = bo.buffer_load(
+        rsrc(addr, nbytes),
+        fx.Int32(i),
+        vec_width=n,
+        dtype=dtype,
+        cache_modifier=cm,
+        mask=mask,
+    )
+    return fx.Vector(v) if n > 1 else dtype(v)
+
+
+def st(addr, i, value, cm=0, nbytes=None):
+    """``value`` (a Numeric or a Vector) at element ``i`` of address ``addr``; with
+    ``nbytes``, a store past the extent is dropped by the hardware."""
+    bo.buffer_store(
+        fx.Vector(value).ir_value() if isinstance(value, fx.Vector) else value,
+        rsrc(addr, nbytes),
+        fx.Int32(i),
+        cache_modifier=cm,
+    )
+
+
+def ld_bf8(addr, i, cm=0):
+    """Eight bf16 at bf16 element ``i`` (a multiple of 8) as a bf16 Vector."""
+    w = fx.Vector(
+        bo.buffer_load(
+            rsrc(addr), fx.Int32(i) // 2, vec_width=4, dtype=T.i32, cache_modifier=cm
+        )
+    )
+    return w.bitcast(fx.BFloat16)
+
+
+def ld_i32x4(addr, i, cm=0):
+    """Four i32 words at word ``i``."""
+    return fx.Vector(
+        bo.buffer_load(
+            rsrc(addr), fx.Int32(i), vec_width=4, dtype=T.i32, cache_modifier=cm
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def st_i32x4(addr, i, words, cm=0, nbytes=None):
+    st(addr, i, fx.Vector(words), cm, nbytes)
+
+
+def _gptr(addr, dtype, n):
+    return fx.inttoptr(
+        fx.PointerType.get(
+            dtype.ir_type, fx.AddressSpace.Global, 4 * max(1, n * dtype.width // 32)
+        ),
+        fx.Int64(addr),
+    )
+
+
+def gld(addr, dtype=fx.Int32, n=1):
+    """``n`` elements at a per-lane 64-bit byte address (no descriptor): a
+    gather whose base differs by lane and lies past a descriptor's 4 GiB."""
+    v = fx.generic_load(_gptr(addr, dtype, n), dtype=dtype, count=n)
+    return fx.Vector(v) if n > 1 else v
+
+
+def gst(addr, value):
+    """``value`` (a Numeric or Vector) at a per-lane 64-bit byte address."""
+    v = fx.Vector(value) if isinstance(value, fx.Vector) else value
+    dtype = v.dtype if isinstance(v, fx.Vector) else type(v)
+    n = v.numel if isinstance(v, fx.Vector) else 1
+    fx.generic_store(_gptr(addr, dtype, n), v)
+
+
+def gptr(addr):
+    """An i32 global pointer at byte address ``addr`` (for atomics)."""
+    return fx.inttoptr(
+        fx.PointerType.get(T.i32, fx.AddressSpace.Global, 4), fx.Int64(addr)
+    )
+
+
+def atomic_add(addr, v):
+    """Agent-scope atomic add on the i32 at byte address ``addr``; the old value."""
+    return fx.Int32(fx.llvm.atomic_add(gptr(addr), fx.Int32(v), syncscope="agent"))
+
+
+def drain_stores():
+    """Wait for this thread's outstanding memory operations. A workgroup-scope
+    release fence alone lowers to no vmcnt wait on gfx950, so it cannot order
+    stores to another CTA before a flag or an arrival."""
+    fx.memory_fence(syncscope="workgroup", ordering=fx.AtomicOrdering.Release)
+    rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)
+
+
+def memrealtime():
+    """s_memrealtime: the 100 MHz device clock."""
+    return fx.Int64(llvm.call_intrinsic(T.i64, "llvm.amdgcn.s.memrealtime", [], [], []))
+
+
+def uniform(v):
+    """The first active lane's Int32, wave-uniform in an SGPR."""
+    return fx.Int32(rocdl.readfirstlane(T.i32, fx.Int32(v).ir_value()))
+
+
+def uniform_i64(v):
+    v = fx.Int64(v)
+    lo = uniform(fx.Int32(v & fx.Int64(0xFFFFFFFF)))
+    hi = uniform(fx.Int32(v >> fx.Int64(32)))
+    return (fx.Int64(hi) << fx.Int64(32)) | fx.Int64(fx.Uint32(lo))
+
+
+def ld_ptr64(table, i):
+    """Entry ``i`` of an i64 table in memory, wave-uniform."""
+    w = ld(table, fx.Int32(i) * 2, fx.Int32, 2)
+    lo, hi = uniform(w[0]), uniform(w[1])
+    return (fx.Int64(hi) << fx.Int64(32)) | fx.Int64(fx.Uint32(lo))
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# LDS
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def lds_ld(ptr, n=1, dtype=fx.Int32):
+    """``n`` elements at LDS pointer ``ptr`` (an ``fx.Array`` iterator plus an
+    element offset): one ds_read of ``n`` x width bits."""
+    if n == 1:
+        return fx.ptr_load(ptr)
+    return fx.Vector(fx.ptr_load(ptr, result_type=fx.Vector.make_type(n, dtype)))
+
+
+def lds_st(ptr, value):
+    fx.ptr_store(value, ptr)
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# wave reductions (DPP inside a row, permlane swaps across rows)
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def _permlane_swap(off, x, y):
+    swap = rocdl.permlane32_swap if off == 32 else rocdl.permlane16_swap
+    pr = swap(
+        llvm.StructType.get_literal([T.i32, T.i32]),
+        as_ir_value(fx.Int32(x)),
+        as_ir_value(fx.Int32(y)),
+        False,
+        False,
+    )
+    return tuple(fx.Int32(llvm.extractvalue(T.i32, pr, [j])) for j in range(2))
+
+
+def _xshfl(v, off):
+    """Lane ``lane ^ off``'s value for off 1..8 (DPP); 16 / 32 via shuffle."""
+    if off >= 16:
+        return v.shuffle_xor(off, 64)
+    is_f = isinstance(v, fx.Float32)
+    x = v.bitcast(fx.Int32) if is_f else fx.Int32(v)
+    if off == 8:
+        y = fx.Int32(update_dpp_i32(x, x, 0x118, 0xF, 0xC, False))
+        y = fx.Int32(update_dpp_i32(y, x, 0x108, 0xF, 0x3, False))
+    elif off == 4:
+        y = fx.Int32(update_dpp_i32(x, x, 0x114, 0xF, 0xA, False))
+        y = fx.Int32(update_dpp_i32(y, x, 0x104, 0xF, 0x5, False))
+    elif off == 2:
+        y = fx.Int32(update_dpp_i32(x, x, 0x4E, 0xF, 0xF, False))
+    else:
+        y = fx.Int32(update_dpp_i32(x, x, 0xB1, 0xF, 0xF, False))
+    return y.bitcast(fx.Float32) if is_f else y
+
+
+def _xred(v, off, op):
+    if off < 16:
+        return op(v, _xshfl(v, off))
+    is_f = isinstance(v, fx.Float32)
+    x = v.bitcast(fx.Int32) if is_f else fx.Int32(v)
+    a, b = _permlane_swap(off, x, x)
+    if is_f:
+        return op(a.bitcast(fx.Float32), b.bitcast(fx.Float32))
+    return op(type(v)(a), type(v)(b))
+
+
+def _add(a, b):
+    return a + b
+
+
+def butterfly(v, offsets, op=_add):
+    """Butterfly reduction over the xor ``offsets`` in order: every lane of the
+    covered group receives the result."""
+    for off in offsets:
+        v = _xred(v, off, op)
+    return v
+
+
+def wave_sum(v):
+    return butterfly(v, (32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1))
+
+
+def wave_max(v):
+    return butterfly(v, (32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1), fx.max)
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# math
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def _hw_f32(name, x):
+    return fx.Float32(
+        llvm.call_intrinsic(T.f32, name, [fx.Float32(x).ir_value()], [], [])
+    )
+
+
+def hw_exp2(x):
+    return _hw_f32("llvm.amdgcn.exp2.f32", x)
+
+
+def hw_rcp(x):
+    return _hw_f32("llvm.amdgcn.rcp.f32", x)
+
+
+def hw_rsq(x):
+    return _hw_f32("llvm.amdgcn.rsq.f32", x)
+
+
+def sigmoid(x):
+    """1 / (1 + exp(-x)) on v_exp_f32 and v_rcp_f32: an underflowing exp gives 1,
+    an overflowing one 0."""
+    return hw_rcp(fx.Float32(1.0) + hw_exp2(x * fx.Float32(-LOG2E)))
+
+
+def silu(x):
+    return x * sigmoid(x)
+
+
+def softplus(x):
+    """log(1 + exp(x)), x past 20 as is (vLLM's GDN gate)."""
+    return (x > fx.Float32(20.0)).select(x, fmath.log1p(fmath.exp(x)))
+
+
+def exp(x):
+    return fmath.exp(fx.Float32(x))
+
+
+def rsqrt(x):
+    return fmath.rsqrt(x)
+
+
+def bf16_round(a):
+    return fx.Float32(fx.Float32(a).to(fx.BFloat16))
+
+
+def bf_lo(w):
+    """The f32 of a packed bf16 pair word's low half."""
+    return (fx.Int32(w) << 16).bitcast(fx.Float32)
+
+
+def bf_hi(w):
+    return (fx.Int32(w) & fx.Int32(-65536)).bitcast(fx.Float32)
+
+
+def pack_bf16(a, b):
+    """Two f32 rounded to bf16, packed in one Int32 (a low)."""
+    return (
+        fx.Vector.from_elements([a, b], fx.Float32).to(fx.BFloat16).bitcast(fx.Int32)[0]
+    )
+
+
+def pack_bf16x8(values):
+    """Eight f32 rounded to bf16 as four packed Int32 words."""
+    return (
+        fx.Vector.from_elements(list(values), fx.Float32)
+        .to(fx.BFloat16)
+        .bitcast(fx.Int32)
+    )
+
+
+def unpack_bf16x8(words):
+    """Four packed Int32 words -> eight f32."""
+    out = []
+    for w in range(4):
+        out += [bf_lo(words[w]), bf_hi(words[w])]
+    return out
+
+
+def zeros(n, dtype=fx.Float32):
+    return fx.Vector.from_elements([dtype(0)] * n, dtype)
+
+
+def mfma_bf16(a, b, acc):
+    """``acc + A @ B.T`` over 32 K: ``a``, ``b`` a lane's 8 bf16 (16x16x32)."""
+    return fx.Vector(
+        rocdl.mfma_f32_16x16x32_bf16(
+            T.vec(4, T.f32),
+            [
+                fx.Vector(a).ir_value(),
+                fx.Vector(b).ir_value(),
+                fx.Vector(acc).ir_value(),
+                0,
+                0,
+                0,
+            ],
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def mfma_bf16_k16(a, b, acc):
+    """``acc + A @ B.T`` over 16 K: ``a``, ``b`` a lane's 4 bf16 as Int16
+    (16x16x16): lane ``l`` holds row ``l % 16``, K ``4 (l / 16) + [0, 4)``."""
+    return fx.Vector(
+        rocdl.mfma_f32_16x16x16bf16_1k(
+            T.vec(4, T.f32),
+            [
+                fx.Vector(a).ir_value(),
+                fx.Vector(b).ir_value(),
+                fx.Vector(acc).ir_value(),
+                0,
+                0,
+                0,
+            ],
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def lds_ld_tr16(ptr):
+    """ds_read_b64_tr_b16 at LDS pointer ``ptr`` (a bf16 iterator plus an
+    element offset): four bf16 transposed across the lanes, as Int16."""
+    return fx.Vector(
+        rocdl.ds_read_tr16_b64(
+            fx.Vector.make_type(4, fx.BFloat16), fx.to_llvm_ptr(ptr)
+        ).result
+    ).bitcast(fx.Int16)
+
+
+def mfma_f4(a, b, acc, sa, sb, opsel_a=0):
+    """``acc + A @ B.T`` over 128 K of e2m1: ``a`` / ``b`` a lane's four Int32 (32
+    codes), ``sa`` / ``sb`` its E8M0 scale codes (``opsel_a`` picks A's byte of
+    the ``sa`` word; B's is the low byte)."""
+    return fx.Vector(
+        rocdl.mfma_scale_f32_16x16x128_f8f6f4(
+            T.vec(4, T.f32),
+            [
+                fx.Vector(a).ir_value(),
+                fx.Vector(b).ir_value(),
+                fx.Vector(acc).ir_value(),
+                4,
+                4,
+                opsel_a,
+                fx.Int32(sa).ir_value(),
+                0,
+                fx.Int32(sb).ir_value(),
+            ],
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def sched_barrier():
+    """Keep issued loads where they are (the scheduler would sink them to their
+    use)."""
+    rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
+
+
+def unlikely(cond):
+    """``cond`` marked cold (llvm.expect)."""
+    return fx.Boolean(
+        llvm.call_intrinsic(
+            ir.IntegerType.get_signless(1),
+            "llvm.expect.i1",
+            [as_ir_value(cond), as_ir_value(fx.Boolean(False))],
+            [],
+            [],
+        )
+    )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+# Adapted from the Kimi-K3 decode's ``mono/common/plan.py`` (after ROCm/ATOM
+# a526f0d, MIT License, Copyright (C) 2026, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.).
+"""A kernel build's parameters, all of them in FlyDSL's JIT cache key, and a
+kernel's argument list, named once.
+
+FlyDSL keys a compiled kernel by the scalars its launcher's closures capture;
+a parameter used only by build-time Python would not be keyed, and two builds
+differing only there would share one binary. So a build's parameters are one
+frozen dataclass of scalars, ``key_tuple`` turns it into one (name, value)
+tuple, and the launcher references that tuple. The tuple also carries the
+digest of the kernel sources (``source_digest``): FlyDSL does not reach every
+helper's source when it hashes a kernel.
+
+A FlyDSL kernel and its launcher each spell out their positional parameters
+and the host passes them by position, so ``KernelAbi`` is the one list of
+names: the build checks both signatures against it and the host packs by name.
+"""
+
+import enum
+import functools
+import hashlib
+import inspect
+from dataclasses import dataclass, fields
+from pathlib import Path
+
+_SCALARS = (int, float, bool, str, enum.Enum)
+_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def source_digest() -> str:
+    """sha256 of every ``.py`` file of the ``wide`` package, path and contents."""
+    h = hashlib.sha256()
+    for f in sorted(_ROOT.rglob("*.py")):
+        h.update(str(f.relative_to(_ROOT)).encode())
+        h.update(f.read_bytes())
+    return h.hexdigest()[:16]
+
+
+def key_tuple(key) -> tuple:
+    """``key``'s (field name, value) pairs, every value a scalar, then the
+    kernel sources' digest."""
+    out = []
+    for f in fields(key):
+        value = getattr(key, f.name)
+        if not isinstance(value, _SCALARS):
+            raise TypeError(
+                f"{type(key).__name__}.{f.name} = {value!r}: a build parameter must "
+                "be a scalar to reach the JIT cache key"
+            )
+        out.append((f.name, value))
+    out.append(("sources", source_digest()))
+    return tuple(out)
+
+
+def _python_params(fn) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+    py = getattr(fn, "func", None) or getattr(fn, "_func", None)
+    if py is None:
+        raise TypeError(f"no Python function behind {fn!r}")
+    return tuple(inspect.signature(py).parameters)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class KernelAbi:
+    names: tuple[str, ...]
+
+    def check(self, kernel, launcher) -> None:
+        """The kernel takes exactly ``names``; the launcher too, then ``stream``."""
+        got = _python_params(kernel)
+        if got != self.names:
+            raise TypeError(f"kernel parameters {got} != ABI {self.names}")
+        got = _python_params(launcher)
+        if got != (*self.names, "stream"):
+            raise TypeError(f"launcher parameters {got} != ABI {self.names} + stream")
+
+    def pack(self, values: dict) -> list:
+        """``values`` (every name, nothing else) in ABI order."""
+        if set(values) != set(self.names):
+            extra = sorted(set(values) - set(self.names))
+            missing = sorted(set(self.names) - set(values))
+            raise TypeError(f"ABI mismatch: missing {missing}, unexpected {extra}")
+        return [values[n] for n in self.names]
+
+    def zeros(self) -> list:
+        """Every argument 0: what a compile-only call passes."""
+        return [0] * len(self.names)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""QSA indexer scores of a decode batch over vLLM's paged compressed-key
+cache, in the stock scoring op's format: ``logits[row, c]`` = sum over the
+indexer heads of ``relu(q_h . k_c)`` / ``divisor`` for the row's visible
+columns ``c < visible[row]`` (columns past it unwritten but for the last
+4-column store), and ``visible`` = complete compressed blocks the row sees.
+
+``splits`` CTAs a row each score a contiguous range of 256-column rounds:
+the CTA first loads the row's page table into LDS (byte offsets of its pages
+in the cache); a wave then multiplies four 16-column tiles of keys with the
+row's queries on the matrix unit (``S^T = K Q^T``, 16x16x32, the indexer
+heads in four of the 16 columns) per round, with the next round's key loads
+in flight.
+
+With a selection budget (``ScoreBuild.top``, the decode top-k's blocks) the
+launch also selects, replacing ``top_k_per_row_decode``: a row with at most
+``top`` visible blocks is not scored (its first CTA lists them all), and in
+a longer row the CTA that arrives last on the row's counter selects the
+``top`` best (``wide.select``) into ``sel``.
+"""
+
+import math
+from dataclasses import astuple, dataclass
+from typing import NamedTuple
+
+import flydsl.compiler as flyc
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+import torch
+from flydsl.expr import const_expr, range_constexpr
+from flydsl.expr.typing import Int32, Int64
+
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide import prepare as prep_
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide import select as sel_
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.attention import (
+    COUNTER_WORDS,
+    _arrive,
+    splits_for,
+)
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.common.ops import (
+    CM_DEV,
+    _xshfl,
+    bf_hi,
+    bf_lo,
+    gld,
+    ld,
+    lds_ld,
+    lds_st,
+    mfma_bf16,
+    pack_bf16,
+    st,
+    traced,
+    uniform,
+    wave_sum,
+    zeros,
+)
+
+i32 = fx.Int32
+f32 = fx.Float32
+
+THREADS = 256
+WAVES = THREADS // 64
+DIM = 128  # an indexer head's dims
+TILES = 4  # 16-column tiles a wave scores a round
+ROUND = WAVES * TILES * 16  # columns a CTA scores a round
+LDS_BYTES = 160 * 1024
+MAIN_HEADS = 12  # the main attention's query heads a rank
+QKV_ROW = (2 * MAIN_HEADS + 2) * 256  # qkv_proj's row: [q | gate] a head, k, v
+IX_ROW = 5 * DIM  # index_qk_proj's row: the query heads, then the key
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class ScoreBuild:
+    rows: int
+    splits: int
+    page: int  # compressed keys a cache block
+    pages: int  # the page table's width
+    heads: int  # indexer heads
+    ratio: int
+    pos64: bool  # query positions are int64
+    divisor: float
+    top: int = 0  # the selection budget in blocks (0: scores only)
+    # vLLM's fused prepare in the launch (``wide.prepare``): (main eps, index
+    # eps, MRoPE (h, w) sections or None, MRoPE positions kept in the ring);
+    # () runs none (the caller prepared ``q``, the caches)
+    prep: tuple = ()
+
+
+def _head_sum(vals, heads: int):
+    """Sums over the 16-lane group's first ``heads`` lanes (the others hold
+    zeros), into its lane 0."""
+    off = 1
+    while off < heads:
+        vals = [v + _xshfl(v, off) for v in vals]
+        off *= 2
+    return vals
+
+
+@traced
+def _select_last(tid, end, counters, row, splits: int, verdict, keys, staged, *args):
+    """A row past the budget: the row's last-arriving CTA selects its blocks
+    (``select.select(..., *args)``) from the scores every CTA wrote."""
+    if end > i32(0):
+        last = _arrive(counters, row, splits, tid, verdict)
+        if last:
+            logits, logits_stride, sel, sel_stride, top = args
+            sel_.select(
+                tid, keys, staged, logits, row, logits_stride, end, sel, sel_stride, top
+            )
+
+
+@traced
+def _store_scores(logits, base, c, end, n, vals, cm: int):
+    """Lane ``n == 0``'s four scores of columns ``c ..``: whole when they are
+    all before ``end``, else one by one (the columns at ``end`` and past it
+    are not this tile's)."""
+    if (n == 0) & (c < end):
+        if c + i32(4) <= end:
+            st(logits, base + c, fx.Vector.from_elements(vals, fx.Float32), cm)
+        else:
+            for e in range_constexpr(4):
+                if c + i32(e) < end:
+                    st(logits, base + c + i32(e), vals[e], cm)
+
+
+@traced
+def _index_queries(wave, lane, row, heads: int, ixqk, qx, w, eps: float, *args):
+    """Wave ``w``'s indexer query head ``w`` of the row, normed and rotated,
+    into LDS (``qx``) as bf16 pairs."""
+    cos_sin, axes, mrope = args
+    if wave < i32(heads):
+        xq = prep_.load_pair(ixqk, row * IX_ROW + wave * DIM + lane * 2)
+        yq = prep_.index_norm_rope(lane, xq, w, eps, cos_sin, axes, mrope)
+        lds_st(qx + wave * (DIM // 2) + lane, pack_bf16(yq[0], yq[1]))
+
+
+@traced
+def _main_heads(first, step: int, lane, row, qkv, q_out, gate_out, *args):
+    """The row's main query heads (and their gates) and its key | value
+    head, items ``first, first + step, ..`` of 13 (a wave each)."""
+    qn_w, kn_w, eps, cos_sin, axes, mrope, kv, kv_block, kv_page, slots = args
+    for item in range(first, i32(MAIN_HEADS + 1), i32(step)):
+        if item < i32(MAIN_HEADS):
+            src = row * QKV_ROW + item * (2 * prep_.MAIN_DIM)
+            o = prep_.main_head(lane, src, qkv, qn_w, eps, cos_sin, axes, mrope)
+            at = ((row * MAIN_HEADS + item) * prep_.MAIN_DIM) // 2 + lane * 2
+            st(q_out, at, o)
+            gate = ld(qkv, (src + prep_.MAIN_DIM) // 2 + lane * 2, Int32, 2)
+            st(gate_out, at, gate)
+        else:
+            src = row * QKV_ROW + MAIN_HEADS * 2 * prep_.MAIN_DIM
+            o = prep_.main_head(lane, src, qkv, kn_w, eps, cos_sin, axes, mrope)
+            slot = uniform(prep_.low_word(slots, row))
+            if slot >= i32(0):
+                dst = (
+                    kv
+                    + Int64(slot // kv_page) * kv_block
+                    + Int64((slot % kv_page) * (4 * prep_.MAIN_DIM))
+                )
+                st(dst, lane * 2, o)
+                v = ld(qkv, (src + prep_.MAIN_DIM) // 2 + lane * 2, Int32, 2)
+                st(dst, prep_.MAIN_DIM // 2 + lane * 2, v)
+
+
+@traced
+def _new_key(lane, row, lp, live, req, k, axes, fresh, visible, qx, heads: int, *args):
+    """The row's indexer key: the ring commit and, at a completed group, the
+    compressed key and (``fresh``) its score at column ``visible - 1``."""
+    eps, w, cos_sin, mrope, tail, raw, comp, logits, base, inv = args
+    done, key = prep_.index_key(
+        lane, row, lp, live, req, k, eps, w, cos_sin, mrope, tail, raw, comp
+    )
+    prep_.commit_raw(lane, row, live, k, axes, tail, raw)
+    if fresh != i32(0):
+        total = f32(0.0)
+        for h in range_constexpr(heads):
+            word = lds_ld(qx + h * (DIM // 2) + lane)
+            dot = wave_sum(bf_lo(word) * key[0] + bf_hi(word) * key[1])
+            total = total + fx.max(dot, f32(0.0))
+        if lane == i32(0):
+            st(logits, base + visible - i32(1), total * f32(inv), CM_DEV)
+    _ = done
+
+
+_BUILDS: dict = {}
+_STREAM = fx.Stream(None)
+
+
+def build(key: ScoreBuild):
+    if key in _BUILDS:
+        return _BUILDS[key]
+    assert key.heads <= 16
+    splits, page, heads, ratio = key.splits, key.page, key.heads, key.ratio
+    table_rounds = -(-key.pages // THREADS)
+    inv = 1.0 / key.divisor
+    keyed = astuple(key)
+
+    top = key.top
+    table_words = 2 * table_rounds * THREADS
+    staged = sel_.lds_keys(LDS_BYTES - 4 * (table_words + 64)) if top else 0
+    select_words = sel_.lds_words(staged) if top else 4
+    # the last arriver reads the row's scores: device-coherent stores
+    cm = CM_DEV if top else 0
+
+    prep = key.prep
+    if prep:
+        main_eps, ix_eps, mrope, tail = prep
+        assert heads * DIM // 2 == 256 and ratio == 4
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class Lds:
+        table: fx.Array[fx.Int32, table_words, 16]
+        keys: fx.Array[fx.Int32, select_words, 16]
+        verdict: fx.Array[fx.Int32, 4, 16]
+        qx: fx.Array[fx.Int32, (heads * DIM // 2) if prep else 4, 16]
+
+    @flyc.kernel(
+        name=f"q4w_qsa_score_s{key.rows}_x{splits}"
+        + (f"_k{top}" if top else "")
+        + ("_prep" if prep else ""),
+        known_block_size=[THREADS, 1, 1],
+    )
+    def kernel(
+        q: Int64,
+        kc: Int64,
+        page_bytes: Int64,
+        bt: Int64,
+        bt_stride: Int32,
+        reqs: Int32,
+        token_to_req: Int64,
+        positions: Int64,
+        seq_lens: Int64,
+        logits: Int64,
+        logits_stride: Int32,
+        columns: Int32,
+        visible_out: Int64,
+        sel: Int64,
+        sel_stride: Int32,
+        counters: Int64,
+        ixqk: Int64,
+        qkv: Int64,
+        q_out: Int64,
+        gate_out: Int64,
+        rope_pos: Int64,
+        pos_axis: Int32,
+        cos_sin: Int64,
+        qn_w: Int64,
+        kn_w: Int64,
+        iqn_w: Int64,
+        ikn_w: Int64,
+        kv: Int64,
+        kv_block: Int64,
+        kv_page: Int32,
+        main_slots: Int64,
+        raw: Int64,
+        raw_block: Int64,
+        raw_row: Int32,
+        raw_size: Int32,
+        raw_rings: Int32,
+        raw_slots: Int64,
+        raw_bt: Int64,
+        raw_bt_stride: Int32,
+        comp_slots: Int64,
+        comp_blocks: Int32,
+    ):
+        _ = keyed
+        tid = i32(fx.thread_idx.x)
+        bid = i32(fx.block_idx.x)
+        alloc = fx.SharedAllocator()
+        sm = alloc.allocate(Lds).peek()
+        table = fx.recast_iter(fx.Int64, sm.table.ptr)
+        lane, wave = tid % 64, tid // 64
+        n, g = lane % 16, lane // 16
+        row, member = bid // splits, bid % splits
+
+        if const_expr(prep):
+            # the main heads need nothing but the row: they go first
+            axes = [
+                uniform(prep_.low_word(rope_pos, a * pos_axis + row)) for a in range(3)
+            ]
+            _main_heads(
+                member * WAVES + wave,
+                splits * WAVES,
+                lane,
+                row,
+                qkv,
+                q_out,
+                gate_out,
+                qn_w,
+                kn_w,
+                main_eps,
+                cos_sin,
+                axes,
+                mrope,
+                kv,
+                kv_block,
+                kv_page,
+                main_slots,
+            )
+
+        req = uniform(ld(token_to_req, row, Int32))
+        live = (req >= 0) & (req < reqs)
+        req = live.select(req, i32(0))
+        # an int64 position's low word
+        pos = uniform(ld(positions, row * (2 if key.pos64 else 1), Int32))
+        seq = live.select(uniform(ld(seq_lens, req, Int32)), i32(0))
+        a, b = (pos + 1) // ratio, seq // ratio
+        visible = (a < b).select(a, b)
+        end = live.select((visible < columns).select(visible, columns), i32(0))
+        if (member == 0) & (tid == 0):
+            st(visible_out, row, visible)
+        if const_expr(top):
+            # within the budget the row takes every block: nothing to score
+            short = end <= i32(top)
+            if short & (member == 0):
+                sel_.identity(sel, row, sel_stride, end, top, tid)
+            end = short.select(i32(0), end)
+        # the launch's own new compressed key (a completed group) is scored
+        # apart, from registers: its column stays out of the tiles
+        fresh = i32(0)
+        if const_expr(prep):
+            cslot = uniform(prep_.low_word(comp_slots, row))
+            fresh = (
+                live & (cslot >= i32(0)) & (end == visible) & (end > i32(0))
+            ).select(i32(1), i32(0))
+        tile_end = end - fresh
+        rounds = (tile_end + ROUND - 1) // ROUND
+        r0 = member * rounds // splits
+        local = (member + 1) * rounds // splits - r0
+
+        # a row with tiles to score: its pages (byte offsets in the cache, -1:
+        # none) and, preparing, its indexer queries (wave w's head w, bf16
+        # pairs) into LDS; a row within the budget needs neither
+        if tile_end > i32(0):
+            for tr in range_constexpr(table_rounds):
+                p = tid + tr * THREADS
+                inside = p < key.pages
+                entry = ld(bt, req * bt_stride + inside.select(p, i32(0)), Int32)
+                ok = inside & (entry >= 0)
+                lds_st(table + p, ok.select(Int64(entry) * page_bytes, Int64(-1)))
+            if const_expr(prep):
+                _index_queries(
+                    wave,
+                    lane,
+                    row,
+                    heads,
+                    ixqk,
+                    sm.qx.ptr,
+                    iqn_w,
+                    ix_eps,
+                    cos_sin,
+                    axes,
+                    mrope,
+                )
+            fx.barrier()
+
+        qs = []
+        if const_expr(prep):
+            raw_args = (
+                raw,
+                raw_block,
+                raw_row,
+                raw_size,
+                raw_rings,
+                raw_slots,
+                raw_bt,
+                raw_bt_stride,
+            )
+            k_raw = prep_.load_pair(ixqk, row * IX_ROW + heads * DIM + lane * 2)
+            for kq in range_constexpr(DIM // 32):
+                at = (n < heads).select(n, i32(0)) * (DIM // 2) + kq * 16 + g * 4
+                v = lds_ld(sm.qx.ptr + at, 4)
+                qs.append((n < heads).select(v, zeros(4, Int32)).bitcast(fx.BFloat16))
+            # the row's last wave: no main head at 4 splits a row or more
+            if (member == splits - 1) & (wave == WAVES - 1):
+                _new_key(
+                    lane,
+                    row,
+                    pos,
+                    live,
+                    req,
+                    k_raw,
+                    axes,
+                    fresh,
+                    visible,
+                    sm.qx.ptr,
+                    heads,
+                    ix_eps,
+                    ikn_w,
+                    cos_sin,
+                    mrope,
+                    tail,
+                    raw_args,
+                    (kc, page_bytes, page, comp_blocks, comp_slots, ratio),
+                    logits,
+                    row * logits_stride,
+                    inv,
+                )
+        else:
+            for kq in range_constexpr(DIM // 32):
+                v = ld(
+                    q,
+                    (
+                        (row * heads + (n < heads).select(n, i32(0))) * DIM
+                        + kq * 32
+                        + g * 8
+                    )
+                    // 2,
+                    Int32,
+                    4,
+                )
+                qs.append((n < heads).select(v, zeros(4, Int32)).bitcast(fx.BFloat16))
+
+        def key_loads(r):
+            """Round ``r``'s keys of the lane's column of each tile: its
+            quarter (``g``) of each 32-dim step, as stored."""
+            out = []
+            for u in range_constexpr(TILES):
+                c = (r0 + r) * ROUND + (wave * TILES + u) * 16 + n
+                ok = (r < local) & (c < tile_end)
+                c = ok.select(c, i32(0))
+                base = lds_ld(table + c // page)
+                ok = ok & (base >= 0)
+                at = (
+                    kc
+                    + ok.select(base + Int64(c % page) * Int64(DIM * 2), Int64(0))
+                    + Int64(g * 16)
+                )
+                out.append(
+                    [gld(at + Int64(k * 64), Int32, 4) for k in range(DIM // 32)]
+                )
+            return out
+
+        current = key_loads(i32(0))
+        for r in range(i32(0), local, i32(1)):
+            pending = key_loads(r + 1)
+            for u in range_constexpr(TILES):
+                d = zeros(4)
+                for k in range_constexpr(DIM // 32):
+                    d = mfma_bf16(current[u][k].bitcast(fx.BFloat16), qs[k], d)
+                # relu, then the sum over the heads (lanes n of the 16-lane group)
+                s = _head_sum([fx.max(d[e], f32(0.0)) for e in range(4)], heads)
+                c = (r0 + r) * ROUND + (wave * TILES + u) * 16 + g * 4
+                vals = [s[e] * f32(inv) for e in range(4)]
+                _store_scores(logits, row * logits_stride, c, tile_end, n, vals, cm)
+            current = pending
+
+        if const_expr(top):
+            _select_last(
+                tid,
+                end,
+                counters,
+                row,
+                splits,
+                sm.verdict.ptr,
+                sm.keys.ptr,
+                staged,
+                logits,
+                logits_stride,
+                sel,
+                sel_stride,
+                top,
+            )
+
+    @flyc.jit
+    def launch(
+        q: Int64,
+        kc: Int64,
+        page_bytes: Int64,
+        bt: Int64,
+        bt_stride: Int32,
+        reqs: Int32,
+        token_to_req: Int64,
+        positions: Int64,
+        seq_lens: Int64,
+        logits: Int64,
+        logits_stride: Int32,
+        columns: Int32,
+        visible_out: Int64,
+        sel: Int64,
+        sel_stride: Int32,
+        counters: Int64,
+        ixqk: Int64,
+        qkv: Int64,
+        q_out: Int64,
+        gate_out: Int64,
+        rope_pos: Int64,
+        pos_axis: Int32,
+        cos_sin: Int64,
+        qn_w: Int64,
+        kn_w: Int64,
+        iqn_w: Int64,
+        ikn_w: Int64,
+        kv: Int64,
+        kv_block: Int64,
+        kv_page: Int32,
+        main_slots: Int64,
+        raw: Int64,
+        raw_block: Int64,
+        raw_row: Int32,
+        raw_size: Int32,
+        raw_rings: Int32,
+        raw_slots: Int64,
+        raw_bt: Int64,
+        raw_bt_stride: Int32,
+        comp_slots: Int64,
+        comp_blocks: Int32,
+        stream: fx.Stream = _STREAM,
+    ):
+        _ = keyed
+        kernel(
+            q,
+            kc,
+            page_bytes,
+            bt,
+            bt_stride,
+            reqs,
+            token_to_req,
+            positions,
+            seq_lens,
+            logits,
+            logits_stride,
+            columns,
+            visible_out,
+            sel,
+            sel_stride,
+            counters,
+            ixqk,
+            qkv,
+            q_out,
+            gate_out,
+            rope_pos,
+            pos_axis,
+            cos_sin,
+            qn_w,
+            kn_w,
+            iqn_w,
+            ikn_w,
+            kv,
+            kv_block,
+            kv_page,
+            main_slots,
+            raw,
+            raw_block,
+            raw_row,
+            raw_size,
+            raw_rings,
+            raw_slots,
+            raw_bt,
+            raw_bt_stride,
+            comp_slots,
+            comp_blocks,

+
+    _BUILDS[key] = launch
+    return launch
+
+
+_COUNTERS: dict = {}
+
+
+def _counters(rows: int, device) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The rows' arrival counters (zero; the last arriver leaves its counter
+    zero)."""
+    k = (rows, str(device))
+    if k not in _COUNTERS:
+        _COUNTERS[k] = torch.zeros(
+            rows * COUNTER_WORDS, dtype=torch.int32, device=device
+        )
+    return _COUNTERS[k]
+
+
+class Prep(NamedTuple):
+    """What the score launch needs to run vLLM's fused prepare for a decode
+    batch (``ScoreBuild.prep``): the projections, the outputs, the rope, the
+    norms and every cache with its slots."""
+
+    ixqk: torch.Tensor  # [rows, (heads + 1) 128] bf16: index_qk_proj(x)
+    qkv: torch.Tensor  # [rows, QKV_ROW] bf16: qkv_proj(x)
+    query: torch.Tensor  # [rows, 12, 256] bf16 out: the main attention's q
+    gate: torch.Tensor  # [rows, 12, 256] bf16 out
+    rope_pos: torch.Tensor  # int64 [3, >= rows] (MRoPE) or [>= rows]
+    cos_sin: torch.Tensor  # bf16 [positions, 64]
+    q_norm: torch.Tensor  # the main attention's Gemma norms (256)
+    k_norm: torch.Tensor
+    ix_q_norm: torch.Tensor  # the indexer's (128)
+    ix_k_norm: torch.Tensor
+    main_eps: float
+    ix_eps: float
+    mrope: tuple | None  # (h, w) sections
+    kv: torch.Tensor  # [blocks, 1, page, 512] bf16
+    main_slots: torch.Tensor  # int64 [>= rows]
+    ring: torch.Tensor  # [rings, ring rows, 128 (+ 12 with MRoPE positions)] bf16
+    ring_slots: torch.Tensor  # int64 [>= rows]
+    ring_table: torch.Tensor  # int32 [reqs, >= 1]: a request's ring at column 0
+    comp_slots: torch.Tensor  # int64 [>= rows]: a completed group's row, else -1
+
+
+def _prep_args(p: Prep | None, rows: int, comp_blocks: int) -> list[int]:
+    if p is None:
+        return [0] * 25
+    assert p.qkv.dtype == p.ixqk.dtype == p.kv.dtype == p.ring.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+    assert p.qkv.shape[1] == QKV_ROW and p.qkv.is_contiguous()
+    assert p.ixqk.stride(0) == IX_ROW and p.ixqk.stride(1) == 1
+    assert p.query.is_contiguous() and p.gate.is_contiguous()
+    assert p.query.shape == p.gate.shape == (rows, MAIN_HEADS, 256)
+    assert p.cos_sin.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and p.cos_sin.shape[1] == 64
+    assert p.cos_sin.is_contiguous()
+    for t in (p.rope_pos, p.main_slots, p.ring_slots, p.comp_slots):
+        assert t.dtype == torch.int64 and t.stride(-1) == 1
+    assert p.ring_table.dtype == torch.int32
+    blocks, kv_heads, page, rec = p.kv.shape
+    assert kv_heads == 1 and rec == 512 and p.kv.stride(2) == rec
+    assert p.kv.stride(3) == 1
+    tail = p.ring.shape[2] > DIM
+    assert p.ring.stride(2) == 1 and (not tail or p.ring.shape[2] >= DIM + 12)
+    axis = p.rope_pos.stride(0) if p.rope_pos.dim() == 2 else 0
+    return [
+        p.ixqk.data_ptr(),
+        p.qkv.data_ptr(),
+        p.query.data_ptr(),
+        p.gate.data_ptr(),
+        p.rope_pos.data_ptr(),
+        axis,
+        p.cos_sin.data_ptr(),
+        p.q_norm.data_ptr(),
+        p.k_norm.data_ptr(),
+        p.ix_q_norm.data_ptr(),
+        p.ix_k_norm.data_ptr(),
+        p.kv.data_ptr(),
+        p.kv.stride(0) * 2,
+        page,
+        p.main_slots.data_ptr(),
+        p.ring.data_ptr(),
+        p.ring.stride(0) * 2,
+        p.ring.stride(1) * 2,
+        p.ring.shape[1],
+        p.ring.shape[0],
+        p.ring_slots.data_ptr(),
+        p.ring_table.data_ptr(),
+        p.ring_table.stride(0),
+        p.comp_slots.data_ptr(),
+        comp_blocks,
+    ]
+
+
+def score(
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    k_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    page_table: torch.Tensor,
+    token_to_req: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    seq_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    ratio: int,
+    logits: torch.Tensor,
+    visible: torch.Tensor,
+    divisor: float | None = None,
+    selected: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    prep: Prep | None = None,
+) -> None:
+    """``qsa_mqa_paged`` into ``logits`` [rows, columns] f32 and ``visible``
+    [rows] int32: ``q`` [rows, heads, 128] bf16, ``k_cache`` [pages,
+    page_size, 1, 128] bf16. With ``selected`` [rows, top] int32, also the
+    decode top-k's selection (``top_k_per_row_decode(logits, 1, visible,
+    selected, ...)``'s set, ascending; -1 past a short row's blocks); a row
+    within the budget then leaves its logits unwritten. With ``prep`` (a
+    decode batch, ``q`` None), first vLLM's fused prepare of the rows
+    (``ops.qsa_prepare``): the queries from the projections, the caches;
+    ``positions`` are then the rows' logical positions."""
+    from vllm.v1.attention.ops.flydsl_kernels import _run_compiled
+
+    if prep is None:
+        rows, heads, dim = q.shape
+        assert q.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and q.is_contiguous()
+    else:
+        rows, heads, dim = logits.shape[0], prep.ixqk.shape[1] // DIM - 1, DIM
+    _, page, kv_heads, kdim = k_cache.shape
+    assert dim == kdim == DIM and kv_heads == 1
+    assert k_cache.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+    assert k_cache.stride(1) == DIM and k_cache.stride(3) == 1
+    assert logits.dtype == torch.float32 and logits.stride(1) == 1
+    assert logits.shape[1] % 4 == 0 and logits.stride(0) % 4 == 0
+    assert visible.dtype == token_to_req.dtype == seq_lens.dtype == torch.int32
+    assert positions.dtype in (torch.int32, torch.int64) and positions.is_contiguous()
+    assert page_table.dtype == torch.int32 and page_table.stride(1) == 1
+    top = 0
+    if selected is not None:
+        assert selected.dtype == torch.int32 and selected.stride(1) == 1
+        assert selected.shape[0] == rows
+        top = selected.shape[1]
+    divisor = math.sqrt(dim) if divisor is None else divisor
+    key = ScoreBuild(
+        rows,
+        splits_for(rows),
+        page,
+        page_table.shape[1],
+        heads,
+        ratio,
+        positions.dtype == torch.int64,
+        float(divisor),
+        top,
+        ()
+        if prep is None
+        else (
+            float(prep.main_eps),
+            float(prep.ix_eps),
+            None if prep.mrope is None else tuple(int(v) for v in prep.mrope),
+            prep.ring.shape[2] > DIM,
+        ),
+    )
+    _run_compiled(
+        build(key),
+        0 if q is None else q.data_ptr(),
+        k_cache.data_ptr(),
+        k_cache.stride(0) * k_cache.element_size(),
+        page_table.data_ptr(),
+        page_table.stride(0),
+        page_table.shape[0],
+        token_to_req.data_ptr(),
+        positions.data_ptr(),
+        seq_lens.data_ptr(),
+        logits.data_ptr(),
+        logits.stride(0),
+        logits.shape[1],
+        visible.data_ptr(),
+        0 if selected is None else selected.data_ptr(),
+        0 if selected is None else selected.stride(0),
+        0 if selected is None else _counters(rows, logits.device).data_ptr(),
+        *_prep_args(prep, rows, k_cache.shape[0]),
+        torch.cuda.current_stream(),
+    )

+"""The wide decode's launches: one persistent kernel per GDN layer, and two per
+QSA layer around vLLM's attention (``LayerBuild.kind``):
+
+    gdn        [stats] attn mix -> GDN proj + conv -> recurrence + gated norm
+               -> out_proj -> TP exchange -> attn combine
+               -> mlp mix -> router -> route + quantize -> experts
+               -> TP exchange -> mlp combine
+    qsa_front  [stats] attn mix -> x -> qkv_proj + index_qk_proj
+               (vLLM's QSA attention follows)
+    qsa_back   o_proj (gated) -> TP exchange -> attn combine -> the MLP half
+
+Phases are separated by grid barriers; an exchange's readers wait on its line
+flags instead. Up to ``tiled.RESIDENT_MAX`` rows a mix is one phase and so is
+GDN proj -> out_proj -> attn combine: their hand-offs are tagged pairs
+(``stages.tagged``), and each GEMM's first weights are issued inside the
+barrier before it. A launch reads the multi-stream state, updates it in place
+(``state``, [rows, HC * HIDDEN] bf16, materialized: the next launch, a PLE
+layer and the final mixer read it as is) and leaves ``rrms`` of every (row,
+stream) in its scratch for the next launch's mix; ``stats`` computes them
+first when the state comes from vLLM (layer 0, after a PLE layer).
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import flydsl.compiler as flyc
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+import torch
+from flydsl.expr import const_expr
+from flydsl.expr.typing import Int32, Int64
+
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.common.grid import (
+    Grid,
+    TraceInvariant,
+    grid_sync,
+    prologue,
+)
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.common.ops import (
+    ld,
+    ld_ptr64,
+    memrealtime,
+    st,
+)
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.common.plan import (
+    KernelAbi,
+    key_tuple,
+)
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.layout import (
+    BLOCKS,
+    HC,
+    HIDDEN,
+    LOWRANK,
+    MAX_TOKENS,
+    QSA_CORE,
+    SLOTS,
+    THREADS,
+    VALUE_DIM,
+)
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.stages import exchange as ex_
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.stages import (
+    gdn,
+    hc,
+    moe,
+    tagged,
+    tiled,
+)
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.amd.specialized_decode.wide.stages import qsa as qsa_
+
+KINDS = ("gdn", "qsa_front", "qsa_back")
+ATTN, MLP = 0, 1  # a layer's two exchanges
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class LayerBuild:
+    kind: str
+    tokens: int
+    tp: int
+    stats: bool = False  # the input state came from vLLM: compute its rrms first
+    qkvz_shuffled: bool = False  # in_proj_qkvz on AITER's ASM FP4 GEMM layout
+    out_shuffled: bool = False  # out_proj likewise
+    rip: int = 384  # the experts' padded intermediate rows a rank
+    hc_eps: float = 1e-6
+    gdn_eps: float = 1e-6
+    trace: bool = False  # CTA 0 stamps the clock at every phase end (``phase_names``)
+    allreduce: str = "bf16"  # the TP exchange's line codec (``exchange.CODECS``)
+
+    def __post_init__(self):
+        if self.kind not in KINDS:
+            raise ValueError(f"layer kind {self.kind!r}")
+        if self.allreduce not in ex_.CODECS:
+            raise ValueError(f"all-reduce codec {self.allreduce!r}")
+        if not 1 <= self.tokens <= MAX_TOKENS:
+            raise ValueError(f"{self.tokens} rows: 1 to {MAX_TOKENS}")
+
+
+ABI = KernelAbi(
+    (
+        "state",
+        "x",
+        "scratch",
+        "a_norm",
+        "a_di",
+        "a_up",
+        "m_norm",
+        "m_di",
+        "m_up",
+        "w_qkvz",
+        "w_qkvz_s",
+        "w_ba",
+        "w_conv",
+        "a_log",
+        "dt_bias",
+        "gdn_norm",
+        "w_out",
+        "w_out_s",
+        "conv_state",
+        "conv_stride",
+        "ssm",
+        "ssm_stride",
+        "st_idx",
+        "attn",
+        "gate",
+        "w_gate",
+        "w13",
+        "w13s",
+        "w2",
+        "w2s",
+        "peers",
+        "rank",
+        "epoch",
+        "layer",
+        "sync",
+        "sync_next",
+        "folds",
+        "health",
+        "alarm",
+        "trace",
+        "w_qkv",
+        "w_ix",
+        "qkv_out",
+        "ix_out",
+    )
+)
+TRACE_WORDS = 32  # i64 stamps a layer in the trace buffer
+TRACE_BACK = 8  # where a QSA layer's second launch stamps in its layer's row
+
+
+def phase_names(key) -> list[str]:
+    """The stamps of a traced build (``LayerBuild.trace``), in order: each
+    marks the end of the named phase ("start": the kernel's start)."""
+    parts = ["mix_down", "mix_reduce", "mix_up"]
+    if tiled.resident(key.tokens):
+        parts = ["mix_down+up"]  # one phase (hc.mix_resident)
+    mix = lambda t: [f"{t}.{p}" for p in parts]  # noqa: E731
+    mlp = mix("mlp") + moe.phase_names(key.tokens)
+    out = ["start"] + (["stats"] if key.stats else [])
+    if key.kind != "qsa_back":
+        out += mix("attn")
+    if key.kind == "qsa_front":
+        out += ["qsa_proj"]
+    if key.kind == "gdn":
+        gdn_ = ["gdn_proj+conv", "gdn_recur", "out+allreduce+combine"]
+        if tiled.resident(key.tokens):
+            gdn_ = ["gdn+out+allreduce+combine"]  # one phase (tagged hand-offs)
+        out += gdn_ + mlp
+    if key.kind == "qsa_back":
+        out += ["out+allreduce+combine"] + mlp
+    return out
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# scratch: a width's intermediate buffers at static offsets
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def _part_words(rows: int) -> int:
+    plans = [
+        hc.down_plan(rows),
+        gdn.proj_plan(),
+        gdn.out_plan(),
+        gdn.out_plan(QSA_CORE),
+        moe.router_plan(),
+    ]
+    return max(p.partial_words(rows) for p in plans)
+
+
+def _resident_chunks() -> int:
+    """K chunks of the longest GEMM unit, which a resident stage holds."""
+    plans = [
+        hc.down_plan(1),
+        gdn.proj_plan(),
+        gdn.ba_plan(),
+        gdn.out_plan(),
+        gdn.out_plan(QSA_CORE),
+        moe.router_plan(),
+        qsa_.qkv_plan(),
+        qsa_.ix_plan(),
+    ]
+    return max([p.per for p in plans] + [hc.UP_CHUNKS])
+
+
+def scratch_layout(rows: int) -> dict[str, tuple[int, int]]:
+    """Name -> (byte offset, bytes) of a width's scratch, 256-byte aligned.
+    ``split`` (the MoE's split-unit marks) comes first and is sized for the
+    widest step, so every width's marks share one zeroed region that nothing
+    else writes."""
+    sizes = {
+        "split": MAX_TOKENS * SLOTS * 4,
+        "rrms": rows * HC * 4,
+        "inj_a": rows * HC * 4,
+        "inj_m": rows * HC * 4,
+        "down": rows * LOWRANK * 2,
+        "qkv": gdn.handoff_words(rows)[0] * 4,
+        "z": rows * VALUE_DIM * 2,
+        "ba": gdn.handoff_words(rows)[1] * 4,
+        "core": gdn.handoff_words(rows)[2] * 4,
+        "part": _part_words(rows) * 4,
+        "route": 2 * rows * SLOTS * 4,
+        "x4": rows * HIDDEN // 8 * 4,
+        "x4s": rows * HIDDEN // 32 * 4,
+        "mpart": rows * SLOTS * HIDDEN * 4,
+        "mpart2": rows * SLOTS * HIDDEN * 4,
+        "mixp": hc.mix_words(rows)[0] * 4,
+        "mixd": hc.mix_words(rows)[1] * 4,
+    }
+    out, off = {}, 0
+    for name, n in sizes.items():
+        out[name] = (off, n)
+        off = (off + n + 255) // 256 * 256
+    return out
+
+
+def scratch_bytes(rows: int) -> int:
+    return max(o + n for o, n in scratch_layout(rows).values())
+
+
+class Scratch(TraceInvariant):
+    """A width's scratch buffers (``scratch_layout``) as byte addresses."""
+
+    rrms: fx.Int64
+    inj_a: fx.Int64
+    inj_m: fx.Int64
+    down: fx.Int64
+    qkv: fx.Int64
+    z: fx.Int64
+    ba: fx.Int64
+    core: fx.Int64
+    part: fx.Int64
+    route: fx.Int64
+    x4: fx.Int64
+    x4s: fx.Int64
+    mpart: fx.Int64
+    mpart2: fx.Int64
+    split: fx.Int64
+    mixp: fx.Int64
+    mixd: fx.Int64
+
+    def __init__(self, base, rows: int):
+        for name, (off, _) in scratch_layout(rows).items():
+            setattr(self, name, fx.Int64(base) + fx.Int64(off))
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# the kernels
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+_BUILDS: dict = {}
+_STREAM = fx.Stream(None)
+
+
+def build(key: LayerBuild):
+    if key in _BUILDS:
+        return _BUILDS[key]
+    S, tp = key.tokens, key.tp
+    shape = moe.Shape(S, key.rip)
+    MoeLds = moe.lds_struct(shape)
+    aux_words = max(hc.up_lds_words(S), ex_.GroupTile.words(S), gdn.recur_lds_words())
+    chunks = _resident_chunks()
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class GemmLds:
+        stage: fx.Array[fx.Int32, tiled.stage_words(S, chunks), 16]
+        aux: fx.Array[fx.Int32, aux_words, 16]
+
+    @fx.union
+    class PhaseLds:
+        gemm: GemmLds
+        moe: MoeLds  # type: ignore[valid-type]
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class Smem:
+        word: fx.Array[fx.Int32, 4, 16]
+
+    if key.kind == "qsa_front":
+        part_bytes = scratch_layout(S)["part"][1]
+        assert qsa_.partial_words(S) * 4 <= part_bytes, "qsa_proj partials"
+    keyed = key_tuple(key)
+    name = f"q4w_{key.kind}_s{S}_tp{tp}" + ("_st" if key.stats else "")
+    name += "" if key.allreduce == "bf16" else f"_{key.allreduce}"
+
+    @flyc.kernel(name=name, known_block_size=[THREADS, 1, 1])
+    def kernel(
+        state: Int64,
+        x: Int64,
+        scratch: Int64,
+        a_norm: Int64,
+        a_di: Int64,
+        a_up: Int64,
+        m_norm: Int64,
+        m_di: Int64,
+        m_up: Int64,
+        w_qkvz: Int64,
+        w_qkvz_s: Int64,
+        w_ba: Int64,
+        w_conv: Int64,
+        a_log: Int64,
+        dt_bias: Int64,
+        gdn_norm: Int64,
+        w_out: Int64,
+        w_out_s: Int64,
+        conv_state: Int64,
+        conv_stride: Int64,
+        ssm: Int64,
+        ssm_stride: Int64,
+        st_idx: Int64,
+        attn: Int64,
+        gate: Int64,
+        w_gate: Int64,
+        w13: Int64,
+        w13s: Int64,
+        w2: Int64,
+        w2s: Int64,
+        peers: Int64,
+        rank: Int32,
+        epoch: Int64,
+        layer: Int32,
+        sync: Int64,
+        sync_next: Int64,
+        folds: Int64,
+        health: Int64,
+        alarm: Int64,
+        trace: Int64,
+        w_qkv: Int64,
+        w_ix: Int64,
+        qkv_out: Int64,
+        ix_out: Int64,
+    ):
+        _ = keyed
+        tid = fx.thread_idx.x
+        bid = fx.block_idx.x
+        alloc = fx.SharedAllocator()
+        sm = alloc.allocate(Smem).peek()
+        ph = alloc.allocate(PhaseLds)
+        gl, ml = ph.gemm.peek(), ph.moe.peek()
+        g = Grid(tid, bid, sync, sync_next, folds, health, alarm, sm.word.ptr)
+        prologue(g)
+        scr = Scratch(scratch, S)
+        aux_f32 = fx.recast_iter(fx.Float32, gl.aux.ptr)
+        gemm = tiled.Gemm(gl.stage.ptr, S, tid, chunks=chunks)
+        up_gemm = tiled.Gemm(gl.stage.ptr, S, tid, k_total=LOWRANK, chunks=chunks)
+        bases = [ld_ptr64(peers, r) for r in range(tp)]
+        own = bases[0]
+        for r in fx.range_constexpr(1, tp):
+            own = (rank == r).select(bases[r], own)
+        ep = ld(epoch, 0, fx.Int32)
+        names: list[str] = []
+        first = TRACE_BACK if key.kind == "qsa_back" else 0
+
+        def stamp(name):
+            if const_expr(key.trace):
+                if (bid == 0) & (tid == 0):
+                    st(trace, layer * TRACE_WORDS + first + len(names), memrealtime())
+                names.append(name)
+
+        def end_phase(name, issue=None):
+            """The phase's grid barrier; at resident widths ``issue()`` (the
+            next phase's first weights) runs inside it, its loads returned."""
+            out = grid_sync(g, issue if tiled.resident(S) else None)
+            stamp(name)
+            return out
+
+        stamp("start")
+
+        def exchange(kind: int):
+            slot = (layer % 2) * 2 + kind
+            tag = ep * 128 + layer * 2 + kind + 1
+            return ex_.Exchange(bases, own, rank, tp, slot, tag, S, key.allreduce)
+
+        # Past ``tiled.RESIDENT_MAX`` and up to ``tiled.PRELOAD_ROWS``, a GEMM
+        # phase's static weights are issued in an earlier phase, where the grid
+        # waits (``tiled.unit_preload``), and reach the GEMM as its
+        # ``pending``: mix_up's while mix_down runs (they land in its GEMM, not
+        # at the reduce's barrier), the GDN input projection's and the router's
+        # while mix_reduce runs, out_proj's while the recurrence runs, the MLP
+        # mix's W_di while the attention combine waits for the peer. Above it,
+        # mix_up's loads are issued as mix_reduce starts (``hc.UpLoads``).
+        early = tiled.RESIDENT_MAX < S <= tiled.PRELOAD_ROWS
+
+        def ahead(weights, plan):
+            return tiled.unit_preload(gemm, weights, plan, g.bid) if early else None
+
+        def mix(tag, kind, norm, di, up, inj, pending=None, then=None, nxt=None):
+            """``pending``: the down GEMM's first weights in flight, at the
+            resident widths ``hc.mix_issue``'s, else ``ahead``'s. The next
+            GEMM's are issued by ``then()`` inside the last barrier at the
+            resident widths, by ``ahead(*nxt)`` as mix_reduce starts at the
+            others, and returned."""
+            if const_expr(tiled.resident(S)):
+                hc.mix_resident(
+                    g,
+                    gemm,
+                    up_gemm,
+                    aux_f32,
+                    state,
+                    scr.rrms,
+                    norm,
+                    di,
+                    up,
+                    x,
+                    inj,
+                    (scr.mixp, scr.mixd),
+                    ep * 128 + layer * 2 + kind + 1,
+                    S,
+                    pending,
+                )
+                return end_phase(f"{tag}.mix_down+up", then)
+            if const_expr(early):
+                pre = hc.UpLoads(g, up_gemm, up, state, scr.rrms, norm, S)
+            hc.mix_down(g, gemm, state, scr.rrms, norm, di, scr.part, pending)
+            end_phase(f"{tag}.mix_down")
+            pre_next = None if nxt is None else ahead(*nxt)
+            if const_expr(not early):
+                pre = hc.UpLoads(g, up_gemm, up, state, scr.rrms, norm, S)
+            hc.mix_reduce(g, scr.part, scr.down, inj, S, True)
+            end_phase(f"{tag}.mix_reduce")
+            hc.mix_up(g, up_gemm, aux_f32, scr.down, up, x, S, pre)
+            end_phase(f"{tag}.mix_up")
+            return pre_next
+
+        def back(weights, source, k, pending=None, name="out+allreduce+combine"):
+            xch = exchange(ATTN)
+            tile = ex_.GroupTile(gl.aux.ptr, S)
+            gdn.out(g, gemm, weights, source, scr.part, tile, xch, k, 0, pending)
+            pre_down = ahead(hc.down_weights(m_di), hc.down_plan(S))
+            hc.combine(g, xch, state, scr.inj_a, scr.rrms, S, key.hc_eps)
+            issued = end_phase(name, lambda: hc.mix_issue(g, m_di, m_up, S))
+            return issued if tiled.resident(S) else pre_down
+
+        def mlp_half(pending):
+            mw = moe.Weights(w_gate, w13, w13s, w2, w2s)
+            pre = moe.prefetch(g, shape, mw)  # in flight through the mix
+            router_w = (moe.router_weights(w_gate), moe.router_plan())
+            routed = mix(
+                "mlp", MLP, m_norm, m_di, m_up, scr.inj_m, pending, nxt=router_w
+            )
+            xch = exchange(MLP)
+            moe.mlp(
+                g,
+                shape,
+                gemm,
+                ml,
+                x,
+                mw,
+                moe.Bufs(
+                    scr.part,
+                    scr.route,
+                    scr.x4,
+                    scr.x4s,
+                    scr.mpart,
+                    scr.mpart2,
+                    scr.split,
+                ),
+                xch,
+                end_phase,
+                pre if moe.small(S) else routed,
+            )
+            hc.combine(g, xch, state, scr.inj_m, scr.rrms, S, key.hc_eps)
+            if const_expr(key.trace):
+                end_phase(moe.phase_names(S)[-1])
+
+        down_w = None
+        if const_expr(key.stats):
+            pre_attn = ahead(hc.down_weights(a_di), hc.down_plan(S))
+            hc.stats(g, state, scr.rrms, S, key.hc_eps)
+            issued = end_phase("stats", lambda: hc.mix_issue(g, a_di, a_up, S))
+            down_w = issued if tiled.resident(S) else pre_attn
+        if const_expr(key.kind == "qsa_front"):
+            mix("attn", ATTN, a_norm, a_di, a_up, scr.inj_a, down_w)
+            qsa_.proj(g, gemm, w_qkv, w_ix, x, qkv_out, ix_out, scr.part, S)
+            if const_expr(key.trace):
+                end_phase("qsa_proj")
+        if const_expr(key.kind == "gdn"):
+            w = gdn.Bufs(
+                qkvz=w_qkvz,
+                qkvz_s=w_qkvz_s,
+                shuffled=key.qkvz_shuffled,
+                ba=w_ba,
+                conv=w_conv,
+                a_log=a_log,
+                dt_bias=dt_bias,
+                norm=gdn_norm,
+            )
+            b = gdn.Bufs(
+                x=x,
+                qkv=scr.qkv,
+                z=scr.z,
+                ba=scr.ba,
+                core=scr.core,
+                part=scr.part,
+                st_idx=st_idx,
+                conv_state=conv_state,
+                conv_stride=conv_stride,
+                ssm=ssm,
+                ssm_stride=ssm_stride,
+            )
+            proj_w = mix(
+                "attn",
+                ATTN,
+                a_norm,
+                a_di,
+                a_up,
+                scr.inj_a,
+                down_w,
+                lambda: gdn.proj_issue(g, w),
+                (gdn.proj_weights(w), gdn.proj_plan()),
+            )
+            out_w = tiled.Fp4Weights(
+                w_out, w_out_s, HIDDEN, VALUE_DIM, key.out_shuffled
+            )
+            if const_expr(tiled.resident(S)):
+                # one phase: the recurrence polls the projection's tagged
+                # outputs, out_proj the recurrence's (its weights issued
+                # before the recurrence, to land under it)
+                gtag = ep * 128 + layer * 2 + 1
+                gdn.proj(g, gemm, w, b, S, 0, proj_w, gtag)
+                pending = tiled.issue_unit(bid, tid, out_w, gdn.out_plan())
+                gdn.recur(g, w, b, aux_f32, S, key.gdn_eps, None, gtag)
+                source = tagged.Pairs(g, scr.core, VALUE_DIM, gtag)
+                name = "gdn+out+allreduce+combine"
+            else:
+                gdn.proj(g, gemm, w, b, S, 0, proj_w)
+                end_phase("gdn_proj+conv")
+                pending = ahead(out_w, gdn.out_plan())  # lands under the recurrence
+                gdn.recur(g, w, b, aux_f32, S, key.gdn_eps)
+                end_phase("gdn_recur")
+                source = tiled.Source(scr.core, VALUE_DIM)  # type: ignore[assignment]
+                name = "out+allreduce+combine"
+            mlp_half(back(out_w, source, VALUE_DIM, pending, name))
+        if const_expr(key.kind == "qsa_back"):
+            pending = back(
+                tiled.Bf16Weights(w_out, HIDDEN, QSA_CORE),
+                gdn.GatedCore(attn, gate, QSA_CORE),
+                QSA_CORE,
+            )
+            mlp_half(pending)
+        if const_expr(key.trace):
+            assert names == phase_names(key), (names, phase_names(key))
+
+    @flyc.jit
+    def launch(
+        state: Int64,
+        x: Int64,
+        scratch: Int64,
+        a_norm: Int64,
+        a_di: Int64,
+        a_up: Int64,
+        m_norm: Int64,
+        m_di: Int64,
+        m_up: Int64,
+        w_qkvz: Int64,
+        w_qkvz_s: Int64,
+        w_ba: Int64,
+        w_conv: Int64,
+        a_log: Int64,
+        dt_bias: Int64,
+        gdn_norm: Int64,
+        w_out: Int64,
+        w_out_s: Int64,
+        conv_state: Int64,
+        conv_stride: Int64,
+        ssm: Int64,
+        ssm_stride: Int64,
+        st_idx: Int64,
+        attn: Int64,
+        gate: Int64,
+        w_gate: Int64,
+        w13: Int64,
+        w13s: Int64,
+        w2: Int64,
+        w2s: Int64,
+        peers: Int64,
+        rank: Int32,
+        epoch: Int64,
+        layer: Int32,
+        sync: Int64,
+        sync_next: Int64,
+        folds: Int64,
+        health: Int64,
+        alarm: Int64,
+        trace: Int64,
+        w_qkv: Int64,
+        w_ix: Int64,
+        qkv_out: Int64,
+        ix_out: Int64,
+        stream: fx.Stream = _STREAM,
+    ):
+        _ = keyed
+        kernel(
+            state,
+            x,
+            scratch,
+            a_norm,
+            a_di,
+            a_up,
+            m_norm,
+            m_di,
+            m_up,
+            w_qkvz,
+            w_qkvz_s,
+            w_ba,
+            w_conv,
+            a_log,
+            dt_bias,
+            gdn_norm,
+            w_out,
+            w_out_s,
+            conv_state,
+            conv_stride,
+            ssm,
+            ssm_stride,
+            st_idx,
+            attn,
+            gate,
+            w_gate,
+            w13,
+            w13s,
+            w2,
+            w2s,
+            peers,
+            rank,
+            epoch,
+            layer,
+            sync,
+            sync_next,
+            folds,
+            health,
+            alarm,
+            trace,
+            w_qkv,
+            w_ix,
+            qkv_out,
+            ix_out,
+        ).launch(grid=(BLOCKS,), block=(THREADS,), stream=stream)
+
+    ABI.check(kernel, launch)
+    _BUILDS[key] = launch
+    return launch
+
+
+def run(key: LayerBuild, args: dict) -> None:
+    """Launch ``key``'s kernel on the current stream; ``args``: every ABI name
+    (tensors by data pointer, ints as is)."""
+    from vllm.v1.attention.ops.flydsl_kernels import _run_compiled
+
+    vals = [
+        v.data_ptr() if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor) else int(v) for v in ABI.pack(args)
+    ]
+    _run_compiled(build(key), *vals, torch.cuda.current_stream())
+
+
+def compile_only(key: LayerBuild) -> None:
+    """Compile ``key``'s kernel without launching it (FlyDSL's compile-only
+    mode returns before the launch)."""
+    import os
+
+    old = os.environ.get("COMPILE_ONLY")
+    os.environ["COMPILE_ONLY"] = "1"
+    try:
+        f = build(key)
+        f(*ABI.zeros(), stream=torch.cuda.current_stream())
+    finally:
+        if old is None:
+            del os.environ["COMPILE_ONLY"]
+        else:
+            os.environ["COMPILE_ONLY"] = old
